name: SLITHERWRACK HELM
description: Effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of this unit.
legend: This war-helm was fashioned from the skull of an infamous toad dragon; its pure repulsiveness causes enemies to retch and reel, rendering them helpless in their disgust.

name: GNARLSTAFF OF MORGHUR
description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.
legend: Infused with the corrupting taint of the Shadowgave, the hideous mewling sounds emitted by this staff unmake the arcane wards of the enemy.

name: BRAYBLAST TRUMPET
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE BEASTS OF CHAOS INFANTRY or non-CAVALRY unit that started the battle with 2 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: Carved from the bone of a Shaggoth, the thunderous blasts of this horn draw the true children of Chaos towards it.

name: RAGING STORM
description:
Declare: Pick each friendly THUNDERSCORN unit on the battlefield to be the friendly targets, then pick each enemy unit in combat with any friendly THUNDERSCORN units to be the enemy targets.

Effect: Heal (1) each friendly target. Then, roll a D3 for each enemy target, if any. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the enemy target equal to the roll.
legend: Lightning arcs down to the battlefield, imbuing the Thunderscorn with renewed vigour and smiting their enemies with lethal crackling energy.

name: FIENDS OF THE WILDS
description: Effect: Change one of the dice in the charge roll to a 4.
legend: To the blasting of brayhorns come the roaming brayherds, stampeding from all directions to tear the enemy asunder.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a <ky>Charge</ky> ability for a friendly %000002677Brayherd% unit

name: ARCH-DESPOILERS
description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS units that target an enemy unit that is contesting an objective you do not control.
legend: The rampaging creatures of the beastherds despise all aspects of civilisation, and they will tear down monuments with their bare hands if necessary.

name: BLOODGREED
description:
Declare: Pick each friendly WARHERD unit that used a FIGHT ability this turn to be the targets.

Effect: Heal (3) each target.
legend: Those beastmen in the throes of the bloodgreed who sate their cursed hunger for flesh are all but impossible to put down.

name: MASTERS OF THE WILDERNESS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS unit that has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up that unit in reserve in ambush. It has now been deployed.

Designer’s Note: Any number of friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS units can start the battle in reserve – even your entire Beasts of Chaos army!
legend: The wild lands of the Mortal Realms are the territory of the Beasts of Chaos, and they have dwelt in these places for longer than can be remembered.

name: BEASTHERD AMBUSH
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS unit that is in ambush.

Effect: Set up that unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

For the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for that unit.
legend: As the beasts close upon their foes, horn-blasts sound in every direction, signalling the launch of a deadly ambush.

name: RITUALS OF RUIN
description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:

Warping Curse: Pick an enemy unit within 12" of a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS HERO or, if there is a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS HERO in reserve, within 12" of a battlefield edge to be the target. Then, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

Brand of Wild Fury: Pick a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS unit wholly within 12" of a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS
legend: The mightiest of the beastmen worship the power of primeval Chaos, slaughtering and devouring in order to be blessed with strength or to force their opponents into throes of primal savagery.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

name: DEATH-GRIP
description: Effect: If that friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS unit is not in combat and is wholly within 18" of this unit, after the SHOOT ability has been resolved, that friendly unit can move 2D6". It can move into combat.
legend: As the enemy brings their firepower to bear, this general urges their kin to stay within claw’s grasp of their assailants.
condition: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a <ky>Shoot</ky> ability that targeted a friendly Beasts of Chaos unit

name: BESTIAL CUNNING
description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS units wholly within 12" of this unit that were set up this turn using the ‘Beastherd Ambush’ ability to be the targets.

Effect: Each target can immediately move D3". The targets cannot move into combat during any part of that move.
legend: Bestial warlords might lack the tactical nous of trained soldiers, but there are few creatures more adept at sniffing out an enemy’s weakness and violently exploiting it.

name: PROPAGATOR OF RUIN
description: Effect: While this unit is on the battlefield, you can use the ‘Rituals of Ruin’ ability twice per turn in your hero phase instead of once per turn. You cannot pick the same effect more than once per turn.
legend: This general seethes with anarchic power and with their every action seeks to promulgate the majesty of Chaos.

name: SUMMON WILDFIRE TAURUS
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Wildfire Taurus on the battlefield, pick a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Wildfire Taurus wholly within 18" of the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: Wisps of flame develop into a roaring, charging beast of black smoke and wildfire.

name: SUMMON RAVENING DIREFLOCK
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Ravening Direflock on the battlefield, pick a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Ravening Direflock wholly within 18" of the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Ravening Direflock has 3 parts that must each be set up within 1" of at least 1 other part.
legend: Dark feathers borne on the wind coalesce to form the terrible shapes of the Ravening Direflock.

name: SUMMON DOOMBLAST DIRGEHORN
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Doomblast Dirgehorn on the battlefield, pick a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Doomblast Dirgehorn wholly within 18" of the caster.
legend: Drawn from beneath the earth, animal bones are fused into the shape of a giant horn.

name: VILETIDE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. In addition, until the start of your next turn, the target cannot use commands.
legend: A seemingly ceaseless wave of bile, gore and writhing insects crashes into the enemy.

name: VICIOUS STRANGLETHORNS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:
  • Halve the target’s Move characteristic.
  • Subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.
legend: Twisting, thorn-covered vines erupt from the undergrowth to ensnare the foe.

name: DEVOLVE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy non-HERO unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:
  • The target unit has a maximum control score of 1.
  • The target cannot use commands.
  • Each time the target moves, if the caster is on the battlefield, the target must end that move no further from the caster than it was at the start of the move.
legend: Delving into the minds of their enemies, the shaman magnifies the savage and animalistic parts of their foes’ psyches until they are little more than growling beasts.

name: COLLAR OF CONTEMPT
description: Effect: This unit can use UNBIND abilities as if it had WIZARD (1). Each time this unit successfully unbinds a spell, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.
legend: This thrice-damned brass collar is the bane of magical power.

name: BUTCHER’S BLADE
description:
Declare: Pick each enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s combat attacks to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
legend: One cut from this blade can see a target brutally exsanguinated.

name: AR’GATH, THE KING OF BLADES
description: Effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for enemy HEROES while they are in combat with this unit.
legend: This daemonic blade hungers for the flesh of champions and will not be denied by trickery or magic.

name: BUTCHERS OF NATIONS
description:
Used By: The unit using that FIGHT ability.

Effect: Pick a friendly BLOODBOUND unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved.
legend: When the daemonic hosts of Khorne join their Bloodbound followers in battle, they crush all before them in a storm of gore-splattered carnage.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a %000010870<ky>FIGHT</ky> ability% for a %000008070BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON% unit

name: TIDE OF SAVAGERY
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BLOODBOUND HERO and up to 2 other friendly BLOODBOUND units that are wholly within 12" of that HERO to be the targets.

Effect: Add 2" to the targets’ Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.
legend: Since Korghos Khul’s ascension to daemonhood, the Goretide are filled with renewed purpose, rushing into battle with ever greater vigour.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase

name: EAGER KILLERS
description: Effect: Each friendly BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON unit that has used a FIGHT ability this turn and is not in combat can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat.
legend: Khorne's daemons care only for violence; any moment spent not slaying is a moment wasted.

name: DRAWN TO CARNAGE
description: Effect: Add X to charge rolls for friendly BLADES OF KHORNE units, where X is the number of friendly BLADES OF KHORNE CAVALRY or MONSTER units that have already charged this phase and that are wholly within 12" of the unit being rolled for.
legend: Nothing can stop the thunderous onset of a Brass Stampede once it has begun to gain momentum.

name: BLOODY COMPETITORS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO BLOODBOUND unit and a friendly non-HERO BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON unit to be the targets.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the targets are wholly within 12" of each other, add 1 to wound rolls for the targets’ combat attacks.
legend: Where the mortal followers and daemons of Khorne fight next to one another, they compete to reap the most skulls in the name of their grim deity.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

name: TIRELESS CONQUERORS
description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly BLOODBOUND units that target an enemy unit that is contesting an objective you do not control.
legend: The Bloodbound surge across the battlefield with blades held high, salivating and baying as they rip the enemy from their strongholds.

name: BLOOD-DRENCHED
description:
Effect: After that ability has been resolved, if you unlocked a BLOOD TITHE ability this turn, pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE unit to be the target. The following effects apply to the target for the rest of the battle:

Wild-eyed Brutality: Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target.

Blood Haze: If the target is BLOODBOUND, its Blood-hungry weapons have Crit (Mortal).

Weapons of Murder: If the target is a non-</
legend: As blood gushes down blades, armour and teeth, the fervent warriors of the Blood God are driven into a divine frenzy.
condition: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared the ‘%000017049Skulls for the Skull Throne%’ ability

name: MURDERLUST
description:
You do not need to unlock this ability to use it. It is already unlocked.

Effect: Roll a dice. You can replace one of the dice in the charge roll with that value. If you do so, inflict D3 mortal damage on the unit using that CHARGE ability after that ability is resolved.
legend: When worthy opponents are near, the impulse to kill becomes all-consuming.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a <ky>CHARGE</ky> ability

name: BLOOD FOR THE BLOOD GOD
description: Effect: Earn 1 blood tithe point each time a unit (friendly or enemy) is destroyed. Blood tithe points are spent to unlock BLOOD TITHE abilities. You can only use BLOOD TITHE abilities that are unlocked. Once a BLOOD TITHE ability is unlocked, you do not need to spend further blood tithe points to use it.
legend: Khorne cares not from where the blood flows...

name: DIVINE SCORN
description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 enemy WIZARDS or PRIESTS within 6" of any friendly BLADES OF KHORNE units to be the target(s).

Effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the target’s power level, to a minimum of 0, until the start of the next turn.
legend: The battlefield is Khorne's temple, and Khorne's alone.
condition: Once per Turn, Start of Any Turn

name: SKULLS FOR THE SKULL THRONE
description: Effect: Pick a BLOOD TITHE ability that you have not unlocked and spend the number of blood tithe points required to unlock that ability (shown in the top-right corner of the ability). That BLOOD TITHE ability is now unlocked for the rest of the battle.
legend: ...only that it flows.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn

name: PUNISH THE PACIFIST
description:
Declare: Each unit (friendly and enemy) and enemy MANIFESTATION that is not in combat is a target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 1-2, inflict 1 mortal damage on each target. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy target.
legend: To shirk from combat is to sin against the War God.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase

name: MURDER THE MYSTIC
description:
You can only unlock this ability if you have unlock this ability if you have unlocked ‘Divine Scorn’.

Declare: Pick up to 4 enemy MANIFESTATIONS to be the target(s).

Effect: Make a banishment roll of 2D6 for each target. If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on that MANIFESTATION’s warscroll, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 3" of it and then it is banished and removed from play.
legend: Those who cower behind conjured spellcraft will be punished severely.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

name: GLORIOUS COMBAT OR NAUGHT
description:
You can only unlock this ability if you have unlock this ability if you have unlocked ‘Divine Scorn’ or ‘Punish the Pacifist’.

Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly BLADES OF KHORNE units.
legend: The air boils, charring arrows and melting musket shot.

name: REVEL IN BATTLE
description:
You can only unlock this ability if you have unlock this ability if you have unlocked ‘Punish the Pacifist’.

Effect: Other than the Companion weapon ability, weapon abilities for combat attacks made by enemy units that charged this turn and that target a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE unit have no effect.
legend: No tricks - no deceptions.

name: SLAUGHTER TRIUMPHANT
description:
You can only unlock this ability if you have unlock this ability if you have unlocked ‘Murder the Mystic’ or ‘Glorious Combat or Naught’.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by friendly BLADES OF KHORNE units that charged in the same turn.
legend: Khorne's fury floods the field, burning out all thought but to slay.

name: CLEAVE WIDE THE GRIN OF KHORNE
description:
You can only unlock this ability if you have unlock this ability if you have unlocked already ‘Revel in Battle’ or ‘Glorious Combat or Naught’.

Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly BLADES OF KHORNE units.
legend: Gore begets gore, and death begets death.

name: RESANGUINATION
description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 16" of your general, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: On a 3+, Heal (D3) that unit.
legend: The Slaughterpriest calls upon Khorne’s favour to sear the wounds of an ally so that they can continue to shed the blood of the enemy.

name: THE BLOOD TITHE
description: Effect: Each time a unit is destroyed during the battle, you receive 1 blood tithe point.
legend: Khorne’s warriors receive divine rewards when blood is shed; whether the sacrifice is theirs or that of their foes matters not.

name: FAVOURED OF KHORNE
description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, you receive 1 blood tithe point.
legend: These blood-marked warriors are the victors of many battles and court the favour of their patron.
condition: Once Per Turn, Start of Your Turn

name: HEADS MUST ROLL
description:
Declare: Spend 3 blood tithe points and pick up to 3 friendly units.

Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of those units’ melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
legend: A terrible hunger is awoken in the gore-slick weapons of the Bloodbound.
condition: Once Per Turn, Any Hero Phase

name: HEADHUNTER
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy HERO in combat with your general.

Effect: Your general has STRIKE-FIRST this phase, but all attacks made by them this phase must target that enemy HERO.
legend: Even Khorne’s priests will seek out the worthiest of foes against which to test their martial prowess.

name: BLOOD-WOKEN RUNES
description: Effect: Friendly units have WARD (5+) if they have used a FIGHT ability in the same phase.
legend: Fell runes of resilience are carved into the armour of these warriors, needing only the touch of a foe’s blood to be empowered.

name: MURDERLUST
description:
Declare: Spend 1 blood tithe point and pick up to D3 friendly units.

Effect: Each of those units can move D6" (roll for each).
legend: All servants of Khorne feel the urge to kill, but when prey is near, the impulse becomes all-consuming.
condition: Once Per Turn, Any Hero Phase

name: THE CRIMSON PLATE
description: Effect: Your general has WARD (5+).
legend: This ancient armour bestows Khorne’s protection upon its wearer, provided it is burnished daily with the blood of champions.

name: UNHOLY FLAMES
description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 16" of your general, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: On a 4+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
legend: The priest imbues the blades of their allies with daemonic fire, so that they may claim skulls with horrific ease.

name: BRASS FLESH
description: Effect: Unmodified save rolls of 5+ for this unit cannot fail.
legend: Arrows and blades alike simply glance off the burnished, metallic skin of these warriors.

name: FRENZIED TASKMASTER
description: Effect: Each time this unit is picked to use the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability, for each unmodified hit roll of 6 for the attacks made as part of that ability, inflict an additional 3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with this unit instead of D3.
legend: Fashioned into living engines of destruction, these warriors have secondary limbs that end in razor-sharp blades.

name: SCORPION TAILS
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect:
  • Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
  • If the target unit’s starting size was 1, subtract 1 from wound rolls for its combat attacks for the rest of the turn.
legend: With their powerful arachnoid stingers, these warriors inject deadly venom into the enemy

name: THE SCENT OF BLOOD
description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls and add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks that target an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn.
legend: The iron stink of gore sends Karanak's pack into a feral frenzy.

name: THE QUARRY
description: Effect: If no enemy units are the quarry, pick an enemy unit to be the quarry (you can pick an enemy unit in reserve).
legend: Karanak's hunt is eternal, for there is no end to those who offend Khorne's creed.

name: SUSTAINED BY GORE
description: Effect: Heal (D3) your general.
legend: Karanak can pursue a target endlessly, provided the blood keeps flowing.

name: SAVAGERY UPON SAVAGERY
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit in combat to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons. If the target is a HERO, add D3 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons instead.
legend: The harder one resists Karanak, the more furious the daemon grows.
condition: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

name: BLOOD-DRENCHED
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that slew any enemy models using a FIGHT ability this turn to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, the target’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal).
legend: As blood gushes down blades, armour and teeth, the fervent warriors of the Blood God are driven into a divine frenzy.
condition: Once Per Turn, End of Any Turn

name: KILLING POUNCE
description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, when making charge rolls for your general, you can roll an additional dice, to a maximum of 3, but if you do, they must finish that charge in combat with the quarry.
legend: When the moment to strike comes, Karanak leaps with unbridled force.
condition: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase

name: EVASIVE HUNTER
description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for shooting attacks that target your general.
legend: Karanak's natural speed and the bloody aura that surrounds him, makes him difficult to target from afar.

name: FURIOUS BITES
description: Effect: If your general is in combat with the quarry, inflict D3 mortal damage on the quarry.
legend: All three of Karanak's monstrous heads hunger to tear apart flesh and soul.

name: WARMONGER’S ICON
description:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to D3 friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS units within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.

Effect: The targets have STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.
legend: The personal standard of a warhorde's master inspires a frenzied devotion.
condition: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

name: MURDER-WON TROPHIES
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS HERO to be the target.

Effect: Give the target 1 artefact of power from the ’Gorechosen Champions’ Army of Renown rules.

Designer’s Note: This artefact of power is given to the HERO during the deployment phase, not during army composition.
legend: The Gorechosen have ripped countless trophies from the carcasses of worthy foes.

name: CROWNED IN BUTCHERY
description: Effect: Add 20 to this unit’s control score while it is in combat.
legend: To yoke the lords of the Gorechosen demands a champion of singular, terrifying will.

name: SUMMON WRATH-AXE
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Wrath-axe on the battlefield, pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Set up a Wrath-axe wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: A Wrath-axe is a manifestation of Khorne's otherworldly anger, its razor-sharp edges glowing red-hot from the Blood God's rage. At signs of weakness or wizardry, such a blazing axe appears in the air, splitting reality with its downwards stroke.

name: SKIN OF BRASS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that friendly unit. If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.
legend: A shimmering skull manifests over a chosen champion, spilling gore upon them and granting their skin the hue and toughness of freshly forged brass.

name: THE SCARRING BLADE
description:
Effect: Allocate D3 damage points to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). For the rest of the turn, add X to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS units for the rest of the turn, where X is equal to the number of damage points allocated to this unit this turn by this ability.

For the rest of the battle, this unit cannot use the ‘Hate-fuelled Killers’ ability and cannot be healed.
legend: It is said that wounds caused by this dagger never cease leaking blood - and that one who turns it upon themselves in bleak reverence will earn great favour.

name: BRUTAL LASHMASTER
description: Effect: Each time a friendly Bloodstoker uses the ’Whipped to Fury’ ability, another friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS HERO within its combat range can be picked to be the target of that ability instead of a non-HERO BLOODBOUND unit.
legend: A favoured Bloodstoker can drive even other champions to battle.

name: COWED AND BROKEN
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them that is in combat with a friendly unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Roll 8 dice. If the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to each roll. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
legend: The priest channels Khorne's seething hatred through a Gorechosen, causing the bones of foes who stand in the way of worthier targets to agonisingly twist and snap.

name: BLOODMIST SKULL
description: Effect: This unit has WARD (3+) against damage inflicted by shooting attacks.
legend: A thick sanguine pall spills from the mouth of this rune-carved skull, burning enemy projectiles to ash mid-flight.

name: LEGENDARY SLAYERS
description: Effect: Blood-hungry weapons used by friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS units have Crit (Mortal).
legend: To be Gorechosen is to have slain hundreds, if not thousands.

name: ERUPTION OF APOPLEXY
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them that is in combat with a friendly unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target. If the target is destroyed, before removing the last model in that unit from play, inflict D3 mortal damage on every unit (friendly and enemy) within 6" of that model, or D6 mortal damage instead if the chanting roll was 8+.
legend: The priest focuses the rage of all the battle's combatants into a single warrior, whose organs rupture under the strain - or whose entire body violently explodes in a magnificent shower of boiling gore and bone shrapnel.

name: THE RED GOD’S EYE
description: Effect: Friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS units have WARD (6+).
legend: When the Gorechosen fight in unity, the Blood God's gaze is drawn. None would dare falter under such scrutiny.

name: HATE-FUELLED KILLERS
description: Effect: The first time each friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 5+, that unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, Heal (1) that unit.
legend: Anger, hate and violence run through the veins of the Gorechosen, allowing them to ignore otherwise fatal blows.

name: MAGICAL SCORN
description:
Effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls for WIZARDS while they are within 12" of this unit.

Subtract 1 from chanting rolls for enemy PRIESTS while they are within 12" of this unit.
legend: This warrior's loathing of the arcane and esoteric exudes from them in waves.

name: FRENZIED TASKMASTER
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE INFANTRY or CAVALRY unit within this unit’s combat range that is not in combat to be the target.

Effect: The target can move D6" but cannot end that move in combat. If the target ends that move within this unit’s combat range, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
legend: This champion does not allow their followers to shirk the slaughter.

name: SKULL COLLECTOR
description:
Effect: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy HERO by this unit’s combat attacks this turn and that enemy HERO has been destroyed, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the battle.

This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.
legend: Even other warriors of Khorne are in awe of this champion's fixation on decapitation.

name: SUMMON HEXGORGER SKULLS
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Hexgorger Skulls invocation on the battlefield, pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Set up a Hexgorger Skulls invocation wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Hexgorger Skulls invocation has 2 parts that must be set up within 8" of each other.
legend: Hexgorger Skulls are the physical manifestation of Khorne's hatred of the arcane arts. They drift across the battlefield, seeking to feed upon eldritch energy and those conjurers who attempt to use it.

name: SUMMON WRATH-AXE
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Wrath-axe on the battlefield, pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Set up a Wrath-axe wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: A Wrath-axe is a manifestation of Khorne's otherworldly anger, its razor-sharp edges glowing from the heat of the Blood God's rage. As a chanting priest carves the ground open, these eldritch axes appear to tear the air in twain, reality set ablaze at its passage.

name: SUMMON BLEEDING ICON
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Bleeding Icon on the battlefield, pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Set up a Bleeding Icon wholly within 18" of the chanter and visible to them.
legend: A common sight in the crimson skies above Khorne's domain, a Bleeding Icon can be summoned to the Mortal Realms to signal the attention - and the displeasure - of the Lord of Battles.

name: GOREFLESH
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly BLADES OF KHORNE unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point allocated to the target in each phase. If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.
legend: Glistening, steaming blood flows over the flesh of the priest’s followers before coagulating into a gruesome second skin that dulls the strikes of the foe.

name: UNCONTROLLABLE RAGE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the effects of the ’Blood-drenched’ ability apply to the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, ignore the effect of ’Wild-eyed Brutality’ on the target.
legend: Opening their own veins while chanting hateful catechisms of worship, the priest spreads their own depthless fury to their allies.

name: STOKE THE FLAMES
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Blades of Khorne unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:
  • When resolving the damage sequence for enemy units in combat with the target, your opponent cannot spend rage dice as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability.
  • If the target is destroyed, you gain 1 rage dice. If the chanting roll was 6+, you gain 2 rage dice instead.
legend: The priest calls for their followers to slay and be slain as they channel the ire of Khorne.

name: RUNES OF LOATHING
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target has WARD (3+) against damage inflicted by SPELL abilities, PRAYER abilities and abilities used by MANIFESTAT
legend: With a guttural curse, the priest carves runes into their flesh that are antithetical to hated sorcery, which sympathetically manifest upon the armour of nearby followers.

name: BLOOD BOIL
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.
legend: Spitting ritualistic words of wrath into the air, the priest turns the blood coursing through the veins of the enemy red-hot, burning them from the inside out.

name: GIFT OF APOPLEXY
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses an ability that is not a MOVE or FIGHT ability, after that ability has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 3 mortal damage instead of D3.
legend: The priest invokes a murderous rage in their enemies to which they must give vent… either against their foes or against each other.

name: GIFT OF APOPLEXY
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses an ability that is not a MOVE, CHARGE or FIGHT ability, after that ability is resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 3 mortal damage instead of D3.
legend: Chanting words of carnage, the Slaughterpriest invokes a murderous rage in their enemies that will drive them to tear each other apart with hands and teeth should the opportunity to unleash violence on their foes not present itself.

name: FINAL ACT OF VIOLENCE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly BLADES OF KHORNE unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. If the chanting roll was 8+, roll 2 dice instead. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking
legend: The spat invectives of this priest inspire their faithful to slaughter to their last breath.

name: FETTERS OF BLOOD
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn:
  • The targets cannot use RETREAT or RUN abilities.
  • The targets cannot be removed from the battlefield by an ability that would allow them to be set up elsewhere on the battlefield or in
legend: Erupting from the ground by the enemy’s feet, these chains ensnare those who would flee the wrath of Khorne.

name: UNRIVALLED BATTLELUST
description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of friendly BALEFUL LORDS units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
legend: With a terrifying roar, this marshal amongst Bloodthirsters goads their kin to even greater heights of carnage.
condition: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase

name: CROWN OF THE SLAUGHTERBORN
description: Effect: Enemy units within 12" of this unit cannot be healed and cannot have slain models returned to them.
legend: A prize won on the battlefields of the Great Game, this spiked circlet of brass and iron torments stirring souls and ensures bloody wounds shall not heal.

name: BORN OF BUTCHERY
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE BALEFUL LORDS unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the current battle round number plus the number of units (friendly and enemy) that have been destroyed this battle. If the roll contains 8 or more results of 3+, set up a replacement unit identical to the target on the battlefield, wholly within 7" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: So long as gore flows in rivers and hate chokes mortal souls, the Baleful Lords shall rise again and anew.
condition: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase

name: BELLOW OF HATRED
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BALEFUL LORDS unit that has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, enemy units cannot use commands while they are in combat with the target. The target cannot use RAMPAGE abilities for the rest of the turn.
legend: The enmity released by this blood-curdling scream stuns nearby enemies.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

name: MAGE-EATERS
description:
Used By: A friendly BALEFUL LORDS unit targeted by that Spell ability.

Effect: Make a magic-eater roll of D6. On a 3+, that spell is unbound. If the spell was unbound and the magic-eater roll was 5+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.
legend: Those who dare wield spells in the presence of these daemons are soon punished.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a <ky>Spell</ky> ability

name: FIRST IN HIS SIGHT
description: Effect: Heal (D3) each friendly BALEFUL LORDS HERO that is in combat.
legend: Of all Khorne's daemon legions the Baleful Lords are highest in his favour, and the inferno of his rage burns hot in their immortal veins.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Enemy Turn

name: DRAWN BY BLOOD
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BALEFUL LORDS unit that has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn to use this ability.

Effect: That unit can move D6". It can end that move in combat but only with units it was in combat with at the start of the phase.

If that unit destroyed any enemy units this turn, then instead:

That unit can move 2D6". It can end that move in combat with any units that had any damage points allocated to them this turn.
legend: For the Baleful Lords, nothing is more pressing than to commit atrocity.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn

name: THE PRICE OF MERCY
description:
Declare: You must use this ability. Pick each friendly BALEFUL LORDS unit that did not charge or use a FIGHT ability this turn to be a target.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
legend: Inaction is hateful to all Khorne's daemons, but to the Baleful Lords, it is utterly anathemic.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn

name: SUNDER THE SORCEROUS
description:
Declare: Pick each enemy MANIFESTATION within 3" of a friendly BALEFUL LORDS unit to be a target.

Effect: Roll 2D6 for each target. If the roll equals or exceeds the banishment value of the target:
  • That target is banished and removed from play.
  • Inflict D3 mortal damage on the enemy unit that summoned the target.
legend: The Baleful Lords are veterans of impossible battles across the mind-bending vistas of the Realm of Chaos. No mere spell, nor its caster, can oppose them.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

name: DOKK JUICE
description: Effect: If this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, Heal (1) this unit. This unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.
legend: A sip of this brew temporarily grants the imbiber the regenerative qualities of a troggoth – if they are able to keep it down for long enough, that is.

name: GLOWIN’ TATTOOZ
description: Effect: This unit has WARD (4+).
legend: The beast spirits in these tattoos are so fierce that death itself shies away from them.

name: MONSTA-KILLA CHOMPA
description: Effect: This unit has STRIKE-FIRST while it is in combat with an enemy BEAST or MONSTER.
legend: No beast worth its bones can escape the bite of this boss’s chompa.

name: TIRELESS TRACKERS
description: Effect: Half the friendly non-HERO BONESPLITTERZ INFANTRY units on the battlefield (rounding up) can immediately use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
legend: The Brutal Rukks move at a relentless pace when hunting prey, appearing suddenly and giving the enemy no time in which to prepare.

name: SQUINT-EYE TAKTIKS
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit on the battlefield to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, hit rolls for shooting attacks made by friendly Savage Orruk Arrowboys units that target the target unit score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.
legend: Whether down to luck, feverishly launched volleys or the simple act of squinting one eye to ‘aim proppa’, this rukk’s Arrowboys have developed a knack for hitting targets where it hurts.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase

name: REALM-CHOMPERS
description: Effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for enemy units while they are within the combat range of any friendly BONESPLITTERZ HEROES.
legend: The dokks and bosses of these orruks have devoured so many beast spirits that magical essence is devoured by their warpaint.

name: WE’Z DA BEASTIEST
description: Effect: Friendly BONESPLITTERZ CAVALRY units have Anti-charge (+1 Rend).
legend: The Boarboys of the Snaga Rukks love smashing into startled enemies, but having hunted the greatest of beasts, are no strangers themselves to being barrelled into by stampeding monsters.

name: SPRING THE TRAP
description: Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for friendly BONESPLITTERZ units that charged in the same turn.
legend: When the prey is finally corralled, the Bonesplitterz launch themselves forward. The time for kunnin’ is over; now it’s time to get brutal!

name: TAKE DA BAIT
description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly BONESPLITTERZ units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target’s melee weapons while it is in combat with an enemy unit that charged in the same turn, and so long as the target has not charged during the battle.
legend: When a group of enemies hurl themselves at a line of grinnin’ Bonesplitterz, too late they realise it was all a trap…

name: BONESPLITTERZ WAAAGH!
description:
Declare: Pick each friendly BONESPLITTERZ WIZARD and BONESPLITTERZ PRIEST to be the targets.

Effect: Add 1 to the power level of each target for the rest of the turn. In addition, friendly BONESPLITTERZ units have WARD (5+) for the rest of the turn.
legend: Their warpaint blazing with ferocious energy, the Bonesplitterz surge forward under the potent mystical guidance of their shamans.
condition: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase

name: MONSTER HUNTERS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BONESPLITTERZ unit in combat with an enemy MONSTER to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks and add 1 to save rolls for the target.
legend: Bonesplitterz mobs are adept at bringing down the many ferocious monsters that inhabit the Mortal Realms.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase

name: KILLA INSTINKT
description: Effect: This unit’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal).
legend: This keen-eyed orruk knows exactly where to strike for maximum effect, even against the gargantuan beasts of the Mortal Realms.

name: ’ORRIBLE LEER
description: Effect: Enemy MONSTERS cannot use RAMPAGE abilities while they are in combat with this unit.
legend: The awful grin of this orruk can send chills down the spine of even the most blood-crazed monsters.

name: ONE WIV’ DA BEAST
description: Effect: The next time this phase that this unit uses a SPELL ability, instead of making a casting roll for this unit, you can use a value of 6 for the roll that cannot be modified.
legend: This shaman has consumed the spirits of many a beast, strengthening his spiritual connection to the Twin‑Headed God.
condition: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase

name: BASHDOKK DANCE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BONESPLITTERZ PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly BONESPLITTERZ unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Add 1 to charge rolls and run rolls for the target for the rest of the turn. If the chanting roll was 7+, in addition, for the rest of the turn, the target can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn.
legend: Thumping his feet in a hectic rhythm, the Wardokk gets the boyz ready to have a massive rukk.

name: GRIMDOKK DANCE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BONESPLITTERZ PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly BONESPLITTERZ unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Heal (3) the target unit or return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3. If the chanting roll for this prayer was 9+, instead, Heal (6) the target unit or return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to 6.
legend: Stamping his feet hard on the ground, the Wardokk drives Gorky energy into nearby ladz, causing rent flesh to knit together, and broken bones to grind back into place.

name: WEIRDOKK DANCE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BONESPLITTERZ PRIEST to chant this prayer. Then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Subtract 1 from chanting rolls and casting rolls for enemy PRIESTS and WIZARDS while they are within 18" of the chanter until the start of your next turn.

In addition, if the chanting roll was 11+, enemy Priests within 18" of the chanter each lose D6 ritual points and enemy WIZARDS cannot use UNBIND abilities while they are within 18" of the chanter until the start of your next turn.
legend: Dancing to a rhythm only they can hear, this erratic beat causes havoc with enemy mystics.

name: GLOWY GREEN FRENZY
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BONESPLITTERZ WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn, including Companion weapons.
legend: A swirl of green energy coalesces around the boyz, imbuing them with a terrifying ferocity that drives their strikes with primal strength.

name: FISTS OF GORK
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BONESPLITTERZ WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
legend: Great green fists rain down from the sky to pummel the foe.

name: GORKAMORKA’S WAR CRY
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BONESPLITTERZ WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.
legend: The shaman takes a huge gulp of Waaagh! energy before letting out a world-shaking roar.

name: FORM UP, ALLIES!
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES unit to use this ability, then pick 2 other visible friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.

The unit using this ability and the targets:
  • cannot be under orders.
  • must each be a different unit type.

Effect: For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are under orders.

legend: Once the order is given, humans, aelves and duardin alike link up to form a fortress of flesh and steel that little can stand against.

name: RESPECTED COMMANDER
description: Effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
legend: This commander is hailed as a paragon of virtue by all goodly beings, and their orders are followed with the utmost haste.

name: DIVINE MANDATE

Declare: Pick a friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

legend: Sigmar’s quest to drive Chaos from reality and reconquer the Mortal Realms imbues his faithful with his dread aspect of war, that of a furious and all-conquering warrior king.

name: THESE REALMS ARE OURS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES WIZARD to cast this spell, pick an objective within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, melee weapons used by friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES units have Charge (+1 Damage) for attacks that target enemy units that are contesting the target objective.
legend: The allies of Sigmar share a desire to restore civilisation and stability to the realms, whatever the cost.

name: SIGNET OF THE CITY
description:
Declare: Pick this unit and each visible friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES unit wholly within 18" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:
  • The targets are under orders.
  • The targets have WARD (6+).
  • The targets have a maximum control score of 1.
legend: This piece of jewellery is bestowed upon those who have performed a great service to one of Sigmar’s cities, giving their opinion considerable weight in matters military. The bearers do tend to overstep their authority, however, countermanding earlier orders and sowing confusion.
condition: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase

name: FORCES OF ORDER
description:

legend: The soldiers who stand shoulder to shoulder against the evil ravaging the Mortal Realms are hardy and bold, and they take strength from their shared bonds of fellowship.

name: THE LAST BLADE OF EMBERGARD
description: Effect: This unit can use this ability while it is in reserve. Pick 1 of this unit’s non-Companion melee weapons. Add 2 to that weapon’s Attacks characteristic and Rend characteristic for the rest of the battle.
legend: This chipped and scratched blade grows steadily hotter as allies and enemies fall, fuelled by the fury of battle.

name: BONES OF SAINT IGNIFUS
description: Effect: Add 1 to the casting roll or chanting roll for that ability.
legend: The seventh Supreme Pontifex of the Sigmarite faith, Ignifus perished in the act of slaying the Nightmare of Vandium. His bones thrum with righteous power.
condition: Reaction: You declared a <ky>SPELL</ky> or <ky>PRAYER</ky> ability for a %000010532visible% unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders

name: THE SPHERE CELESTIAL
description:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a point on the battlefield within 1" of this unit and more than 3" from all other units (friendly and enemy) and terrain features to be the target point. Then, pick another visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR INFANTRY or CAVALRY HERO that is wholly within 18" of this unit and not in combat to be the target unit.

Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and
legend: By cranking the dials on this incredibly sophisticated artefact, the bearer can manipulate space and time on a local level, swapping the position of themselves and another willing ally.

name: I’VE SEEN WORSE AND KILLED BETTER
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with any friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN units that did not charge this turn to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, other than the Companion weapon ability, weapon abilities for the target’s combat attacks have no effect for the rest of the turn.
legend: The duardin who battle for the Cities of Sigmar are as gruff and critical as they are loyal, courageous and bold. Little can move them once their mind is set or their feet planted.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Combat Phase

name: HAVE NO MERCY
description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of the next battle round, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR AELF units that target that enemy unit while it is damaged or has had any models slain in the same turn.
legend: Their mistress’s commands echoing in their minds, the aelves of the Darkling Covens are compelled to murder the foe with pitiless efficiency, their dark-hearted kin joining them in the slaughter.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round

name: THRONGS OF THE FAITHFUL
description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly SIGMARITE units that target the enemy unit using that FIGHT ability.
legend: All that remains in these Sigmarites’ hearts is a burning desire for vengeance against the reavers who slaughtered their loved ones.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Your opponent declared a %000010870<ky>FIGHT</ky> ability%

name: TO THE LAST
description: Effect: Each time a friendly unit that is under orders uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.
legend: Determined to safeguard all that they cherish, the Sigmarites charge into battle to reinforce wavering battlelines.

name: DAWNBRINGER CRUSADE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO CITIES OF SIGMAR INFANTRY unit wholly within friendly territory to use this ability.

Effect: If that unit is in combat, it can move 6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move. It does not have to end the move in combat.

If that unit is not in combat, it can move 6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.
legend: Pouring forth from the Cities of Sigmar, the Dawnbringer Crusades seek to reconquer and reconsecrate the Mortal Realms in the name of the God-King.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

name: MASTERS OF THE ARCANE
description:
Effect: Add 1 to arcane manipulation rolls and banishment rolls for friendly WIZARDS that are under orders.

Designer’s Note: WIZARDS in this battletome use arcane manipulation rolls for a variety of powerful effects.
legend: The battlemages of the Collegiate Arcane might be intimidating and occasionally aloof, but their sorcery perfectly supplements a fighting formation.

name: FRONT-LINE LEADER
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR HUMAN INFANTRY HERO to use this ability. Then, you can pick up to 1 friendly NON-HERO HUMAN INFANTRY unit and up to 1 friendly HUMAN WAR MACHINE unit that are wholly within 12" of that HERO to be the targets.

legend: The officars of this army are the stuff of Dawnbringer legend, hard-bitten veterans that stand with the troops through thick and thin. Their exemplary behaviour and courage inspires their soldiers to fight all the harder when the going gets tough.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

name: CANNY CREWS
description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly Ironweld Great Cannon units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, each time the target uses a SHOOT ability, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, or 1 wound roll, or 1 random characteristic roll for the Damage characteristic.
legend: The crews of these Great Cannons are so well trained they often fire the perfect shot, blasting off the heads of monsters or mowing down ranks of the enemy.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase

name: FORM UP!
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit to use this ability, then pick 2 other visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.

The unit using this ability and the targets:
  • cannot be under orders.
  • must each be a different unit type.

Effect: For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are under orders.
