legend: Once the order is given, shieldwalls and cannon batteries link up to form a fortress of flesh and steel that little can stand against.

name: TAKE AIM!
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is under orders to use this ability.

Effect: Pick 1 of that unit’s ranged weapons. Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made with that weapon for the rest of the turn.
legend: While their shield-slogging comrades keep the foe at bay, sharpshooters rain down punishing volumes of fire on helpless foes.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase

name: SOUND THE ATTACK!
description:
Used By: The unit using that CHARGE ability.

Effect: You can change the lowest D6 in the charge roll to match the highest D6.
legend: As the piercing note of a war-horn sounds, shields shift aside to permit cavalry and hollering assault troops to sally forth and engage the foe.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a <ky>CHARGE</ky> ability for a unit that is under orders

name: INTO THEM, YOU DOGS!
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly HERO that is under orders to use this ability. That unit is the field officer for the rest of the turn. Then, pick 2 other visible friendly non-HERO units that are under orders and wholly within 12" of the field officer to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the first time the field officer uses a FIGHT ability, you can pick a target that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn. That target is inspirited and the other target is emboldened. The inspirited target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immedia
legend: Sigmarite officers demand remarkable feats from their warriors, leading them into the furnace of battle with a rousing speech and a sword held high.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

name: HURL THEM BACK!
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is under orders and in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn to use this ability.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons.
legend: After the enemy has spent their fury, the Sigmarites heave forward, shoving their foes off balance and leaving them open to a killing blow.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

name: FOR SIGMAR, CHARGE!
description: Effect: Friendly CAVALRY units have STRIKE-FIRST if they charged in the same turn.
legend: With their blade raised high, the Marshal signals the charge of the Cavaliers.

name: FLASK OF LETHISIAN DARKWATER
description: Effect: Heal (D6) your general.
legend: Sourced from the lakewaters of the city of Lethis, when this potion is carefully sipped, its black liquid soothes the body and soul.
condition: Once Per Battle, Start of Any Turn

name: THE OFFICAR'S ORDER
description:
Declare: Pick a battle tactic card in your hand and place it face-down separately next to your other battle tactic cards. The information on it is still hidden from your opponent but make it clear which card is separate. The card stays separate until you use the command on it or score the battle tactic on it as described below.

Effect: When you use the command on that card, it is not discarded but returns to your hand. Your opponent can check the information on it before it returns to your hand. The card goes back to being a normal battle tactic card, with the exception that you cannot use the command on it in the same phase it went back into your hand.

If you did not use the command on the card you separated, you can still score the battle tactic on it at the end of your turn as normal if you met its conditions. If you do so, discard it as normal. If you neither used the command nor scored the battle tactic on the ca
legend: Reading the flow of battle, a ranking Freeguilder dispatches an order that could well turn the tide in the Sigmarites’ favour.
condition: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round

name: IRONWELD DISCIPLINE
description:
Declare: Pick your Ironweld Great Cannon to use this ability.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, it can use the ‘Shoot’ ability as if it were your shooting phase.
legend: With nerves of steel, the crew of the Great Cannon prepare to fire even as enemies close in on all sides.
condition: Once Per Turn, Enemy Shooting Phase

name: BRAZIER OF HOLY FLAME
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly Freeguild Steelhelms unit within your general’s combat range.

Effect: You can return up to D3 slain models to that unit.
legend: The torch borne by this champion symbolises the light of civilisation being carried forth into the darkness of the wilds, a sacred act that emboldens those who march alongside them.

name: HEIRLOOM BLADE
description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of your general’s Master-forged Longsword.
legend: Wielded in countless battles, the edge of this blade is as keen as the day it was forged.

name: GLIMMERING
description: Effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, or 1 wound roll, or 1 save roll made for your general.
legend: The glinting facets of this tiny fragment of Mallus offer fleeting glimpses of the future.

name: TWIN-TAILED COMET OF HONOUR
description: Effect: While this unit has any champions, add 5 to this unit’s control score.
legend: Bearing one of the holiest symbols of Sigmar, this medal is awarded for exemplary acts of gallantry

name: THE LIVING CITY CROSS
description: Effect: While this unit has any champions, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.
legend: Having spent many years deployed in the wilds of Ghyran, this warrior has trained their troops to use camouflage and guerrilla-style survival techniques.

name: AQSHIAN ORDER OF MERIT
description: Effect: While this unit has any champions, if an enemy unit in combat with this unit uses the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability, when resolving attacks as part of that ability, on an unmodified hit roll of 6, do not inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on each unit in combat with that unit.
legend: Awarded to distinguished veterans of battle in the Realm of Fire, this medal marks out those who have protected their allies against Aqshy’s rage-inducing effects.

name: FORTIFY POSITION
description: Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target friendly CASTELITE units if they did not use a MOVE ability in the same turn.
legend: Heavy pavises are slammed into the dirt, forming a wall of oak and iron as strong as a fortification.

name: WELL PROVISIONED
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for that unit’s shooting attacks for the rest of the phase.
legend: This brigade has a quartermaster well versed in the art of keeping their troops, healthy, hale and supplied with plenty of arrows and blackpowder.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase

name: ADEPT TACTICIAN
description:
Declare: Pick 2 friendly Freeguild Fusiliers units that have been destroyed and have not already been replaced.

Effect: Set up a single replacement Freeguild Fusiliers unit with 10 models more than 6" from all enemy units.
legend: Assembling reinforcements into ad-hoe regiments is the hallmark of a seasoned, if a somewhat desperate, general.
condition: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase

name: BRACE!
description: Effect: Your general has WARD (5+).
legend: With a keen eye for incoming attacks, this Ogor Warhulk is adept at rebuffing any and all threats made towards the Fusil-Major riding atop its gun platform.

name: RESPECTED LEADER
description: Effect: Friendly Wildercorps Hunters units gain the REINFORCEMENTS keyword.
legend: On occasion, a brigade will attract more Wildercorps Hunters than normal, as word reaches their ears of a commander worthy of their loyalty.

name: SHIELD BASH
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy INFANTRY, WAR MACHINE or CAVALRY unit in combat with your general to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target must immediately use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were the enemy movement phase.
legend: With a bellow, the Ogor Warhulk drives their shield forward, forcing the enemy back.
condition: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase

name: POINT-BLANK VOLLEY
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
legend: A deadly round of shots are fired off at close range.
condition: Once Per Turn, Enemy Combat Phase

name: PIOUS VETERAN
description: Effect: Each time you pick targets while declaring a PRAYER ability used by a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR PRIEST, if this unit is eligible to be picked, you can pick it to be an additional target.
legend: The quiet strength of this warrior’s faith is such that tiny miracles manifest around them wherever they go

name: STENTORIAN GENERAL
description: Effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are in combat with any visible friendly units that are wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders.
legend: This hero’s bellowed threats are so intense that the enemy cowers before them.

name: ASTUTE TACTICIAN
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for the target and add 2 to run rolls for the target.
legend: This Sigmarite has spent as much time with their nose in military tomes as they have knee-deep in the spilled guts of their foes. Their erudition in the subject of battlefield manoeuvres is highly regarded.

name: BRISTLING ATTITUDE
description: Effect: Spend any number of rage dice. If your opponent’s fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, roll X dice, where X is the number of rage dice spent. For each 3+, subtract 1 from the charge roll.
legend: Many enemy assaults falter in the face of this general’s fiery yet determined resistance.
condition: Reaction: Opponent declared a <ky>Charge</ky> ability for a %000010532visible% unit within 12" of this unit

name: BELOVED LEADER
description: Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls applied by enemy abilities for attacks made by visible friendly units that are wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders.
legend: Such is the esteem in which this officer is held that their soldiers would march into the jaws of death without fear.

name: DRAW STEEL!
description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR HUMAN unit that charged this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
legend: With a bellow, the officar lunges into battle, and their troops follow them with as much steel in their hearts as they wield in their clenched fists.

name: COSMOPOLITAN LEADER
description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly non-WAR MACHINE SIGMARITE units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Spend 1 rage dice for each target. If your opponent’s fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, add 1 to wound rolls for each target’s combat attacks until the start of your next turn.
legend: This veteran has trained under and alongside soldiers from all walks of life across the Cities of Sigmar. Their knowledge of many different fighting styles and disciplines is a rare quality.

name: GRIZZLED DRILLMASTER
description: Effect: Other visible friendly units have WARD (6+) while they are wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders.
legend: This warrior is a grim-faced veteran who mercilessly drills regiments under their command, not out of cruelty but from a desire to ensure their survival.

name: COSMOPOLITAN LEADER
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR INFANTRY or CAVALRY unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. If this unit is HUMAN, pick up to 3 eligible units to be the targets instead.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn:
  • If the target is HUMAN, add 1 to wound rolls for t
legend: This officar has trained under and alongside all the myriad factions that dwell within the walls of the Cities of Sigmar. Their knowledge of many different fighting styles and disciplines is a rare quality.

name: PROTOTYPE ARCO-COMBUSTOR UNINHIBITOR
description:
Effect: For the rest of the turn:
  • Add 3" to this unit’s Move characteristic.
  • This unit can use SHOOT abilities even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn.
  • No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by RETREAT abilities.
legend: This device accelerates the burning of a Cogfort’s emberstone fuel, allowing sudden and shocking bursts of motion.
condition: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase

name: EMERGENCY BELLOWS
description: Effect: Remove 1 of this unit’s heat tokens.
legend: This cogwork mechanism pumps cool air into an overheating arco-combustor.

name: GRAPPLE-NET LAUNCHER
description:
Declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.

Effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
legend: This hull-mounted defensive device flings a steel-mesh net at onrushing foes, trapping them fast and nullifying their attacks.
condition: Once Per Battle, Enemy Combat Phase

name: HOLY AEGIS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 7+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each target in each phase.
legend: A shimmering barrier manifests around the beneficiary, dulling the impact of enemy attacks.

name: RECKONING OF SINNERS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with any of the targets.
legend: Searing oratory causes enemies to be stricken by the weight of the sins and outrages they have committed against the God-King’s folk.

name: BENEDICTION OF THE HIGH HEAVENS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick another visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Heal (D3) the target and the chanter. If the chanting roll was 7+, Heal (D3) each visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of the chanter instead.
legend: The priest beseeches Sigmar to rain down restorative blessings upon his faithful, seeing lacerations heal and broken bones reknit.

name: THROWING KNIVES
description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 10" of your general to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
legend: Jorvan Kreel has, over the course of his adventures, acquired an assortment of deadly blades ready to be hurled into a chest, stomach or skull.

name: RANGER DOCTRINES
description:
Used By: The unit using that FIGHT ability

Effect: Immediately after that FIGHT ability has been resolved, pick a point on the battlefield within 6" of your general. Remove the unit using this ability from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of that point and not in combat.
legend: Kreel was once a captain in the Wildercorps. While he now commands an eclectic assortment of forces, the fluid tactics he honed in his prior life can still be used to great effect.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a %000010870<ky>FIGHT</ky> ability% for your general or a friendly non-<ky>HERO</ky> unit wholly within 12" of your general

name: CLOSE-QUARTERS DRILL
description: Effect: Friendly units’ ranged weapons have Shoot in Combat but you must subtract 1 from hit rolls for their shooting attacks while they are in combat.
legend: Kreel has trained his Grenadiers to hold their fire until it can be unloaded right in their foes’ faces.

name: COME AND TAKE IT, BLAGGARDS!
description: Effect: Add 5 to the control scores of friendly non-HERO units while they are in combat with any enemy units that have 6 or more models or a Health characteristic of 3 or more.
legend: Though their city lies in ruin, these warriors defy any enemy who tries to prise the wreckage from them.

name: HOT-BLOODED ENDURANCE
description: Effect: Your general can use CHARGE abilities even if they used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn and no mortal damage is inflicted on them by RETREAT abilities.
legend: A lifetime spent in the wilderness has left Kreel an indefatigable warrior.

name: TRAINED RANGER
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge to be the target.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.
legend: The pathfinding skills he picked up in the jungles of the Charrwind Coast serve Kreel well in Embergard’s urban sprawl.
condition: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase

name: BLADE OF THE KRAKEN
description: Effect: Double the Attacks characteristic of your general’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
legend: In a decisive moment, Kreel fights ferociously to avenge Embergard’s fall – and also to maintain his warrior reputation…
condition: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

name: SPEED OF THE TWIN-TAILED COMET
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3" to the Move characteristic of friendly non-WAR MACHINE CITIES OF SIGMAR units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.
legend: Banners blaze with ethereal fire and trail comet-like contrails as the Freeguilders hurl themselves forward to meet the enemy.

name: CURSE OF SCORCHED METAL
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the first time the target uses an ATTACK ability, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for an attack made by the target as part of that ATTACK ability, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after the ATTACK ability has been resolved.
legend: The wizard causes the weapons of their foes to grow unbearably hot, searing their flesh to the bone.

name: HIGH STAR’S LIGHT
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
legend: The mage summons a simulacrum of Sigendil, the High Star of Azyr, to inspire their allies to the greatest heights of valour.

name: DUARDRAZHAL
description: Effect: Friendly DUARDIN ASCENDANT units are unified while they are wholly within 12" of at least 1 FYRESLAYERS, 1 KHARADRON OVERLORDS and 1 CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN unit.
legend: Grombrindal's goal is no less than the reunification of all the scattered, noble duardin nations.

name: TIRELESS PURPOSE
description: Effect: Each time a friendly DUARDIN ASCENDANT INFANTRY unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Normal Move' ability, add 2" to the distance that unit can move as part of that ability.
legend: This duardin lord shares Grombrindal's vision for their people, and their fervour is infectious.

name: VALAYAN HEARTH-BANNER
description:
Declare: Pick each friendly unified DUARDIN ASCENDANT unit on the battlefield to be the targets.

Effect: Heal (D3) each target.
legend: Wrought in the image of she who guards hold and hearth, this runic standard is a salve to even severe wounds - for those who believe.
condition: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase

name: SPIRIT OF THE WHITE DWARF
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly DUARDIN ASCENDANT PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly DUARDIN ASCENDANT unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: The target is unified until the start of your next turn. If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick 2 targets instead of 1.
legend: When Grombrindal takes the field, even the most sceptical Kharadron cannot help but feel a flicker of divine awe.

name: OATH OF RESTORATION
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly DUARDIN ASCENDANT PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible objective within 18" of them that is contested by 2 or more friendly unified units to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly DUARDIN ASCENDANT units have WARD
legend: All that which once belonged to the duardin will be theirs anew - so swear those who hold faith in Grombrindal.

name: 'AS THE ANCESTORS INTENDED!'
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unified DUARDIN ASCENDANT PRIEST to be the target.

Effect: Add 1 to chanting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
legend: To stand with far-flung kin in hours of crisis bolsters every duardin preacher.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

name: 'PAH! NOW THIS IS A SHOT...'
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unified DUARDIN ASCENDANT INFANTRY unit to be the target.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s ranged weapons for the rest of the turn .
legend: Duardin gunners of every creed never miss an opportunity to show their superior craft before their kin.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase

name: 'AS ONE, KINFOLK!'
description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly unified DUARDIN ASCENDANT INFANTRY units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the targets, to a maximum of 3.
legend: The children of the ancestor gods surge across the field as one mighty throng.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase

name: 'SETTLE EVERY GRUDGE! KHAZUK!'
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unified DUARDIN ASCENDANT INFANTRY unit to be the target.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
legend: When fighting as one, the duardin are a red-handed force of raw vengeance.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Comhat Phase

name: ENGINEER KIRSTA LOUDREN
description: Effect: If this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice for each visible unit (friendly and enemy) within its combat range. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
legend: Loudren is ferociously protective of her Cogfort’s arco-combustor and she would rather see it utterly destroyed than have it fall into unworthy hands.

name: THE CHANT OF IRON
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly IRON MARCH PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick either a visible enemy unit within 18" of them or a visible friendly IRON MARCH unit that is wholly within 12" of them and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If you picked an enemy unit:
  • If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible enemy unit to be a second target.
  • Subtract 2" from each target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.

If you picked a friendly unit,
legend: The alliance between Grungni the Maker and Sigmar the God-King is writ large upon the priest’s brow as divine creation and celestial wrath combine.

name: FORM UP, IRON MARCH!
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly IRON MARCH unit to use this ability, then pick either 1 or 2 other visible friendly IRON MARCH units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.

The unit using this ability and the targets:
  • cannot be under orders.
  • must each be a different unit type.

Effect: For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are under orders.

Designer’s Note: ‘Unit type’ refers to the name of the warscroll (Core Rules, 4.0), e.g. ‘Cannonade Cogfort<
legend: Once the order is given, Cogforts and infantry alike link up to form a fortress of flesh and steel that little can stand against.

name: CASTELLAN-CAPTAIN VYAN PHILSIN
description: Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly IRON MARCH INFANTRY units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders.
legend: Infamous for launching amphibious assaults on Kruleboyz camps in the swamps of Ghyran, those who board Philsin’s Cogfort are well versed in close combat.

name: BATTLE-PRIEST SOLANTRA WHYL
description: Effect: This unit has PRIEST (1).
legend: Whyl is a veteran battle-priest who suffered crippling injuries during a Skaven artillery barrage. Since then, she has strapped herself into any Cogfort willing to give her berth, using the titan as her mobile pulpit.

name: COMMODORE DE GRAÇON
description: Effect: This unit and up to 1 other friendly IRON MARCH WAR MACHINE within this unit’s combat range can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
legend: De Graçon is an intrepid commander known for her lightning raids on enemy positions. She has a reputation for burning through fuel at a fearsome pace.

name: ENGINEER GURREN ASHBROW
description: Effect: Each time this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.
legend: Ashbrow is one of the Ironweld’s most senior Cogfort experts. His tireless repairs are as ingenious as they are swift.

name: BROADMOORE AND LOUSE
description: Effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Crew’s Leadshotters. In addition, if this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, you can set up a Freeguild Marshal and Relic Envoy wholly within 6" of this unit and not in combat. That unit has the IRON MARCH keyword.
legend: The notoriously foul-tempered Marshal Hans Broadmoore and his downtrodden Relic Envoy Louse Renlik often ride to battle atop a Cogfort. Should foes attempt to board, the pair fight back fiercely with sabre and pistol.

name: ENGINEER BARTEL HOLST
description: Effect: This unit has WARD (6+) and STRIKE-LAST.
legend: Holst believes that a powerful defence is a Cogfort’s greatest boon. His war machine is clad in duardin-forged steel plate; to him, the Cogfort’s severely reduced manoeuvrability and speed is an acceptable cost.

name: CASTELLAN-CAPTAIN REGAN VANDERCLOUD
description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+:
  • Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
  • The target has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the turn.
legend: Vandercloud prefers to smash their Cogfort into the foe like a stone battering ram.

name: MASTER SAPPER GAVELOCK FISKE
description: Effect: This unit’s ranged weapons have Anti-FACTION TERRAIN (+1 Rend) and Anti-WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend).
legend: Whether directing the fire of a realmscorcher or the bombardment of a godbreaker cannon, Fiske can pinpoint the weak spot of any enemy fortification.

name: DEVOUT COMMANDER
description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic and the Rend characteristic of your general’s Master-forged Weapon.
legend: This faithful commander strikes with a ferocity born of utter conviction.

name: FERVENT RUSH
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability.

Effect: This unit can use CHARGE abilities this turn even if it used a RUN ability in the same turn.
legend: Singing righteous hymns and prepared to give their lives for the cause, these Sigmarites charge forward to battle.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase

name: SUDDEN AMBUSH
description: Effect: Set up this unit within 6" of an enemy unit and not in combat.
legend: The Whisperblade hides until it is the perfect moment to strike.

name: FIERCE ZEALOTS
description: Effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly Freeguild Steelhelms units.
legend: Should Zenestra demand it, these followers will fight tooth and nail for even the meanest patch of dirt.

name: LADY OF THE WHEEL
description: Effect: Each time a friendly model is slain by a combat attack, roll a number of dice equal to that model’s Health characteristic. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.
legend: Zenestra’s followers will defend her with a strength that can cow even a follower of the Dark Gods.

name: STAND FAST, COMRADES
description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly non-HERO unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target.

Effect: The target has WARD (4+) until the start of the next battle round.
legend: The general calls upon their soldiers to hold the line, no matter the cost and no matter the foe.
condition: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase

name: STEP TO IT!
description: Effect: Do not make a run roll as part of that RUN ability. Instead, add 6" to that non-HERO unit’s Move characteristic to determine the distance each model in that unit can move as part of that RUN ability
legend: The Marshal tells their men to heft their weapons and get moving!
condition: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared a <ky>Run</ky> ability for a non-<ky>Hero</ky> unit wholly within 12" of your general

name: ARDENT DEMAND
description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly non-HERO unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target.

Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.
legend: With a bellowed order, the Marshal ignites the passion and fury of the Freeguilders, and they lay into the enemy furiously.

name: CRIMSON DRAUGHT
description: Effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit.
legend: This vile mixture grants the drinker incredible bursts of speed. Fatal in all but the most controlled of doses, it is often 'gifted' to those whom Morathi is keeping an eye on.

name: DARKLING ELIXIR
description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
legend: Crafted from the blood of creatures best left unnamed, this wicked brew lends the imbiber’s outline a smoky, wispy appearance.

name: WITCHBREW
description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly non-UNIQUE DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.
legend: This holy potion drives the imbiber into such an ecstasy of destruction that they will fight on in the face of impossible odds.

name: GRACEFUL ELUSION
description: Effect: For the rest of the phase, friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY units have WARD (5+) until they have used a FIGHT ability.
legend: Years of combat in the gladiatorial arenas of the temple-cities have honed the survival skills of these aelves to near perfection.

name: FINAL FRENZY
