name: THE BLOOD REVEALS ALL
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly CRONESEER’S PARIAHS HERO within the combat range of a friendly empty CAULDRON OF BLOOD. Then, pick another unit within the combat range of that HERO to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. Allocate a number of damage points to the target equal to the roll (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). Then, that CAULDRON OF BLOOD becomes full.
legend: It matters not from which body the entrails are taken.
condition: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase

name: KHAINE’S INHERITOR
description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+:
  • Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
  • Halve the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.
legend: Those imbued with Khaine’s potent blood who survive the ordeal soon learn to wield that power as a weapon, causing waves of unbearable agony in their foes.

name: AMULET OF THE BLADED QUEEN
description: Effect: This unit has WARD (5+). Add 1 to save rolls for this unit.
legend: This prodigy has earned the blessing of Morathi-Khaine: a magnificent serpentine amulet through the goddess can both protect and keep a watchful eye on her subordinate.

name: MANIFESTATIONS OF MURDER
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly ZAINTHAR KAI WIZARD to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly MANIFESTATIONS below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
  • Bloodwrack Viper
  • Bladewind
  • Heart of Fury

Effect: If you picked a Bloodwrack Viper or Bladewind, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster,
legend: The wizard channels their power and calls one of the sacred manifestations of Khaine to the battlefield.

name: ETHEREAL GRACE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly ZAINTHAR KAI WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly ZAINTHAR KAI unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.
legend: The sorceress grants their fellow Scáthborn the swiftness of a fleeting shadow.

name: DARK MAJESTY
description: Effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack made by a non-HERO unit that targets the friendly Morathi-Khaine is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
legend: Morathi-Khaine’s charm, allure and sheer authority is near impossible to resist; to so much as raise a blade against such an exalted creature requires an effort of willpower beyond most mortals.

name: THE BLOOD SAINTS
description: Effect: While the friendly Shadow Queen is wholly within 6" of a friendly non-HERO ZAINTHAR KAI unit, both that Shadow Queen and that non-HERO unit have WARD (5+).
legend: As the first and most revered of the Scáthborn, the loyalty of these creatures towards Morathi-Khaine is ironclad.

name: ON WINGS OF SHADOW
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly ZAINTHAR KAI WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly ZAINTHAR KAI unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: With a flick of their wrist, the caster summons umbral tendrils that carry their allies away along paths unseen.

name: MATRIARCH OF THE ZAINTHAR KAI
description:
Declare: Pick the friendly Morathi-Khaine to use this ability.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:
  • Until the start of your next turn, this unit has a Move characteristic of 12" and has FLY.
  • This unit can use the ‘Iron Heart of Khaine’ ability as if you had performed a blood rite.
  • Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the turn, the target’s attacks cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).
  • Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE ZAINTHAR KAI HERO that has been destroyed to be the target. Set up a
legend: Surrounded by beings soul-crafted to be her perfect bodyguards, Morathi-Khaine can unleash her true power, safe in the knowledge that no jealous rival nor so-called ally will seek to do her harm.

name: SPEED OF THE SCÁTHBORN
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly ZAINTHAR KAI WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly ZAINTHAR KAI unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.
legend: The potential lurking in the blood of the Zainthar Kai can be unleashed with a sorcerous word.

name: CURSED HERITAGE
description:
Declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with any NON-UNIQUE ZAINTHAR KAI units to be the targets.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.
legend: Each Zainthar Kai warrior carries at least three drops of Khaine’s potent ichor in their veins, and they can call upon its simmering power to send boiling blood erupting from their foes’ eyes in an agonising torrent.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn

name: FATE SLICER
description: Effect: Gain 1 fate point if any models were slain by this unit this turn.
legend: This curving crystal blade can cut a victim’s soul from the tapestry of fate.

name: MUTATING BLADE
description: Effect: Pick 1 of this unit’s melee weapons. That weapon’s Attacks characteristic is 2D6 for the rest of the battle.
legend: An iridescent flamberge, an axe with nine edges, a lash ending in an eagle’stalon: the form of the bearer’s weapon constantly shifts, making its strikes impossible to predict.

name: TOME OF SCORCHED INSIGHT
description: Effect: Change the casting roll for that spell to a value of 12 that cannot be modified. That spell cannot be unbound and this unit cannot use that SPELL ability again for the rest of the battle.
legend: This book is a double-edged gift: it grants incredible arcane prowess but at a steep price, as the book slowly consumes the bearer’s own knowledge of magic.
condition: Reaction: You declared a non-<ky>Summon Spell</ky> ability for this unit

name: THE FIVE VERSES OF VOLARIAN
description: Effect: This unit has a Move characteristic of 14" and has FLY.
legend: Upon reciting these stanzas, the reader is granted the gift of flight. Some acquire a Disc of Tzeentch; others sprout iridescent wings; others still find themselves propelled through the aether by an invisible force.

name: ARCANE SIPHON
description:
Declare: Pick a visible MANIFESTATION (friendly or enemy) that was not set up this turn and is within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+:
  • The target is banished.
  • Heal (X) this unit, where X is the target’s Health characteristic.
legend: This enigmatic device can drain the animating force from nearby magical emanations and transmute it into a shimmering, rejuvenating tonic.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

name: CLOAKED IN WYRDFLAME
description: Effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target this unit.
legend: The bearer is engulfed in a wyrdflame blaze so intense that enemies shrink before it.

name: SPELL-CATCHER AMULET
description:
Declare: This unit can use this ability if any enemy MANIFESTATIONS were banished this phase.

Effect: This unit can use a SUMMON ability from the manifestation lore you picked during army composition. That SUMMON ability does not count towards the total number of SPELL or BANISH abilities this unit can use this phase.
legend: This amulet, in the shape of an unblinking eye, devours the residual energies of arcane manifestations that have been unravelled, re-imagining them in forms more pleasing to the Changer of the Ways.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

name: THE SEARING EYE
description:
Effect: Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent’s fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, roll a dice. If the roll is the same as any of the dice in the casting roll, that spell is miscast. Otherwise, add the roll to the casting roll.
legend: This unblinking orb is said to be the eye of a Lord of Change, its purpose as much to spy on potential rivals as to reward minions with foresight of future events.
condition: Reaction: You declared a <ky>Spell</ky> ability for a %000006191Disciples of Tzeentch% unit wholly within 12" of this unit

name: KAIRIC TOME
description: Effect: Add 1 to or subtract 1 from the casting roll for that spell. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per SPELL ability.
legend: Said to be penned by the Fateweaver himself, this tome is filled with all manner of eldritch secrets.
condition: Reaction: You declared a <ky>SPELL</ky> ability for a <ky>DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH</ky> unit wholly within 6" of this unit

name: COMETH THE HOUR
description: Effect: If you make a charge roll of 9+ for a friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
legend: As moment of preordained glory, these warriors attack with renewed zeal.

name: INEVITABLE ENDING
description:
Declare: Pick a unit (friendly or enemy) to be the target.

Effect: If the target is destroyed this turn, gain 1 fate point.
legend: It is the duty of some simply to die, for their lifeblood will grease the ever‑turning cogs of fate.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn

name: TWIST OF FATE
description:
Effect: Each time a friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH unit uses an ability that requires you to spend 1 or more fate points, after that ability has been resolved, roll a dice. On a 4+, gain 1 fate point.

If you remove 1 or more damage points from the damage pool of a friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH unit as a result of the ‘Destined to Serve’ ability, after the damage sequence for that unit has been resolved, roll a dice. On a 4+, gain 1 fate point.
legend: Those who dwell within the Silver Towers are suffused by an aura of fate‑altering magic.

name: SORCERERS OF WAR
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD that is in combat to be the target.

Effect: The target can use a non-SUMMON SPELL ability as if it were your hero phase, but only the caster or enemy units in combat with the caster can be picked to be the targets of that SPELL ability.
legend: These champions of Tzeentch bring the fires of change directly to their god’s foes, revelling in the infinite fractals of fate that spiral from the madness of a melee.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase

name: HIDEOUS UNPREDICTABILITY
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is masked by illusion to be the target.

Effect: Set up the target wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: Tzeentch’s strange blessings allow his malformed servants to outmanoeuvre and outflank their prey.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase

name: SYMBIOTIC MADNESS
description: Effect: Friendly ARCANITE units’ melee weapons have Crit (2 Hits) while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON unit.
legend: Arcanites who battle alongside the daemons of their manipulative deity receive maddening glimpses of the twisting strands of fate, allowing them to take advantage of fleeting gaps in their foes’ defences in the press of combat.

name: ELDRITCH ILLUSIONS
description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-MONSTER DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH units on the battlefield to be the targets.

Effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up in reserve masked by illusion.

Friendly units that are masked by illusion are destroyed at the end of the fifth battle round and not at the start of the fourth battle round.
legend: The Disciples of Tzeentch delight in spreading confusion amongst their foes with cunningly woven glamours.

name: SMOKE AND MIRRORS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-MONSTER DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH unit that was not set up on the battlefield this turn and was not set up on the battlefield using this ability in the previous turn to be the target, then pick a friendly unit that is masked by illusion to be the substitute.

Effect: Set up the substitute wholly within 6" of the target and not in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and set it up in reserve masked by illusion.
legend: With sudden and terrible clarity, Tzeentch’s foes realise they have been fighting the wrong enemy all along.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase

name: SILVER SIMULACRUM
description:
Effect: If there is a friendly Argent Shard on the battlefield, you can set up 1 additional Argent Shard on the battlefield. It must be set up wholly within friendly territory and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.

Designer’s Note: The original Argent Shard is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability. This ability allows you to set up a second such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.
legend: Like some amorphous organism, an Argent Shard splits in two to double its arcane potency.

name: ALL PART OF THE PLAN
description:
Effect: You start the battle with 0 fate points. You can have a maximum of 9 fate points.
Gain 1 fate point each time:
  • You lose the priority roll.
  • A spell cast by a friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH unit is unbound.
  • A friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH unit miscasts a spell.
  • Your opponent gains control of an objective that you controlled at the start of the turn.
  • A friendly Argent Shard is demolished.
legend: Tzeentch is all-seeing and all-knowing, and even setbacks may ultimately serve his destined ends.

name: DESTINED TO SERVE
description: Effect: Before allocating damage points to a friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH unit, you can spend any number of fate points. For each fate point you spend, remove 1 damage point in that unit’s damage pool.
legend: Those chosen by the Change God are not permitted to fall until they have served their fated purpose.

name: DESTINED ARCANA
description:
Used By: The unit using that SPELL ability.

Effect: Spend any number of fate points. For each fate point you spend, add 1 to the casting roll for that spell.
legend: Tzeentch imbues the spell with a fraction of his limitless arcane might.
condition: Reaction: You declared a <ky>SPELL</ky> ability for a <ky>DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH</ky> unit

name: DESTINED FOR BATTLE
description:
Used By: The unit using that CHARGE ability.

Effect: Spend any number of fate points. For each fate point you spend, add 1 to the charge roll for that CHARGE ability.
legend: Hand-to-hand combat is a crude pursuit, but it has its uses.
condition: Reaction: You declared a <ky>CHARGE</ky> ability for a <ky>DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH</ky> unit in your turn

name: SPELL-EATER PENDANT
description: Effect: Each time this unit unbinds a spell or banishes an enemy MANIFESTATION, gain 1 fate point.
legend: This amulet devours magic and channels it to empower its bearer.

name: CALL OF ANARCHY
description:
Declare: Pick a terrain feature within 18" of this unit, then pick a friendly non-HERO CHANGE-CULT unit that is masked by illusion or that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: If you picked a unit that is masked by illusion, set it up wholly within 3" of that terrain feature and more than 6" from all enemy units.

If you picked a unit that has been destroyed, set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 3" of that terrain feature and more than 6" from all enemy units.

Designer’s Note: Units can be set up in
legend: As the uprising swells, its architect calls forth more cultists to join the anarchy.

name: SILVER SIMULACRUM
description:
Effect: If there is a friendly Argent Shard on the battlefield, you can set up 1 additional Argent Shard on the battlefield. It must be set up wholly within friendly territory and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.

Designer’s Note: The original Argent Shard is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability. This ability allows you to set up a second such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.
legend: Like some amorphous organism, an Argent Shard splits in two to double its arcane potency.

name: SHIFTING MANIFESTATIONS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly CHANGE-CULT WIZARD to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly MANIFESTATIONS below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
  • Burning Sigil of Tzeentch
  • Daemonic Simulacrum
  • Tome of Eyes

Effect: If there is already a friendly MANIFESTATION from the list above on the battlefield, it is immediately banished and removed from play. Then,
legend: In the blink of an eye, the caster banishes one manifestation and uses its power to bring forth another.

name: ELDRITCH STRENGTH
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly CHANGE-CULT WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly CHANGE-CULT unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.
legend: The caster imbues their minions with supernatural might.

name: ILLUSORY INFILTRATION
description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-reinforced CHANGE-CULT Kairic Acolytes units to be the targets.

Effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and not in combat.
legend: Cunning glamours conceal the advance of Kairic cultists.

name: PUPPET ON A STRING
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy HERO within 24" of and visible to a friendly CHANGE-CULT HERO to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, each time the target uses a CORE ability, gain 1 fate point.

Designer’s Note: You can only gain fate points using this ability and the ‘Spell-eater Pendant’ ability.
legend: Whether they know it or not, the enemy hero serves the will of Tzeentch.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase

name: OVERTAKEN BY EVENTS
description:
Declare: Spend 1 fate point. Then, pick an enemy unit within 24" of and visible to a friendly CHANGE-CULT HERO to be the target.

Effect: The target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
legend: Stricken by indecision, the enemy’s leader flails helplessly.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase

name: SEEDS OF DISCORD
description:
Declare: Spend 1 fate point. Then, pick an enemy model within 24" of and visible to a friendly CHANGE-CULT HERO to be the target, then pick another enemy unit within the target’s combat range to be the victim.

Effect: Pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons. Immediately resolve combat attacks for the target made with that weapon against the victim.
legend: Cunning lies and misdirections cause infighting amongst the foe.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

name: SHIELD OF FATE
description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 18" of your general, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: On a 6+, until the start of your next turn, that unit has WARD (6+). If that unit already has a ward save, add 1 to ward rolls for that unit until the start of your next turn instead.
legend: There is little better protection than to be guided by destiny itself.

name: MASTERS OF DESTINY
description:
Effect: Roll 9 dice and put them to one side. These are your destiny dice. During the battle, instead of rolling the dice for 1 of the rolls from the list below, you can pick one of your destiny dice and use it as the roll. Once a destiny dice has been used, it is discarded.

If you want to replace a roll that uses more than one D6, you must use the same number of destiny dice (e.g. you would need to use 2 destiny dice in place of a 2D6 casting roll). Rolls that are replaced count as unmodified rolls and cannot be re-rolled or modified unless noted.

The following rolls can be replaced with destiny dice:
  • Casting rolls
  • Run rolls
  • Charge rolls
  • Hit rolls
  • Wound rolls
  • Save rolls – you must still modify the roll by the Rend characteristic of the attacking weapon.
legend: To serve the Changer of the Ways is to instinctively understand the ebb and flow of future events and manipulate them at will.
condition: Once per Battle, Start of the First Battle Round

name: TRANSIENT FORMS
description: Effect: Roll a dice each time a friendly Kairic Acolytes model is slain in the combat phase. On a 4+, you can return 1 slain model to a friendly Tzaangors unit within 9" of the slain model.
legend: Some Kairic Acolytes actively seek transformation into Tzaangors, whom they revere as beings closer in nature to their mercurial deity.

name: GLIMPSE THE FUTURE
description:
Declare: If you have fewer than 6 destiny dice, make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: On a 7+, you can roll a dice and add it to your destiny dice.
legend: By focusing on the skeins of potential fates, the sorcerer can glean hints of future events in time to manipulate them.

name: ETERNAL CONFLAGRATION
description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of ranged weapons used by friendly Flamers of Tzeentch units.
legend: Some cults of Tzeentch seek to set the very cosmos aflame with the ever-burning fires of change.

name: DAEMONHEART
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit within 1" of your general.

Effect: Inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the number of the current battle round.
legend: Through a dark ritual, the heart of a daemon dwells within your general’s chest, where its dread power can be unleashed to greatly augment the strength of its host.
condition: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

name: TIMESLIP PENDANT
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit within 9" of your general.

Effect: That unit has STRIKE-LAST this phase.
legend: Time is a mutable concept to the bearer of this amulet.
condition: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

name: SILVER SUMMONER
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-WARFLOCK ARCANITE unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) more than 9" from all enemy units and wholly within 12" of a friendly Argent Shard that is visible to this unit.
legend: This hero can channel an Argent Shard’s eldritch power to create uncanny simulacra of fallen warriors.

name: GRAND ILLUSIONIST
description: Effect: If this unit was set up this turn, it can move D3". That move cannot pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.
legend: This hero is a supreme mountebank, able to fabricate convincing illusions that allow them to slip away undetected.

name: DEVOLVING AURA
description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if any damage points were allocated to the target this phase. On a 3+, the target has a maximum control score of 1 until the start of your next turn.
legend: Enemies that stray close to this hero are stricken by hideous malformations.

name: SUMMON BURNING SIGIL OF TZEENTCH
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Burning Sigil of Tzeentch on the battlefield, pick a friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Burning Sigil of Tzeentch wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.
legend: Brief incantations in the Dark Tongue see these burning symbols of worship spark into reality.

name: SUMMON DAEMONIC SIMULACRUM
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Daemonic Simulacrum on the battlefield, pick a friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD To cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Daemonic Simulacrum wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: The wizard draws upon their understanding of change-lore to create a temporary portal for this mirage to enter the fray.

name: SUMMON TOME OF EYES
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Tome of Eyes on the battlefield, pick a friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Tome of Eyes wholly within 18" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: With a snap of the conjurer’s fingers, the Tome appears at their side from a spark of blue wyrdflame.

name: WYRDFLAME BARRAGE:
description:
Effect: When picking targets for shooting attacks made by friendly units with weapons that have the Wyrdflame weapon ability, you can also pick terrain features that are visible to and within range of the attacking model to be targets. Non FACTION TERRAIN terrain features are considered to have a Save characteristic of 5+ and infinite Health for the purposes of this ability.

If any damage points were allocated to a terrain feature by those attacks, after the SHOOT ability has been resolved, roll a dice. If the result is less than or equal to the number of damage points allocated to that terrain feature in this phase, it has the WYRDPY
legend: Tzeentchian fire consumes stone and metal as voraciously as it does living  flesh, swiftly burning foes out of cover.

name: Summon Burning Sigil of Tzeentch
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly PYROFANE WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Burning Sigil of Tzeentch wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.
legend: Brief incantations in the Dark Tongue see these burning symbols of worship spark into reality.

name: WYRDFLAME AEGIS
description: Effect: You can ignore mortal damage inflicted on this unit by the 'Immolation of the Realms' ability, and if damage would have been inflicted upon it by that ability, the persisting effects from that ability apply to it as though it had been allocated damage by the ability.
legend: Wreathed in a cloak of shifting flame, this champion can stride without care into the heart of the inferno.

name: PYROFLUX CONDUIT
description:
Declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is within 3" of a WYRDPYRE terrain feature. You can pick another friendly PYROFANE unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield, then set it up again wholly within 9" of a WYRDPYRE terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, if you picked a target, remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 9" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: This pulsing sliver of crimson crystal allows the bearer and a chosen few allies to leap between gouts of flame.
condition: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase

name: FLAMING WEAPON
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly PYROFANE WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly PYROFANE HERO wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of2D6.

Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
legend: A sorcerous athame is already a potent weapon, but doubly so when wreathed in angry flames.

name: HIDDEN INSTIGATOR
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD to use this ability if it has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up that unit in reserve hidden among cultists. It has now been deployed. Friendly units that are hidden among cultists are not automatically destroyed at the start of the fourth battle round.
legend: The arcane agents of the Pyrofane Cult conceal themselves until the moment is  right to spark the inferno.

name: SUMMON CULT LEADER
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly PYROFANE WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a friendly WIZARD that has been destroyed to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target in reserve hidden among cultists.
legend: Misdirection potent weapons of the Pyrofane Cult, ensuring their masters have free rein to control the battlefield.

name: BURNING ANGUISH
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly PYROFANE WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them and which had any damage points allocated to it this battle round by the ’Immolation of the Realms’ ability to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target cannot use commands for the rest of the battle round.
legend: A sudden eruption of white-hot, burning agony is enough to dissuade enemy leaders from rallying their troops.

name: DECEPTION REVEALED
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly PYROFANE WIZARD that is hidden among cultists to use this ability, then pick a friendly PYROFANE INFANTRY unit with 3 or more models to be the target.

Effect: Set up that WIZARD within the combat range of the target. It can be set up in combat. In addition, if that WIZARD uses the ’Magical Intervention’ command this phase, no command points are spent to do so.
legend: When the servants of the Arch-Manipulator reveal their schemes, it is already too late for their victims.

name: RALLY THE WARCLANS
description:
Declare: Pick an objective being contested by any friendly Kairic Acolyte units to be the target.

Effect: The target objective has the WYRDPYRE keyword for the rest of the battle.
legend: As spiteful as they are insane, Kairic Acolytes of the Pyrof ane Cult would rather burn than give up an inch of ground.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

name: POSSESSED BY THE POWER OF THE WAAAGH!
description:
Declare: You must use this ability at the start of the battle round if there are WYRDPYRES on the battlefield.

Effect: Resolve the effect below that corresponds to the number of WYRDPYRES on the battlefield:

1-2: Inflict 1 mortal damage on each unit within 3" of any WYRDPYRES. Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly units that were allocated any of that damage for the rest of the battle round.

3-4: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit within 3" of any WYRDPYRES. Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly units that were allocated any of that damage for the rest of the battle round.

5-6: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit within 6" of any WYRDPYRES. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by fri
legend: The pyromaniacs of the Cult would gladly watch Tzeentch's sorcerous flames spread to consume the realms entire.
condition: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round

name: INFERNAL GATEWAY
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll either 5 dice or a number of dice equal to the number of fate points you have. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
legend: The sorcerer opens a portal to the Realm of Chaos, pulling enemies to their doom.

name: BOLT OF TZEENTCH
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.
legend: This spell manifests as a prismatic beam of raw magic that tears its victims apart in a display of multispectral colour.

name: FOLD REALITY
description:
Declare: Pick a DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD to cast this spell, then you can pick a friendly non-MONSTER DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH unit wholly within 12" of the caster to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set the target up in reserve masked by illusion. Then, you can pick a friendly unit that is masked by illusion</
legend: The sorcerer contorts the very fabric of the cosmos, allowing their minions to slip from hither to thither in an eye-blink.

name: WYRDFLAME HAZE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly DISCIPLES OF TEENTCH units are not visible to enemy units more than 12" from them while those friendly units are wholly within 12" of a friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH unit that was set up in the same turn.
legend: The caster causes the smoke from arcane blazes to linger on the battlefield, obscuring those lurking within.

name: SHIELD OF FATE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:
  • The target has WARD (5+).
  • Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit.
legend: There is little better protection than to be guided by destiny itself and to be defended by the very hand of fate.

name: TRANSFORMED TO SPAWN
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If any models are slain by this ability, you can pick a friendly Chaos Spawn of Tzeentch unit that is masked by illusion and set it up on the battlefield
legend: Tzeentch is the Changer of the Ways; to be in the presence of his minions risks being mutated into a Chaos Spawn.

name: MASTERS OF DESTINY
description:
Effect: Roll 9 dice and place them to one side. These are your destiny dice. Destiny dice can be spent during the battle to change certain dice rolls. You can never have more than 9 destiny dice at once.

During the battle, instead of making a roll from the list below for a friendly ORACLES OF FATE unit, you can spend your destiny dice. The roll you would have made is replaced with the roll on the destiny dice you spend. If you want to replace a 2D6 roll, 3D6 roll, etc. you must spend a number of destiny dice equal to the number before ‘D6’. Any rolls that have been replaced count as unmodified rolls, and they cannot be re-rolled or modified by other friendly abilities except for those that apply negative modifiers (but they can be modified by enemy abilities)
legend: To serve the Changer of the Ways is to instinctively understand the ebb and flow of future events and be able to manipulate their potential to the fullest.

name: SHIFTING MANIFESTATIONS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly ORACLES OF FATE WIZARD to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly MANIFESTATIONS below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
  • Burning Sigil of Tzeentch
  • Daemonic Simulacrum
  • Tome of Eyes

Effect: If there is already a friendly MANIFESTATION from the list above on the battlefield, it is immediate
legend: In the blink of an eye, the caster banishes one manifestation and uses its power to bring forth another.

name: FATEWEAVER’S GIFT
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly ORACLES OF FATE WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:

Change the Past: Pick an enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the caster, that is in combat and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target. Roll either 4 dice or a number of dice equal to the number of unspent destiny dice you have. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

Seize the Present: Until the
legend: Kairos can bestow his extraordinary insight into the past and future upon those he considers worthy.

name: NEXUS OF FATE
description: Effect: Roll a dice. If you have 9 unspent destiny dice, you must replace 1 of your destiny dice with that roll. Otherwise, place that dice to one side as a destiny dice.
legend: Tzeentch’s favoured servants manipulate what mortals consider ‘destiny’ as if it were a puppet.

name: CORRUPTED LEYSTONE
description: Effect: If this unit is contesting an objective, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again contesting an objective and more than 7" from all enemy units.
legend: This obsidian stone is attuned to sites of arcane power, allowing the bearer to teleport between ley lines.

name: NINEFOLD BLESSINGS
description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if the total value of your unspent destiny dice is exactly 9.

Effect: Re-roll all of your unspent destiny dice. Then, until the start of your next turn:
  • Friendly ORACLES OF FATE units have WARD (5+).
  • Subtract 1 from save rolls for enemy units.

Designer’s Note: Add together the values shown on each unspent destiny dice to find the total value.
legend: Nine is the sacred number of Tzeentch and presages great victories and glories for his servants.
condition: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Your Turn

name: PREDICTED STRIKE
description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general and that is not in combat to be the target.

Effect: The target can move D6". It cannot move through the combat ranges of enemy units or end that move in combat.
legend: Few seers are more accomplished when it comes to predicting an enemy’s movements.
condition: Once Per Battle, Enemy Movement Phase

name: FATED ARRIVAL
description: Effect: Set up this unit wholly within friendly territory, within 1" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.
legend: Followers of Tzeentch ride the waves of fate to ultimate victory.

name: CONSTANT FLUX
description: Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target friendly units while you are the underdog.
legend: Tzeentch’s plans often involve elements of self-sabotage to achieve the final goal.

name: PREDICT THE FUTURE
description: Effect: You can look at up to 3 cards from the top of your battle tactic deck without adding them to your hand. Then, in any order, return each card face down to either the top or the bottom of your battle tactic deck.
legend: Foresighted is forearmed, as the old saying goes.

name: ARCANE RITUALISTS
description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for your general while they are wholly within 6" of another friendly unit.
legend: This host specialises in esoterically gruesome sorcerous rituals.

name: INFERNAL GATEWAY
description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of your general to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: On a 5+, roll either 3 dice or a number of dice equal to the number of battle tactic cards you have discarded this battle. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
legend: The sorcerer opens a portal to the Realm of Chaos, pulling enemies to their doom.

name: FOLD REALITY
description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: On a 6+, remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of your general and more than 6" from all enemy units.
legend: The sorcerer contorts the very fabric of the cosmos, allowing their minions to slip from hither to thither in an eye-blink.

name: CHEAT DESTINY
description: Effect: Instead of discarding that card, return it face down to the bottom of your battle tactic deck.
legend: Can destiny truly be deceived, or are we pulled by strings we cannot see?
condition: Reaction: You used a command on a battle tactic card

name: MUTAGENIC SORCERY
description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of your general to be the enemy target. Then, pick a friendly Tzaangors unit in combat with the enemy target to be the friendly target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+:
  • Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the enemy target equal to the roll.
  • You can return 1 slain model to the friendly target.
legend: As warriors fall around the Tzaangors, some mutate to become the creature that struck them down.

name: VISION OF DEFIANT SUPREMACY
description: Effect: If you won the priority roll this battle round and chose for your opponent to take the first turn or if your opponent seized the initiative this battle round, this unit has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.
legend: As the tide of battle turns, you and your brethren will find yourselves in the thick of the fighting, but you will have the upper hand.
condition: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase

name: VISION OF DESTINED CONQUEST
description:
Effect: If this unit is contesting an objective that you control that is wholly outside friendly territory:
  • If you are the underdog, gain 1 fate point for each command point you have.
  • If you are not the underdog, roll a dice for each command point you have. For each 3+, gain 1 fate point.
legend: The winds of fate will blow strong as you and your warriors overrun a site of import deep in enemy lands.
condition: Once Per Battle, Start of Your Turn

name: VISION OF ARCANE SACRIFICE
description:
Effect: While units (friendly or enemy) are within 6" of this unit:
  • Add 1 to unbinding rolls for those units.
  • Spells cast by those units are miscast on an unmodified casting roll of 4 or less.
The first time this unit is destroyed, gain D6 fate points.
legend: All around you, incantations will wither on lips and spells will backfire catastrophically – until the moment of your fated demise.

name: SUMMON SOULSNARE SHACKLES
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Soulsnare Shackles endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Soulsnare Shackles endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulsnare Shackles endless spell has 3 parts that must each be set up within 3" of at least 1 other part.
legend: Decrepit chains clatter and rusted manacles grind as the Soulsnare Shackles snap at their prey, seeking to clamp down on the spirits of their victims so that they can drag them back to the Great Oubliette in Shyish.

name: SUMMON BURNING HEAD
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly The Burning Head on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up The Burning Head wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: Formed from the fires of Aqshy, the Burning Head manifests as a blazing skull that scorches its way across the battlefield. Ranks of troops are incinerated and the rickety frames of war engines set ablaze by its passing.

name: SUMMON GEMINIDS OF UHL-GYSH
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.
legend: Drawn from the twilight demi-realm between Hysh and Ulgu, the Geminids lash out with the raw magic of light and shadow, scouring flesh while filling minds with horrific lies and unbearable truths.

name: SUMMON KRONDSPINE INCARNATE OF GHUR
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: Those incarnates first encountered in the Krondspine Range of Ghur are terrifying entities, creations of bestial energy protected by monstrous bones and guided by ferocious intellect. Like all things of the Realm of Beasts, they are driven by the laws of predator and prey – and as thaumaphages, they prey upon other manifestations that roam the realm.

name: SUMMON SOULSCREAM BRIDGE
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Soulscream Bridge on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Soulscream Bridge wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulscream Bridge has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.
legend: A nightmarish fusion of bone and tortured spirit-stuff, a Soulscream Bridge disintegrates and consumes the souls of the fallen in order to tear open a makeshift pathway across reality.

name: SUMMON CHRONOMANTIC COGS
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Chronomantic Cogs endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Chronomantic Cogs endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.
legend: Like the procession of the heavens, the rotations of the Chronomantic Cogs control the passage of time, allowing wizards to speed or slow the events that are unfolding around them.

name: SUMMON AETHERVOID PENDULUM
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Aethervoid Pendulum on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up an Aethervoid Pendulum wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: Sweeping suddenly into existence like a reaper’s blade, the Aethervoid Pendulum cuts through armour, flesh and even the fabric of the realms themselves.

name: SUMMON EMERALD LIFESWARM
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Emerald Lifeswarm on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up an Emerald Lifeswarm wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: Imbued with the healing powers of Ghyran, an Emerald Lifeswarm buzzes across the battlefield, seeking out the dead and dying and restoring their lives and vigour.

name: SUMMON LAUCHON THE SOULSEEKER
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Lauchon the Soulseeker on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Lauchon the Soulseeker wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: The splintered echo of an ancient underworld deity, Lauchon the Soulseeker sails the swirling tides of death, drawn by the lure of powerful spirits. Spellcasters can join his macabre odyssey, if they are willing to offer a fitting sacrifice.

name: SUMMON PRISMATIC PALISADE
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Prismatic Palisade on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Prismatic Palisade wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.
legend: The crystalline spars of the Prismatic Palisade are formed of pure light and hardened into a barrier that bathes those on the battlefield in the blinding rays of Hysh.

name: SUMMON MALEVOLENT MAELSTROM
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Malevolent Maelstrom on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Malevolent Maelstrom wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: A Malevolent Maelstrom is a swirling vortex of Shyishan magic, a tempest that sucks in sorcerous energies and the souls of the dead before exploding in a cataclysmic nova.

name: SUMMON RAVENAK’S GNASHING JAWS
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Ravenak’s Gnashing Jaws endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Ravenak’s Gnashing Jaws endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: Savage, unrelenting and eternally hungry, the spell known as Ravenak’s Gnashing Jaws is born from the essence of Ghur’s hunger and is capable of chomping through rank after rank of foes.

name: SUMMON UMBRAL SPELLPORTAL
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Umbral Spellportal on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up an Umbral Spellportal wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. An Umbral Spellportal has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.
legend: Comprising a pair of shadowy mirrors, the Umbral Spellportal links two points on the battlefield, allowing wizards to cast their destructive magics and enchanting boons at a distance.

name: SUMMON QUICKSILVER SWORDS
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Quicksilver Swords endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Quicksilver Swords endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: Borne aloft on currents of Chamonic energy, the Quicksilver Swords fly across the battlefield in tight formations before fanning out to eviscerate and behead those in their path.

name: SUMMON HORRORGHAST
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Horrorghast on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Horrorghast wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: Arcane predators that feast upon fear, Horrorghasts haunt the deathly wilds of Shyish, taking on the appearance of whatever will most terrorise their prey – most often the pitiless gaze of Nagash, the Great Necromancer.

name: SUMMON PURPLE SUN OF SHYISH
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Purple Sun of Shyish on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Purple Sun of Shyish wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: No spell inspires greater fear in the beholder than the Purple Sun of Shyish. The skull-faced orb drifts across the battlefield, its rays of death energy transmuting all they touch into amethyst statues.

name: SUMMON SHARDS OF VALAGHARR
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Shards of Valagharr endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Shards of Valagharr endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Shards of Valagharr endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.
legend: As these pairs of cracked prisms of black stone orbit the battlefield, necromantic energy spills from their breached surfaces in a sickening stream, sapping the spirit and life force of all those they pass over.

name: SUMMON SUFFOCATING GRAVETIDE
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Suffocating Gravetide on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Suffocating Gravetide wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: The spirits of the dead rise from the ground and surge forwards in a Suffocating Gravetide to smother the living, burying their victims and dragging their souls down to the Realm of Death.

name: THE SPLINTERED FEMUR
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, pick 1 of the following:
  • Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
  • Subtract 1 from the target’s power level, to a minimum of 0, until the start of your next turn.
  • If the target is a MANIFESTATION, it is banished and removed from play.
legend: A venerated relic of the infamous Spell-eater Queen, this club can easily break not only limbs but also the arcane.

name: FOOL’S CAP
description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent’s fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, for the rest of the turn:
  • Add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
  • Each time the target uses a CHARGE ability, if possible, it must end the charge move within 1/2" of this unit.
  • While the target is in combat with this unit, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks that do not target this unit.
legend: This warrior has manipulated the bones of a Mancrusher Gargant’s skeletal hand into the shape of a jester’s hat. Prancing about with it on their head ensures they acquire an audience…

name: FLAYED FLAGS
description:
Declare: Pick an objective you do not control within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, when resolving the damage sequence for enemy units contesting the target objective, your opponent cannot spend rage dice as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability
legend: When these mighty banners are unfurled in the name of Ushoran, foes find themselves losing heart. Mostly because they are made of rotting skin.

name: CHARNEL VESTMENTS
description: Effect: If this unit is not a PRIEST, it has PRIEST (1). If this unit is already a PRIEST, add 1 to chanting rolls for this unit. If this unit is a WIZARD, it cannot use SPELL abilities and PRAYER abilities in the same phase.
legend: Strips of flayed skin and crudely stitched sinew form a gruesome parody of priestly robes.

name: THE GRISLY PENNANT
description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is greater than the target’s Control characteristic or is a 6, the following effects apply for the rest of the turn:
  • Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
  • Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly units that target that enemy unit.
legend: This raggedy flag of flesh, recently torn from an unfortunate victim, is an icon of purity and nobility to the cannibal army but a terrifying spectacle to their enemies.

name: RING OF NIGHTMARISH VISIONS
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to your fury level. Add 1 to each roll if this unit charged this turn. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
legend: This ring enhances the wearer’s delusion, twisting foes into even more hideous monsters that they attack in a rabid frenzy.

name: RAISE THE BANNERS
description: Effect: Each time another ability returns at least 1 slain model to a friendly unit that is not in combat, after that ability has been resolved, if that unit is a SERFS unit, you can return 1 additional slain model to it, and if it is a KNIGHTS unit, roll a dice. On a 4+, you can return 1 additional slain model to it.
legend: When an abhorrant royal family and their courtiers mass, many loyal knights and serfs inevitably follow.

name: INDULGE, MY PRETTIES
description:
Effect: While a friendly non-HERO FLESH-EATER COURTS MONSTER or BEAST is wholly within 12" of any friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES:
  • That non-HERO unit can use a RAMPAGE ability on its warscroll even if that ability has already been used by another friendly MONSTER in the same turn.
  • If that non-HERO unit charged in the same
legend: Abhorrants often toss their pet monstrosities choice cuts of flesh, resulting in a burst of strength and ferocity.

name: SOUND THE CHARGE
description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly KNIGHTS that charged in the same turn while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES.
legend: Those foolish enough to stand before the cannibal courts’ knights are inevitably trampled beneath claw and foot.

name: LIKE SNAPPING HOUNDS
description:
Declare: Pick each friendly SERFS unit in combat to be the targets.

Effect: For each target:
  • Make a pile-in move.
  • Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
legend: When a noble commences a hunt, packs of serfs are sent ahead of the royal houses to savage prey out of hiding.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

name: OVERWHELMING HORDES
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SERFS unit that did not charge this turn and is in combat to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with that SERFS unit to be the target.

Effect: The target cannot make pile-in moves for the rest of the turn.
legend: As masses of crazed ghouls drag their foes to the ground, the horror and anger of the victims’ allies shifts into a disorienting delusion that leaves them paralysed by indecision.

name: THE BLESSING OF THE CHALICE
description: Effect: Friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES have WARD (5+) if they have destroyed a unit this battle.
legend: Eager to earn favour with their masters, the heroes compete to earn honourable trophies for their court.

name: A KINGDOM DELUDED
description:
Declare: You must use this ability at the start of each turn. If it is the first turn of the battle, pick a DELUSION from these battle traits or, unless otherwise specified, from the warscroll of a friendly unit on the battlefield. If it is not the first turn, make a delusion roll of D6.

Effect: On a delusion roll of 1-2, you must pick a different DELUSION to the one you picked last turn. On a 3-4, you must pick the same Delusion as the one you picked last turn, even if it is on the warscroll of a unit that has been destroyed. In such cases, the eect of that D applies as if the unit had not been destroyed. On a 5-6, you must pick a DELUSION like you did in the first turn. For the rest of the turn, you believe the DELUSION you picked.
legend: The mass delusions suffered by these cannibals are volatile but intense.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn

name: A SPLENDID PAGEANT
description:
Effect: While you believe this DELUSION:
  • Each time a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS unit wholly within 12" of a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HERO uses a RUN ability, if you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
  • While a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS INFANTRY HERO is within the combat range of a friendly
legend: Believing they follow some grand religious icon and its holy custodians, devoted ghouls surge across the field.

name: A GLORIOUS BANQUET
description: Effect: While you believe this DELUSION, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS units that charged in the same turn while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES.
legend: As the court closes on its prey, the nobility signal for the feast to begin.

name: ROYAL BLOOD
description:
Declare: Pick any number of friendly ABHORRANTS to be the targets.

Effect: Heal (D3) each target.
legend: The blood coursing through an abhorrant’s veins has restorative properties.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

name: SUMMON LOYAL SUBJECTS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly ABHORRANT to use this ability, then pick a friendly SERFS or KNIGHTS unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: To the ghouls, an abhorrant’s howl is a call to defend their lands.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase

name: MUSTER GUARD
description:
Declare: Pick any number of friendly NOBLES to be the targets.

Effect: For each target, pick 1 of the following:
  • Return up to 3 slain models to a friendly SERFS unit wholly within 12" of it.
  • Return 1 slain model to a friendly KNIGHTS unit wholly within 12" of it.
The same unit cannot have models returned to it by this ability more than once per turn.
legend: Cannibal nobles have the charisma to rally wavering troops.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase

name: FEEDING FRENZY
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HERO in combat to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons, including Companion weapons, used by friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS units while they are wholly within 12" of the target.
legend: The presence of an abhorrant drives their followers into a furore
condition: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase

name: CRUSADING ARMY
description: Effect: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly units.
legend: The warriors of this court see themselves a crusading paladins venturing out into the realms with a holy cause.

name: ULGUAN CLOAK
description: Effect: Your general is not visible to enemy models that are more than 12" away from them.
legend: This Archregent is shrouded by an aura of darkness – holiness, as they would see it – which makes them difficult to target.

name: NOBLE DEEDS
description: Effect: Each time a friendly HERO uses a FIGHT ability, after its attacks have been resolved, give that HERO a number of noble deeds points equal to the number of damage points allocated by that ability. Each HERO can have a maximum of 6 noble deeds points at any time.
legend: Each member of a ghoulish court is constantly seeking to prove their valour by performing worthy exploits on the battlefield.

name: ROUSING ORATION
description: Effect: Roll a dice for each friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general. Do not roll a dice for your general. For each 5+, give 1 noble deeds point to your general.
legend: The Archregent looses a soul-chilling howl, which is perceived as an inspiring call to gallantry by their deranged followers.

name: DEFENDERS OF THE REALM
description: Effect: Add 1 to save rolls for friendly units that are contesting an objective you control.
legend: These deluded ghouls see themselves as noble defenders, selling their lives dearly to drive back the invader from beyond.

name: FEEDING FRENZY
description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly HEROES that have 6 noble deeds points.
legend: To witness an abhorrant at war spurs a mad hunger in the ghouls

name: BLOOD-RIVER CHALICE
description: Effect: Heal (2D3) your general.
legend: The Archregent guzzles from a bloodstained chalice, roaring as their deathless form swells with restored vitality.
condition: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase

name: SUMMON LOYAL SUBJECTS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly HERO with any noble deeds points to use this ability.

Effect: Spend any number of that HERO’s noble deeds points as follows:

Pick a friendly Cryptguard unit within 9" of this unit and spend 1 noble deeds point to return 1 model to that unit.

Pick a friendly Morbheg Knights unit within 9" of this unit and spend 2 noble deeds points to return 1 model to that unit.
legend: Ghouls flock to their vampiric masters.

name: CRIMSON VICTUALS
description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of your general to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: On a 6+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, if your Cryptguard unit is within 6" of the target, you can return 1 slain model to your Cryptguard unit for each damage point allocated by this ability.
legend: Hissing an incantation, the Archregent saps the life essence of nearby foes.

name: DELUSION OF THE SENTINEL
description: Effect: While you believe this DELUSION, add 1 to ward rolls for friendly units while each model in the unit is contesting an objective.
legend: Convinced that they are the last line of defence, the ghouls fight on with a shrieking grit.

name: DELUSIONS AND MADNESS
description:
Declare: You must use this ability at the start of each battle round. If it is the first battle round, pick a DELUSION. Otherwise, make a delusion roll by rolling a D6.

Effect: On a 1-3, you must pick a different DELUSION to the one you picked last time. On a 4+, you must pick the same DELUSION as last time. For the rest of the battle round, you believe the DELUSION you picked.
legend: The Flesh‑eaters’ delusions can change on a whim.
condition: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round

name: ALMOST LUCID
description: Effect: You can re-roll the delusion roll.
legend: This vampire has just enough sanity to faintly manipulate their madness.
condition: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared the ‘%000023012Delusions and Madness%’ ability

name: A WORTHY CHALLENGE
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that started the battle with 3 or fewer models and is in combat with your general to be the target.

Effect: Your opponent must decide whether the target will accept or refuse your general’s challenge. If they accept, for the rest of the phase, when your general and the target are picked to use a FIGHT ability, all of their attacks must target each other. If they refuse, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the phase.
legend: The pinnacle of chivalry is a noble duel between virtuous warriors.
condition: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

name: DELUSION OF THE HUNTER
description: Effect: While you believe this DELUSION, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly units while no models in the unit are contesting an objective.
legend: The ghouls opt to pounce on trespassers rather than hold ground.

name: DELUSION OF THE GREAT FEAST
description:
Declare: If you believe this DELUSION, pick each friendly unit on the battlefield to be the targets.

Effect: Heal (1) each target. If the target is a SERFS unit, return D3 slain models to it instead.
legend: In victory’s wake, the ghouls gorge upon their ‘bounty’…
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

name: DELUSION OF THE KNIGHTLY HOST
description: Effect: While you believe this DELUSION, if the unmodified charge roll for a friendly HERO or KNIGHTS unit is 8+, add 1 to hit rolls for that unit’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.
legend: The earth shakes and the sky screams as the ghouls charge.

name: COMPANION OF THE HUNT
description: Effect: If your general is not in combat, they can move 3". They cannot move into combat during any part of that move.
legend: This vampire has oft excelled in their monarch’s hunting parties.

name: CHOIRMASTER
description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of your general to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of friendly units’ ranged weapons for attacks that target that enemy unit.
legend: The shrieks of this Gorewarden further bolster the howls of their Crypt Flayers.
condition: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase

name: STRONGER IN MADNESS
description:
Effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit each phase.
In addition, other than the Companion weapon ability, weapon abilities for combat attacks that target this unit have no effect.
legend: The Boon of Ushoran has rendered this warrior’s physical form near indestructible.

name: SAVAGE BEYOND REASON
description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons, including Companion weapons, if it did not use a FIGHT ability in the previous turn. Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of those weapons instead while this unit has no used a FIGHT ability this battle.
legend: The fury of battle drives this general into an intense rage.

name: CRUEL TASKMASTER
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO FLESH-EATER COURTS unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for the target.
legend: The warriors under this courtier’s command instantly obey their summons.

name: ETHEREAL
description: Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for friendly LEGIONS OF NAGASH NIGHTHAUNT units, excluding Nagash.
legend: Nighthaunt spirits can rarely be harmed by blows delivered by those caught in the grip of a spiritual terror.

name: SOUL-SHRIVE AMULET
description:
Declare: Pick empowered agent or sacrificial pawn.

Effect: If you picked empowered agent, for the rest of the turn:

  • Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.
  • Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.

If you picked sacrificial pawn, instead of making a casting roll for the next spell cast by the friendly Nagash this turn, you can use a value of 7 for the roll that cannot be modified and that spell cannot be unbound. Then, allocate 3 damage points to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
legend: This amulet, a powerful artefact in its own right that grants the one who wears it incredible might, also hides a sinister purpose. Great Nagash trusts no-one, and should he desire it, he will sacrifice the bearer in an eyeblink to further his own agenda with no more thought than a man who blows out a candle.
condition: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase

name: RISE! RISE IN MY NAME!
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, pick each other visible friendly LEGIONS OF NAGASH unit wholly within 24" of the caster to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If a target unit has a Health characteristic of 1, return 3 slain models to the target unit.

If a target unit has a Health characteristic of 2 or 3, return 1 slain model to the target unit and Heal (2) the target unit.

If a target unit has a Health characteristic of 4 or more, Heal (D6) the target unit.
legend: With both arms raised high and enveloped in an aura of power so intense it drains the very light from the sky, the caster re-knits the broken forms of Nagash’s minions that they might continue to do battle in his name.

name: INESCAPABLE FATE
description:
Declare: This unit can only use this ability if it has been destroyed.

Effect: If the friendly Nagash is on the battlefield, set up a replacement of this unit wholly within 12" of that Nagash and more than 9" from all enemy units. If this unit is not INFANTRY or CAVALRY, allocate 8 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
legend: This undead lord has been long suspected of base treachery. Nagash is no stranger to such upstarts and has cursed this underling to return to his side each time they would fail him, to remind them just who holds the leash to their collar.
condition: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn

name: LEGIONS OF ENDLESS DEAD
description: Effect: Subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with 2 or more friendly units if any of those friendly units is Nagash or if none of those friendly units share any of the following keywords: SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS, FLESH-EATER COURTS, NIGHTHAUNT or OSSIARCH BO
legend: The sight of Nagash’s legions united under a single deathly banner, a near-infinite sea of undead as far as the eye can see, can bury even the stoutest soul in the deepest pits of sorrow and dread.

name: MY UNDYING DEMAND
description:
Declare: Pick the friendly Nagash to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each visible friendly LEGIONS OF NAGASH unit each phase while it is wholly within 24" of the friendly Nagash.
legend: The Lord of the Undead suffuses his creations with a vigour that causes blades to snap in greying flesh, arrows to bounce from shields of reinforced bone, and even the spells of the enemies to flicker and die in an amethyst flash of unearthly power.

name: INSANITY AND NIGHTMARES MADE MANIFEST
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS unit and a different friendly NIGHTHAUNT unit that are both wholly within 18" of and visible to the caster and wholly within 12" of each other to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the targets are wholly within 12" of and visible to each other:

legend: The horror of battling invigorated Flesh-eaters lends a deadly strength to the rusting blades of the Nighthaunt procession.

name: REAP A BLOODY TITHE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS unit and a different friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit that are both wholly within 18" of and visible to the caster and wholly within 12" of each other to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by the
legend: The caster’s will drives Nagash’s Soulblight and Ossiarch minions forward, the wealth of blood and bone on the gore-strewn battlefield acting as fuel for his mightiest elites.

name: RIVERS OF BLOOD AND SHALLOW GRAVES
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS unit and a different friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS unit that are both wholly within 18" of and visible to the caster and wholly within 12" of each other to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the friendly
legend: As the Flesh-eaters mangle, tear and rip their enemies into bloody chunks, the charnel stink of blood lies heavy in the air. The resulting rivers of blood and fresh piles of potential chattel handily replenish the Soulblight ranks.

name: DELUSION AND DISCIPLINE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit and a different friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS unit that are both wholly within 18" of and visible to the caster and wholly within 12" of each other to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

legend: Loyal bannermen of the Summerking see themselves rallying alongside the greatest martial elites ever to have lived. For the Ossiarchs, they simply follow orders and take every advantage offered by the crazed attacks of their erstwhile allies.

name: BRINGING ORDER TO HORROR
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a friendly NIGHTHAUNT unit and a different friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit that are both wholly within 18" of and visible to the caster and wholly within 12" of each other to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
