legend: Wings of jet black frame the priest as they summon a chill wind that speeds their allies.

name: HALLOWED PRESENCE
description: Effect: While friendly non-WARRIOR CHAMBER units are wholly within 12" of any friendly RUINATION CHAMBER units, those friendly WARRIOR CHAMBER units have WARD (6+).
legend: While fighting alongside the Ruination chambers, those of the Warrior chambers are granted a measure of the incorruptible nature of their solemn brethren.

name: ENTROPIC SCREECH
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly RUINATION CHAMBER MONSTER that has not used any RAMPAGE abilities this turn to use this ability. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with it to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. The unit using this ability cannot use any more RAMPAGE abilities for the rest of the turn.
legend: Cocking its head back, the Morrgryph unleashes a soul-piercing screech that causes foes to wither and collapse under its necrotic onslaught.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

name: UNCAGED LIGHTNING
description: Effect: Each time an enemy unit in combat with this unit moves or is removed from the battlefield, after that ability has been resolved, if that enemy unit is on the battlefield and not in combat with this unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.
legend: The divine lightning wrought into these warriors’ forms has become unstable; it leaps forth from them unexpectedly, usually towards those who try to escape their wrath.

name: VETERANS OF AMBERSTONE WATCH
description:
Effect: Enemy units do not have the STRIKE-FIRST keyword while they are in combat with this unit.

Designer’s Note: Enemy units that have STRIKE-LAST would still have STRIKE-LAST; they would not be treated as having neither STRIKE-FIRST nor STRIKE-LAST.
legend: Practised at fighting cunning foes, these warriors ensure they always have the upper hand.

name: PYROTECHNIC SOULS
description: Effect: When this unit is destroyed, gain 3 rage dice.
legend: When these warriors discorporate, it makes for a spectacularly explosive display

name: LIGHTNING BLAST
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly STORMCAST ETERNALS WIZARD to cast this spell, then pick the closest visible enemy unit to them that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target. If 2 or more visible enemy units are tied to be the closest, you can pick which is the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
legend: The wizard releases pent-up storm energy into the foe, the tang of ozone and the stench of charred flesh filling the air as their enemies are burned and blasted by crackling arcs of lightning.

name: THUNDERSHOCK
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly STORMCAST ETERNALS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.
legend: The wizard unleashes the power of Sigmar's storm as a wave of pure force, leaving the foe stunned and disoriented.

name: STARFALL
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly STORMCAST ETERNALS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy INFANTRY or CAVALRY unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.
legend: Gazing towards the heavens, the wizard hurls meteoric rain into the enemy's path, forcing them to turn an aggressive push into a cautious advance.

name: SHIELD OF AZYR
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, that unit has WARD (5+).
legend: Roaring oaths to Sigmar, these warriors are surrounded by an aura of divine protection.
condition: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase

name: HALLOWED SCROLLS
description: Effect: Your general has WARD (5+).
legend: Sacred parchments inscribed with Sigmarite blessings adorn this warrior.

name: STRIKE WHERE NEEDED
description:
Used By: The unit using that RETREAT ability

Effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on that unit by that RETREAT ability. In addition, that unit can still use CHARGE abilities this turn even though it used a RETREAT ability.
legend: Though often outnumbered by their foes, the Stormcast Eternals are accustomed to fighting on many fronts and focusing their efforts where they will have the greatest impact.
condition: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a <ky>RETREAT</ky> ability

name: BLAZE OF GLORY
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat.

Effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit is slain, make a vengeance roll of D6. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on an enemy unit in combat with that unit.
legend: As these warriors are struck down, Sigmar’s holy lightning wreaks devastation around them before they are called back to the heavens to be Reforged.
condition: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

name: QUICKSILVER DRAUGHT
description: Effect: Your general has STRIKE-FIRST this phase.
legend: This potion lends uncanny speed to the one who imbibes it.
condition: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

name: STORM CHARGE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat.

Effect: That unit can use CHARGE abilities this turn even if it used a RUN ability in the same turn.
legend: These warriors are driven forward by their faith, ever eager to bring Sigmar’s holy retribution to his enemies.
condition: Once Per Battle, Your Charge Phase

name: MORRDA'S TALON
description: Effect: Your general’s Hallowed Greataxe has Crit (Mortal).
legend: Enemies of the God-King know this weapon by name and fear its keen blade.

name: NULL PENDANT
description:
Declare: Roll a dice for each enemy unit contesting the same objective as your general.

Effect: On a 2+, subtract the roll from the control score of that enemy unit this turn.
legend: This dark amulet holds magic within that can sap the resolve of the enemy.
condition: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn

name: LIGHTNING-STRIKE ARRIVAL
description: Effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.
legend: With a clap of thunder, Yndrasta and her allies strike down onto the battlefield.

name: DEFEND TO THE LAST
description: Effect: Friendly units have WARD (6+) while they are contesting an objective you control.
legend: These fearless warriors refuse to fall until their task is completed.

name: THE PRIME HUNTRESS
description: Effect: The Damage characteristic of Thengavar (Yndrasta’s spear) is 2D6 for attacks that target a MONSTER.
legend: Yndrasta relishes hunting the mightiest and most terrifying quarry.

name: DRIVE THEM BACK
description:
Declare: Pick any number of friendly units that are both contesting an objective and in combat.

Effect: Each of those units can make a pile-in move. For each unit that did so, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it and roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that enemy unit.
legend: Not an inch is given to the enemies of Sigmar.

name: DAZZLING RADIANCE
description:
Declare: Pick your general to use this ability if they were set up this phase.

Effect: You can return 1 slain model to each friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general.
legend: Yndrasta’s god-touched brilliance can call stranded Stormcast souls into the fray once more.
condition: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase

name: STRIKE WITH THE TEMPEST'S RAGE
description: Effect: Your general has STRIKE-FIRST if they charged in the same turn.
legend: Yndrasta’s enemies know that to catch her gaze is to be marked for annihilation.

name: HAWK OF THE CELESTIAL SKIES
description: Effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of your general.
legend: The sight of Yndrasta’s seraphic form inspires her warriors with immeasurable resolve.
condition: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

name: TERMINUS CLOCK
description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy WIZARDS while they are within 18" of this unit.
legend: Created by a mad clockwright of Ulfenkarn, this bizarre cogwork piece ticks without rhyme or reason. Whenever its eclectic count ends, however, the power of magic seems to deaden across the field.

name: SHARD OF NIGHT
description: Effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit (positive and negative).
legend: This undead lord’s armour was crafted using elements of an abyssal stalker and grants the bearer that awful creature’s shadowy aura.

name: AMULET OF GRAVES
description: Effect: If there are fewer than 3 friendly Cursed Sepulchres on the battlefield, set up a Cursed Sepulchre on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units, more than 1" from all friendly units and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.
legend: The bearer of this amulet can call upon a long-dead soul in Shyish, manifesting their final resting place onto the battlefield in a storm of necromantic energy.
condition: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase

name: RESTLESS TYRANT
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BARROW LEGION unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.
legend: The skeletal warriors under this one’s command are driven ever forward.

name: THE ROYAL CRYPT
description:
Declare: This ability must be used instead of the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain Feature’ ability.

Effect: Set up 3 Cursed Sepulchres wholly within friendly territory, each within ½" of any of the others and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features. After you have done so, they have been deployed and they are considered to be a single Cursed Sepulchre terrain feature that has a Health characteristic of 24 instead of 8.
legend: These crumbling ruins marks the ancient holdings of a powerful wight.

name: RING OF STRICKEN SOULS
description: Effect: This unit has WARD (5+).
legend: Violet clouds swirl within the Shyishan amethyst set in this ring, which grants the bearer uncanny protection.

name: SPIRIT-EATER
description: Effect: If any models were slain by your general this turn, Heal (D6) your general.
legend: The souls of slain enemies are drawn into this king of undeath, imbuing him with unholy might.

name: GRAVE SENTINELS
description: Effect: The melee weapons used by friendly BARROW LEGION units have Anti-charge (+1 Rend) while they are wholly within 9" of a friendly Cursed Sepulchre.
legend: Unwavering in their eternal vigilance, the deathly warriors of this legion’s overlord guard his ancient resting place.

name: CROWN OF COLD COMMAND
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BARROW LEGION unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+:
  • If the target is damaged, Heal (3) the target.
  • If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.
legend: This eldritch crown compels this king’s warriors from ages past to rise from their graves and fight once more.
condition: Once Per Turn, Any Hero Phase

name: LORD OF THE ARCANE AEGIS
description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following keywords:
  • INFANTRY
  • CAVALRY
  • MONSTER
  • BEAST
For the rest of the battle, each time an attack targets this unit, if the attacking unit has the keyword you picked, an unmodified save roll of 4+ for that attack is always successful.
legend: Even in undeath, this wight still recalls all manner of warding cantrips to protect his forces from the enemy.

name: ALL TO DUST
description: Effect: In the third and subsequent battle rounds, while a friendly Cursed Sepulchre is on the battlefield, subtract 1 from save rolls for enemy units.
legend: Acting as a conduit to the Shyish Nadir, the death magic that swirls around this barrow legion’s tomb causes trespassers to atrophy and their armour to corrode under the weight of ages.

name: CRYPT DAGGER
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy HERO in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target.
legend: Foul sorcery flickers and dances across the ancient iron of this cursed blade, and its bite can bring instant death.
condition: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn

name: GIFTS TO THE PETTY KINGDOMS
description:
Declare: Pick up to 2 friendly non-UNIQUE BARROW LEGION HEROES that do not have an artefact of power to be the targets (you can pick units in reserve).

Effect: Give each target 1 artefact of power from the ‘Barrow Legion’ Army of Renown rules.

Designer’s Note: These artefacts of power are given to the HEROES during the deployment phase, not during army composition.
legend: To each of his vassal kingdoms, this legion’s monarch bestowed a gift bearing a curse that bound them to his service for evermore.

name: GRAVE-SAND PENDANT
description: Effect: If this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, Heal (1) this unit. This unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.
legend: When shattered, the Shyishan realmstone within this talisman can forestall the bearer’s final destruction, granting them one last chance to claim revenge.

name: ENDLESS LEGIONS OF BONE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE BARROW LEGION unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of a friendly BARROW LEGION HERO or wholly within 6" of a friendly Cursed Sepulchre. It must be set up more than 9" from all enemy units.

If it is your move
legend: When the Deathrattle armies are roused to war, their numbers are unending.
condition: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Any Movement Phase

name: AMULET OF NIGHTMARES
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit within 9" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, the target has STRIKE-LAST this phase.
legend: The nightmares of the bearer, who endures a torturous existence trapped in their mouldering undead form, are projected into the minds of the living by this onyx talisman.
condition: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

name: WARDENS OF THE WOLF
description: Effect: Each time 1 or more slain models are returned to a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY or BEASTS unit wholly within 12" of a friendly Belladamma Volga, Radukar the Wolf, Radukar the Beast, Ivya Volga, Lady Annika,
legend: The might of Ulfenkarn marches forth from the shattered city, its graves emptied to bolster the tides of endless dead, as the howls of feral vampires echo across the battlefield.

name: THE SPEED OF DEATH
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly INFANTRY VAMPIRE HERO to be the target.

Effect: The target can move up to 12" and has FLY when it does so. It cannot end that move in combat.
legend: Many vampires are capable of swiftly traversing nearly any terrain by assuming a different form or through the application of the sheer bestial strength and agility granted them by their curse.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

name: HORROR UNENDING
description: Effect: You can pick 1 additional target when using the ‘Deathly Invocation’ ability.
legend: The never-ending waves of deathly minions summoned by a Legion of Shyish shatter all hopes of victory for those who stand against them.

name: TIDE OF BONES AND BLADES
description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly DEATHRATTLE units that charged in the same turn for attacks that target a unit that has fewer models than the attacking unit.
legend: The relentless advance of these skeletal undead can overwhelm even the most tenacious resistance.

name: ARISTOCRACY OF THE NIGHT
description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly VAMPIRE units that are not in combat and add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly VAMPIRE units that charged in the same turn.
legend: These vampires are expected to excel in all martial and mystical disciplines.

name: DRAGGED DOWN AND TORN APART
description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly DEADWALKERS units in combat to be the targets.

Effect: For each target:
  • Make a pile-in move.
  • Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
legend: Hordes of shambling Deadwalker Zombies flow around and over their victims like a rotten tide, bearing them to the ground through sheer weight of numbers before tearing them limb from limb.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

name: UNHOLY SITE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly Cursed Sepulchre to be the target.

Effect: The target has WARD (4+) until the start of your next turn.
legend: Some gravesites have witnessed such horrors that the death magic suffusing them makes them even more difficult to cleanse of the undead’s influence.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

name: ANCIENT BURIAL SITES
description:
Effect: If there is a friendly Cursed Sepulchre on the battlefield, you can set up up to 2 additional Cursed Sepulchres on the battlefield. The first must be set up more than 3" from all units, objectives and other terrain features. The second must be set up wholly outside enemy territory and more than 3" from all units, objectives and other terrain features.

Designer’s Note: The original Cursed Sepulchre is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability. This ability allows you to set up a second and third such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.
legend: Across the Mortal Realms stand time-worn mausoleums and barrows, housing the remains of the long dead.

name: THE UNQUIET DEAD
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly DEATHRATTLE or DEADWALKERS unit that has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up that unit in reserve in the grave. It has now been deployed. You cannot set up more friendly units in the grave than there are on the battlefield.
legend: Animated by necromancy, the undead rise from their graves, balefire eyes blazing with dark purpose.

name: THE RISING DEAD
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in the grave.

Effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a friendly Cursed Sepulchre and more than 9" from all enemy units, or wholly within 6" of the edge of the battlefield, wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: Clawing their way through the soil and rock, more undead warriors join the fight.

name: DEATHLY INVOCATION
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO to use this ability, then pick up to 3 friendly DEATHRATTLE or DEADWALKERS units wholly within 12" of that HERO to be the targets.

Effect: For each target:
  • If the target is damaged, Heal (3) the target.
  • If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health
legend: Skilled wielders of death magic can summon hordes of undead.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase

name: ENDLESS LEGIONS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE DEATHRATTLE or DEADWALKERS unit that started the battle with 2 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO or wholly within 6" of a friendly
legend: To the Gravelords, the dead are mere chattel to be raised and expended.
condition: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Any Movement Phase

name: THE HUNGER
description:
Declare: Pick each friendly VAMPIRE unit that used a FIGHT ability this turn to be the targets.

Effect: Heal (D3) each target. Heal (2D3) the target instead if it destroyed an enemy unit this turn using a FIGHT ability.
legend: Soulblight vampires are revitalised by feasting upon the blood of their foes.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

name: ENDLESS LEGIONS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly Deathrattle Skeletons unit that has been destroyed.

Effect: You can set up a replacement unit with D6 models in friendly territory more than 6" from enemy units.
legend: To the Soulblight aristocracy, the dead are mere chattel to be expended at will.
condition: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase

name: GRAVE-SAND SHARD
description: Effect: Add 1 to each legion roll made for that unit.
legend: By crushing this gem of vitrified grave-sand, the Vampire Lord can draw upon a surge of death magic to reinvigorate their resurrected warriors.
condition: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared the ‘Skeleton Legion’ ability for a unit within 9" of your general

name: SWOOP DOWN
description: Effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.
legend: The sky darkens as the Vargheists descend.

name: RUINOUS CHARGERS
description:
Declare: Pick your Blood Knights unit to use this ability if it charged this turn.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit it passed across during that CHARGE ability.
legend: The Blood Knights of this army leave a trail of destruction as they trample anything that lies between them and their prey.

name: AURA OF NIGHT
description: Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for shooting attacks that target your general.
legend: This black leather brigandine was crafted from the hide of an abyssal stalker and grants the wearer that creature’s shadowy aura.

name: THE HUNGER
description: Effect: Each time a friendly VAMPIRE unit uses a FIGHT ability, after all of its attacks have been resolved, Heal (X) that VAMPIRE unit where X is the number of damage points allocated by those attacks.
legend: Those who bear the Soulblight Curse constantly crave blood and are empowered by feasting upon their foes.

name: CLOUD OF BATS
description: Effect: Remove your general from the battlefield and set them up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.
legend: Your Vampire Lord dissolves into a swarm of bats before reappearing elsewhere.
condition: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase

name: SPIRIT GALE
description:
Declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: On a 7+, inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy unit on the battlefield.
legend: Your general calls forth spectral winds that tear the souls of the foe from their bodies.

name: OVERWHELMING HORDES
description: Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly non-HERO units that target a unit that has fewer models than the attacking unit.
legend: The relentless advance of these skeletal undead can overwhelm even the most tenacious resistance.

name: SHYISHAN BLADE
description: Effect: The Rend characteristic of your general’s Baleful Tomb Blade is 2.
legend: Sorcerous shadows dance across the deadly sharp edge of this obsidian sword.

name: THE RISING DEAD
description: Effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 3" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.
legend: Clawing their way through the soil and rock, more undead warriors join the fight.
condition: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase

name: DEATHMARCH
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO unit that is not in combat to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1" to the target’s Move characteristic and add 3 to its control score.
legend: With rusted armour clattering, the skeletons advance in eerie lockstep, unburdened by pain or doubt.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

name: PROPELLED BY HATE
description:
Declare: Pick another friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target.

Effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
legend: This warrior’s insatiable urge to slaughter the enemies of Nagash drives their deathless soldiers forward with sudden haste.

name: AURA OF ANTIQUITY
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with any friendly units to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
legend: Prolonged exposure to the necrotic energies that animate these Deathrattle warriors can cause the equipment of their foes to corrode and crumble with unnatural speed.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase

name: STOLEN ANIMUS
description: Effect: Each time your general scores a critical hit, Heal (2) your general after the ATTACK ability has been resolved.
legend: This Wight King draws their unholy vitality from spilling blood in great measure.

name: SOUL-DRAIN PENDANT
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.
legend: When the cursed words of awakening are uttered, this amethyst pendant saps the vigour of the living.
condition: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

name: LASH OF THE SIRE
description:
Declare: Pick another friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+:
  • If the target is not in combat, it can move D6" but cannot move into combat during any part of that move.
  • If the target is in combat, it can make a pile-in move.
legend: Such is the domineering force of this undead overlord’s willpower that it can imbue nearby vassals with sudden impetus.

name: IMMORTAL EGO
description: Effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.
legend: Few mortals would claim to be the mightiest slayer in the Mortal Realms or to have a peerless mastery of the blade, given the existence of gods, daemons, demigods and more besides.

name: IMMORTAL EGO
description: Effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.
legend: Few mortals would claim to be the mightiest slayer in the Mortal Realms or to have a peerless mastery of the blade, given the existence of gods, daemons, demigods and more besides.

name: FURIOUS ENDINGS
description: Effect: Each time a MANIFESTATION within 12" of this unit is removed from play, gain 1 rage dice.
legend: This being can harness the power created when Shyishan and Aqshian magics mingle, which often occurs when arcane manifestations meet their end in the Bright Realm.

name: UNBENDING WILL
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly DEATHRATTLE or DEADWALKERS unit that has 2 or more models and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Add D6 to the target’s control score for the rest of the turn.
legend: This immortal tyrant and their minions are a force of unliving conquest like no other.

name: FRIGHTENING VITALITY
description: Effect: Each time an ability would heal exactly 1 or 2 of this unit’s damage points, heal 3 damage points instead.
legend: This deathless champion is an undead juggernaut, capable of a type of regeneration that is rare even amongst the ranks of the unliving.

name: A WASTREL AND A VAGABOND
description:
Effect: While a friendly Deadwalker Zombies or Deathrattle Skeletons unit is wholly within 12" of this unit:
  • Add 2 to run rolls for that unit.
  • Add 3" to the distance that unit can move when it piles in.
legend: This spiteful creature is an embarrassment to their undead peers: perhaps a vampire fallen from favour, a wight who failed in their duty to their king, or a Necromancer who pushed their luck one time too many. Regardless of the reason, they seem to have an affinity with the basest undead minions.

name: UNHINGED RAMPAGER
description: Effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit in your charge phase.
legend: This creature’s bestial hunger sees them close on the foe without hesitation.

name: ETERNAL THRALL
description:
Declare: Pick another friendly non-UNIQUE SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY HERO to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, while the target is on the battlefield:
  • If this unit is a Necromancer, add 1 to this unit’s power level.
  • If this unit is a VAMPIRE, add 1 to unbinding rolls for this unit.
  • If this unit is
legend: Such is this warlord’s notoriety that they have acquired something of a cult following. One of their most ardent supporters is renowned in their own right, and they bask in the adulation of this follower the most.

name: SIPHON STRENGTH
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly CRIMSON KEEP WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by the caster.
legend: The vampire draws on the life essence of the enemy to flood their limbs with strength and heighten their senses.

name: IMMORTAL DEDICATION
description:
Effect: This unit receives D3 martial prowess tokens. Each martial prowess token can be spent to do 1 of the following:
  • Re-roll a hit roll for this unit.
  • Re-roll a wound roll for this unit.
  • Re-roll a save roll for this unit.

At the start of the next turn, remove all this unit’s martial prowess tokens.
legend: Having spent centuries in undeath honing their martial skill, this Gravelord is a master of combat.

name: CHALICE OF THE BLOOD DRAGON
description: Effect: Heal (3D3) this unit.
legend: Said to have been possessed by the Crimson Keep’s first castellan, this chalice can be drained to renew a vampire’s vigour.
condition: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn

name: THE CRIMSON KEEP
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly CRIMSON KEEP unit that has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up that unit in reserve in the Crimson Keep. It has now been deployed. You cannot set up more friendly units in the Crimson Keep than there are on the battlefield.
legend: None can predict where the Crimson Keep will manifest next, but wherever it appears, the slaughter its occupants will wreak will be total.

name: SUMMON UNHOLY RELIQUARY
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Unholy Reliquary on the battlefield, pick a friendly CRIMSON KEEP WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up an Unholy Reliquary wholly within 18" of the caster.
legend: Pulled forth from the underworlds, the remains of a long perished vampire rises from the ground amidst a vortex of death magic.

name: CARVE A BLOODY PATH
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly Blood Knights unit that is in combat to use this ability.

Effect: That unit can use a CHARGE ability even though it is in combat and even if it has already used a CHARGE ability this turn.
legend: With unstoppable force, a wedge of Blood Knights punches through the enemy’s lines leaving a trail of broken foes in their wake.

name: DEATHLY GALE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly CRIMSON KEEP WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly CRIMSON KEEP unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a maximum of 3.
legend: A foul wind carrying a stench of death and decay races across the battlefield, speeding the charge of the Knights of the Crimson Keep.

name: FROM A QUARTER UNSEEN
description:
Declare: You cannot use this ability in the first battle round. Pick each friendly unit that is in the Crimson Keep to be the targets.

Effect: Set up each target wholly within 9" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you set up any units using this ability in the third or a subsequent battle round, do not spend any command points when using the ‘Carve a Bloody Path’ command this turn.
legend: Prince Vhordrai has mastered the art of trapping the foe between his main force and reserves that sally forth from the Crimson Keep at his signal.
condition: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Movement Phase

name: AWAKENED FURY
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly CRIMSON KEEP WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly CRIMSON KEEP unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s Companion melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
legend: At the sorcerer’s gesture, hooves are wreathed in balefire and monstrous talons grow elongated and wickedly sharp.

name: BLOOD RAMPAGE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly CRIMSON KEEP MONSTER that is in combat and has not used any RAMPAGE abilities this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: This unit can make a move of 2D6". It must end that move in combat with the target unit. Then, roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target unit’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

After this ability has been resolved, this unit cannot use RAMPAGE abilities for the rest of the turn.
legend: The nightmarish behemoths that roost among the upper spires of the Crimson Keep tear through the enemy’s ranks, sending bloody chunks and gore flying in all directions.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

name: ETHEREAL
description: Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for friendly LEGIONS OF NAGASH NIGHTHAUNT units, excluding Nagash.
legend: Nighthaunt spirits can rarely be harmed by blows delivered by those caught in the grip of a spiritual terror.

name: SOUL-SHRIVE AMULET
description:
Declare: Pick empowered agent or sacrificial pawn.

Effect: If you picked empowered agent, for the rest of the turn:

  • Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.
  • Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.

If you picked sacrificial pawn, instead of making a casting roll for the next spell cast by the friendly Nagash this turn, you can use a value of 7 for the roll that cannot be modified and that spell cannot be unbound. Then, allocate 3 damage points to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
legend: This amulet, a powerful artefact in its own right that grants the one who wears it incredible might, also hides a sinister purpose. Great Nagash trusts no-one, and should he desire it, he will sacrifice the bearer in an eyeblink to further his own agenda with no more thought than a man who blows out a candle.
condition: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase

name: INESCAPABLE FATE
description:
Declare: This unit can only use this ability if it has been destroyed.

Effect: If the friendly Nagash is on the battlefield, set up a replacement of this unit wholly within 12" of that Nagash and more than 9" from all enemy units. If this unit is not INFANTRY or CAVALRY, allocate 8 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
legend: This undead lord has been long suspected of base treachery. Nagash is no stranger to such upstarts and has cursed this underling to return to his side each time they would fail him, to remind them just who holds the leash to their collar.
condition: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn

name: RISE! RISE IN MY NAME!
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, pick each other visible friendly LEGIONS OF NAGASH unit wholly within 24" of the caster to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If a target unit has a Health characteristic of 1, return 3 slain models to the target unit.

If a target unit has a Health characteristic of 2 or 3, return 1 slain model to the target unit and Heal (2) the target unit.

If a target unit has a Health characteristic of 4 or more, Heal (D6) the target unit.
legend: With both arms raised high and enveloped in an aura of power so intense it drains the very light from the sky, the caster re-knits the broken forms of Nagash’s minions that they might continue to do battle in his name.

name: MY UNDYING DEMAND
description:
Declare: Pick the friendly Nagash to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each visible friendly LEGIONS OF NAGASH unit each phase while it is wholly within 24" of the friendly Nagash.
legend: The Lord of the Undead suffuses his creations with a vigour that causes blades to snap in greying flesh, arrows to bounce from shields of reinforced bone, and even the spells of the enemies to flicker and die in an amethyst flash of unearthly power.

name: LEGIONS OF ENDLESS DEAD
description: Effect: Subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with 2 or more friendly units if any of those friendly units is Nagash or if none of those friendly units share any of the following keywords: SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS, FLESH-EATER COURTS, NIGHTHAUNT or OSSIARCH BO
legend: The sight of Nagash’s legions united under a single deathly banner, a near-infinite sea of undead as far as the eye can see, can bury even the stoutest soul in the deepest pits of sorrow and dread.

name: INSANITY AND NIGHTMARES MADE MANIFEST
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS unit and a different friendly NIGHTHAUNT unit that are both wholly within 18" of and visible to the caster and wholly within 12" of each other to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the targets are wholly within 12" of and visible to each other:

  • Add 10 to the
legend: The horror of battling invigorated Flesh-eaters lends a deadly strength to the rusting blades of the Nighthaunt procession.

name: REAP A BLOODY TITHE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS unit and a different friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit that are both wholly within 18" of and visible to the caster and wholly within 12" of each other to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by the
legend: The caster’s will drives Nagash’s Soulblight and Ossiarch minions forward, the wealth of blood and bone on the gore-strewn battlefield acting as fuel for his mightiest elites.

name: RIVERS OF BLOOD AND SHALLOW GRAVES
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS unit and a different friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS unit that are both wholly within 18" of and visible to the caster and wholly within 12" of each other to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the friendly
legend: As the Flesh-eaters mangle, tear and rip their enemies into bloody chunks, the charnel stink of blood lies heavy in the air. The resulting rivers of blood and fresh piles of potential chattel handily replenish the Soulblight ranks.

name: DELUSION AND DISCIPLINE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit and a different friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS unit that are both wholly within 18" of and visible to the caster and wholly within 12" of each other to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the OSSIARCH BO
legend: Loyal bannermen of the Summerking see themselves rallying alongside the greatest martial elites ever to have lived. For the Ossiarchs, they simply follow orders and take every advantage offered by the crazed attacks of their erstwhile allies.

name: BRINGING ORDER TO HORROR
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a friendly NIGHTHAUNT unit and a different friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit that are both wholly within 18" of and visible to the caster and wholly within 12" of each other to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The NIGHTHAUNT target can use a CHARGE ability as if it were your
legend: With an unearthly bellow, the caster drives the Nighthaunt before them like hunting hounds while the Ossiarchs silently withdraw, redirect and return to the battle in a seamless fashion.

name: FELL BLADES AND BLOODY FANGS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a friendly NIGHTHAUNT unit and a different friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS unit that are both wholly within 18" of and visible to the caster and wholly within 12" of each other to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the SOULBLIGHT
legend: As foes cower in fear from the spectral terror of the Nighthaunt, the Soulblight Gravelords carve a bloody path through the enemy’s ranks. The resulting terror feeds nearby Nighthaunt, triggering a bloody cycle of slaughter from which there is no escape.

name: THE GAZE OF NAGASH
description:
Declare: Pick the friendly Nagash to cast this spell. Then, pick 2 points on the battlefield within 18" of and visible to him and within 12" of each other. Then, draw a line between those points. Each visible enemy unit the line passes across is a target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Pick normal gaze or empowered gaze.

If you picked normal gaze, inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.

If you picked empowered gaze, make an empowerment roll of 2D6. On a 6+, the roll succeeds; otherwise, the roll fails. You can keep making empowerment rolls until a roll fails. If an empowerment roll fails, the spell fails and its effect is not resolved. Otherwise, inflict D3+X mortal damage on each target, where X is the number of empowerment rolls that succeeded.
legend: A swirling witchlight burns within Nagash’s eye sockets, building in intensity until a solid beam of amethyst light blazes forth to annihilate whatever the Lord of Shyish looks upon.

name: SUMMON HAND OF NAGASH
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Hand of Nagash on the battlefield, pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Hand of Nagash wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: From out a yawning portal looms a colossal skeletal arm, infused to its cursed marrow with the magic of Shyish.

name: SUMMON SANGUINE SWARM
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Sanguine Swarm on the battlefield, pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Sanguine Swarm wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Sanguine Swarm spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.
legend: The skies darken as screeching swarms of spectral bats descend upon the battlefield, hungry for blood.

name: SUMMON UNHOLY RELIQUARY
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Unholy Reliquary on the battlefield, pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up an Unholy Reliquary wholly within 18" of the caster, visible to them and more than 3" from all enemy units.
legend: Pulled forth from the underworlds, the remains of a long perished vampire rises from the ground amidst a vortex of death magic.

name: THE EMPTY GRAVEYARD
description: Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again more than 9" from all enemy units and either wholly within 7" of a terrain feature or wholly within 7" of the battlefield edge. This unit cannot use MOVE abilities in the first turn of the first battle round.
legend: Folks tell of a cemetery where the day after a mass funeral, each newly filled burial plot was found empty, with footprints leading away from them into the wilds…

name: THE NEVER-DEAD
description:
Effect: Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent’s fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, for the rest of the turn, each time you make an unmodified save roll of 5+ for an attack that targets this unit, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
legend: It is said that there is a rampaging band of warriors who yearn for the sweet release of death, but as punishment for transgressions past, Elder Bones refuses to let them die.

name: THE INCARNADINE KILLERS
description: Effect: If this unit is not in combat and an enemy unit was destroyed by its combat attacks this turn, this unit can move up to D6". It can end that move in combat.
legend: Beware the Incarnadine Killers, for they are cursed with an insatiable lust for slaughter. Do not think that distance shall keep you safe; should you spy their bloodied forms upon the horizon one moment, their blades will be lodged in your throat the next.

name: Battle Damaged
description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Mighty Grave Beast’s Talons is 5.

name: THAUMIC REALIGNMENT
description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any EXQUISITE PLOT abilities this turn. Pick a friendly WIZARD to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to casting rolls for the target. In addition, at the end of this turn, if the target successfully cast any spells this turn, add 1 to its power level for the rest of the battle.
legend: The seeding of deathly energies soon sees the fell winds rise…
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

name: AMULET OF LEECHES
description:
Effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly Dire Wolves or Fell Bats unit:
  • This unit has WARD (5+).
  • Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly Dire Wolves or Fell Bats unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
legend: This ancient and corroded talisman allows the wielder to draw upon the necromantic energies of their minions for protection.

name: KEEPER OF THE ROYAL MENAGERIE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly Dire Wolves or Fell Bats unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: Those vampires who maintain the bleak menageries of Nulahmia have an instinctive bond with undead beasts.

name: INVOCATION OF NULAHMIA
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SCIONS OF NULAHMIA WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly Dire Wolves or Fell Bats unit wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: You can return 1 slain model to that unit.
legend: This ancient spell, said to hail from the sun-blasted birthplace of necromancy, is wielded by each of Neferata’s chosen.

name: THRALL DRAIN
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SCIONS OF NULAHMIA WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: D3 models in the target are slain. Then, remove all damage points from the caster.
legend: Vampires are consummate and ruthless survivors; they will gladly drain the energy of their subordinates in order to heal their own wounds.

name: RECRUITMENT DRIVE
description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any EXQUISITE PLOT abilities this turn. Pick a friendly unit to be the hunter and an enemy unit with 5 or more models to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for the hunter’s combat attacks that target that enemy unit. In addition, if the target is destroyed this turn by the hunter, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the hunter’s melee weapons for the rest of the battle.
legend: The butchery of a few peons yields a reserve of future ‘recruits’.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

name: SEEK WORTHY BLOOD
description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any EXQUISITE PLOT abilities this turn. Pick a friendly unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the target’s weapons have Anti-HERO (+1 Rend). In addition, if the target destroys any enemy HEROES this turn, the target’s weapons have Anti-HERO (+1 Rend) for the rest of the battle.
legend: Only the finest ichor will suffice for the vampires of Nulahmia. It is considered an art to eviscerate an enemy champion whilst collecting as much of their blood as possible.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

name: SCARLET THIRST
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SCIONS OF NULAHMIA WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly SCIONS OF NULAHMIA VAMPIRE units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster.
legend: At the wizard’s command, a fierce compulsion to feed flares up inside the vampiric court, who eagerly await the chance to indulge their blood hunger without restraint.

name: THE QUEEN’S PRIZE
description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any EXQUISITE PLOT abilities this turn. Pick a friendly unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 5 to the target’s control score.
In addition, at the end of this turn, after determining control of objectives, if the target is contesting an objective that you control and that was controlled by your opponent at the start of this turn, add 5 to the target’s control score for the rest of the battle.
legend: What Neferata desires, Neferata receives.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

name: VILE TRANSFERENCE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit. If any enemy models were slain by this spell, Heal (D3) the caster.
legend: The caster siphons the animus from nearby enemies and uses it to restore their deathless form.

name: PRISON OF GRIEF
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target has STRIKE-LAST until the start of your next turn.
legend: Victims of this curse relive their tragedies, their will to fight replaced by overwhelming self-pity.

name: WASTE AWAY
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.
legend: The wizard causes the muscles of the foe to atrophy, robbing them of their strength.

name: COATL FAMILIAR
description: Effect: Add D6 to the casting roll for that spell.
legend: Though only a juvenile example of the great feathered serpents, this winged creature is still sacred to the mage-god Tepok.
condition: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a <ky>Spell</ky> ability for a friendly Seraphon Wizard within this unit’s combat range

name: INCANDESCENT RECTRICES
description: Effect: Heal (D3) this unit.
legend: This vibrant plumage imbues the bearer with the restorative power of the heavens.

name: BLOODRAGE PENDANT
description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons. Add 2 instead if the number of damage points allocated to this unit is equal to or greater than half of this unit’s Health characteristic (rounding up).
legend: Carved from the bones of savage reptilian megafauna, the Bloodrage Pendant spurs a warrior’s killing rage – all the more should they themselves shed gore.

name: CELESTIAL TRANSLOCATION
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SERAPHON unit wholly within 12" of a friendly SERAPHON WIZARD to use this ability.

Effect: Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: In a flash of starlight, an Eternal Starhost arrives to enact the will of the Old Ones. Tapping into the celestial power that surrounds the slann, they teleport across the battlefield to catch the foe off guard.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase

name: VENGEANCE OF AZYR
description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly SAURUS or KROXIGOR units that are in combat to be the targets.

Effect: For each target:
  • Make a pile-in move.

  • Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
legend: The celestite weapons carried by the warriors of a Sunclaw Starhost are supercharged with the power of Azyr.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

name: SCALY MONSTROSITIES
description: Effect: Add 2 to the Health characteristic of friendly SERAPHON MONSTER units.
legend: The great beasts of the Seraphon are almost invincible when they march forth as a pack.

name: NIMBLE AND QUICK
description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly SKINK INFANTRY or SKINK CAVALRY units that are not in combat to be the targets.

Effect: Each target can move D6". Each target cannot move into combat during any part of that move.
legend: The skink warriors of a Shadowstrike Starhost outmanoeuvre their enemies at every turn.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase

name: THE GREAT PLAN
description:
Declare: You must use this ability. Pick an ASTERISM ability to be prophesied.

Effect: That ASTERISM ability can be used for the rest of the battle, but the others cannot, unless prophesied by the ‘Further the Great Plan’ ability.
legend: The Seraphon look to the heavens for guidance, scrying the stars above in the hope that the Great Plan is revealed to them.

name: FURTHER THE GREAT PLAN
description:
Declare: You cannot use this ability in the first battle round. Pick an ASTERISM that you have prophesied. You cannot pick an ASTERISM that you have previously picked this battle. If you do not meet the condition below that corresponds to that ASTERISM, this ability has no effect.
  • Itzl the Tamer: 3 or more enemy units have been destroyed.
  • Quetzl the Preserver: There are no enemy units wholly within friendly territory.
  • Sotek the Deliverer: The enemy general is in combat or has been destroyed.
  • Tepok the Seer: There are any friendly SLANN units on the battlefield and no friendly SLANN units are in combat or have be
legend: As the battle unfolds, so do the machinations of the Old Ones.
condition: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round

name: ITZL THE TAMER
description: Effect: Companion weapons used by friendly SERAPHON units have Crit (2 Hits).
legend: Itzl is the most bestial of all the Old Ones and his asterism fills the Seraphon with ferocity.

name: QUETZL THE PRESERVER
description: Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons for attacks that target friendly SERAPHON units that are wholly within friendly territory.
legend: Quetzl grants protection from the dangers of the physical realms.

name: SOTEK THE DELIVERER
description: Effect: Add 2 to the Move characteristic of friendly SERAPHON units.
legend: The Asterism of Sotek emboldens the Seraphon with a war-hungry aggression.

name: TEPOK THE SEER
description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly SERAPHON units.
legend: The sign of Tepok, resplendent in the stars above, enlivens the land with thrumming geomantic energy.

name: BEING OF THE STARS
description: Effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for this unit (positive and negative).
legend: This hero has a particularly strong connection to their astral heritage, causing their corporeality to wax and wane.

name: ARCANE DETERMINATION
description: Effect: Add 10 to this unit’s control score while it is wholly within 12" of a friendly MANIFESTATION.
legend: Their body thrumming with celestial energies, this Seraphon draws strength from nearby spell-forms in order to see the will of the Old Ones done.

name: KEEPER OF THE OLD WAYS
description: Effect: You can pick 2 different ASTERISM abilities instead of 1. They are both used in addition to the one you picked in the deployment phase.
legend: Having spent centuries poring over tablets of the Old Ones or in deep meditation, or perhaps through some primal intuition, this Seraphon possesses knowledge of ancient secrets concerning the workings of the cosmos.
condition: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared the ‘%000013630Further the Great Plan%’ ability

name: REPTILIAN CUNNING
description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, if a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘All-out Attack’ command in the combat phase, no command points are spent.
legend: With cold-blooded calculation, this general looks for opportunities to strike.

name: CHILD OF THE STARS
description: Effect: If this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, Heal (D3) this unit. This unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.
legend: This warrior is made of pure star-matter, immortal and eternal.

name: CALM AND COLLECTED
description: Effect: Reduce your and your opponent’s fury levels by up to 3, to a minimum of 0. You must reduce both players’ fury levels by the same amount.
legend: Pure tranquillity radiates from this Seraphon, causing anger to dissipate across the battlefield.
condition: Once Per Battle, End of Your Turn

name: LORD OF SPACE AND TIME
description:
This enhancement can only be given to Slann Starmasters.

Declare: Pick any number of friendly SERAPHON units wholly within 12" of this unit that have not used a MOVE ability this turn to be the targets.

Effect: This unit gains a number of stored time points equal to the number of targets picked.

Then, if this unit has 5 or more stored time points, you can pick up to 3 visible enemy units within 18" of it. In your opponent’s next turn, halve the Move characteristic of those enemy units. If you do so, this unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.
legend: Having mastered temporal manipulation, this slann can store time before bending it to their will.

name: BEASTMASTER
description: Effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly SERAPHON CAVALRY and SERAPHON MONSTER units for the rest of the phase if they are wholly within 12" of this unit at the start of the move.
legend: This mighty leader has a primal dominance over the beasts of the Seraphon hosts, driving them forward to battle.

name: CHOSEN OF QUETZL
description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly non-MONSTER SKINK unit that is in combat and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target can move up to 8". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.
legend: This champion of Quetzl the Preserver is a master tactician, coordinating the movement of nimble skinks to outmanoeuvre the foe.

name: TITAN OF THE LAND
description: Effect: This unit counts as a terrain piece for the purpose of picking targets for the friendly Realmshaper Engine’s ‘Power Unleashed’ ability. Do not inflict any mortal damage on this unit as part of that ability.
legend: This warbeast has absorbed so much of its environment’s latent magic that it has become a locus of the natural energies of the Mortal Realms.

name: ARMOUR CRUNCHER
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: You can spend 1 rage dice. If you do:
  • Apply the effect below.
  • If your opponent’s fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Otherwise, roll a dice. If the roll equals or
exceeds the target’s Save characteristic, apply the effect below.

Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
legend: The sheer heft and strength of this beast sees it crush and crumple well‑protected foes in their own armour before it even gets around to tearing into them with tooth, horn and claw.

name: ANCIENT DEFENDER
description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this unit’s Companion weapons.
legend: This venerable beast has seen countless battles, as evidenced by its heavily scarred hide.

name: TITANIC SLAM
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this unit charged this turn. On a 3+, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.
legend: Whether because of an earthshaking charge or the swipe of a colossal tail, the enemy is thrown to the ground.

name: CHAMELEONIC CAMOUFLAGE
description: Effect: While this unit has not used a MOVE ability in the same turn, it is not visible to enemy units more than 12" away
legend: This beast’s scales are iridescent while it is mobile, but they quickly change to blend in with the environment when the creature comes to a halt.

name: ARMOUR CRUNCHER
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Save characteristic, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
legend: The sheer heft and strength of this beast sees it crush and crumple well-protected foes in their own armour before it even gets around to tearing into them with tooth, horn and claw.

name: LIGHT OF CHOTEC
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SERAPHON WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly SERAPHON unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of damage points the target has. For each 4+, Heal (1) the target.
legend: The wizard calls upon the sun god Chotec to energise an injured warrior with rays of invigorating solar magics.

name: MYSTICAL UNFORGING
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SERAPHON WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target’s weapons until the start of your next turn.
legend: The magic of unmaking flies from the wizard’s outstretched hands.

name: THE EARTH TREMBLES
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SERAPHON WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a point on the battlefield within 18" of them to be the target point, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Draw a straight line between the target point and the closest part on the caster’s base. Roll a D3 for each unit (friendly and enemy) that has models passed across by this line. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
legend: With a focused pulse of will, the Starmaster sets the energy of the ley lines spiking until the ground is violently torn asunder.

name: COMET’S CALL
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SERAPHON WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
legend: Their consciousness soaring up to the heavens, the wizard summons a celestial comet that plummets down into the enemy ranks.

name: SPEED OF HUANCHI
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SERAPHON WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly SERAPHON unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target can use a RUN ability and still use SHOOT and/or CHARGE abilities later in the turn.
legend: With the grace and momentum of a prowling beast, the allies of the priestly mage are filled with a celestial haste.

name: EMPOWERED CELESTITE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SERAPHON WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly SAURUS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
legend: Tapping into the ancient technologies within the weapons of the Coalesced, a light is birthed in each; for a few moments, every strike shatters armour in an explosion of sparks.

name: PREDATORY FIGHTERS
description:
Declare: Roll a dice for each enemy unit in combat with any friendly units.

Effect: On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the unit being rolled for.
legend: These warriors bite bloody chunks of flesh from their foes in battle.
condition: Once Per Phase, End of Any Turn

name: SOTEK'S GAZE
description: Effect: Roll a dice. Add the roll to your general’s control score this turn.
legend: The eyes of this gilded war-mask resonate with the pitiless hunger of the Serpent God. With it, the Oldblood brutally cows lesser foes.

name: BEAST OF THE DARK JUNGLES
description:
Declare: Pick your general to use this ability if they are in combat.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following:

Gargantuan Jaws: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general and roll a dice. If the roll exceeds that unit’s Health characteristic, 1 model in that unit is slain.

Roar: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general. Subtract D6 from that unit’s control score this turn.
legend: The perilous jungles of the Seraphon are the hunting grounds of the mighty Carnosaur, a reptilian titan that strikes fear and awe into the hearts of its enemies.

name: TEMPLE-CITY GUARDIANS
description: Effect: Friendly units have WARD (6+) while they are wholly within friendly territory.
legend: Patrolling the lands on the outskirts of their domain, these defenders will stop at nothing to see intruders driven back.

name: BLADE OF REALITIES
description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of your general’s Relic Celestite Weapon.
legend: Entrusted only to the most formidable Oldbloods, this pan-dimensional weapon exists to bring about the end of tyrants.

name: ANCIENT STRATEGIST
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general. You cannot pick your general.

Effect: That unit can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
legend: This Oldblood has centuries of experience in commanding their cohorts.
condition: Once Per Battle, Enemy Movement Phase

name: THE WRATH OF CHOTEC
description: Effect: The Attacks characteristic of your general’s Sunbolt Gauntlet is 6 instead of D6.
legend: An ancient relic removed from the deepest temple vaults, this gauntlet allows an Oldblood to channel the full might of the Seraphon’s solar god.

name: SCALED AEGIS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SAURUS unit to be the target

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, that unit has WARD (6+) until the start of your next turn.
legend: The tenacity of the saurus Sunbloods is legendary, and that of the cohorts under their command equally so.

name: CHAMELEON AMBUSH
description: Effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.
legend: The Hunters of Huanchi and the Spawn of Chotec emerge from hiding to unleash a hail of potent poisoned projectiles.

name: INSTINCTIVE COMMANDER
description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general and not in combat to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target can immediately use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.
legend: The saurus Sunblood has no need to utter orders, his warriors advancing with instinctive understanding.

name: VENGEANCE OF AZYR
description:
Declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with a friendly SAURUS unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
legend: The celestite weapons carried by the warriors of a Sun blooded Prowlers host are supercharged with the power of Azyr.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

name: FOLLOWERS OF HUANCHI
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SKINK unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target’s ranged weapons have Crit (Auto-wound) for the rest of the turn, including Companion weapons.
legend: Huanchi guides the shots of the skinks and their bestial companions.

name: VENOMITE SWARM
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general to be the target.

Effect: If your general’s Venomites token is on the battlefield, roll a D3. On a 1, remove that token from the battlefield. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
legend: Lethal venom drips from the fangs and claws of Sotek's Venomites.

name: SAVAGE MAULING
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general to be the target.

Effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.
legend: Once the saurus Sunblood begins the dismemberment of the enemy, even mystical defences crumble under his terrible strength

name: BLESSED BY THE OLD ONES
description:
Declare: Your general must use this ability if it has been destroyed. Roll a dice.

Effect: On a 2+, you can set up a replacement unit with 1 Sunblood model anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.
legend: The Sunblood is whisked away by powers unseen moments before a fatal blow can fall, perhaps granting his indomitable spirit time enough to bring him to his feet once more.

name: GLOWY LANTERN
description: Effect: If this unit is a WIZARD or PRIEST, add 1 to its power level for the rest of the battle. Otherwise, pick either the WIZARD (1) or PRIEST (1) keyword. This unit has that keyword for the rest of the battle.
legend: Stolen from the aelves of Hysh after a botched alliance, this aetherquartz jar was at first carried around just because it was shiny. Over time, it has granted its bearer an innate power.

name: KRAKENSKIN SANDALS
description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic, Rend characteristic and Damage characteristic of this unit’s Almighty Stomp.
legend: Cut from the hide of the sea-behemoth Mejendrokk, these sandals protect the wearer’s feet, allowing them to stomp on the enemy without fear of getting spiked.

name: ENCHANTED PORTCULLIS
description: Effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit (positive and negative).
legend: The metal gate that once barred entry to the South Tower of Excelsis bears a potent spell of repulsion. Repurposed as armour, it now serves to protect the wearer’s vulnerables from harm.

name: MASSIVE STUFFIN’ SACK
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll 3 dice. For each roll that is at least double the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is automatically slain.
legend: This gargant hauls around a large sack into which they shove anything that will fit. Which is a lot.

name: MANTLE OF THE WOOD-KINGS
description: Effect: If this unit charged in the same turn, while it is in combat with 2 or more enemy units, add 1 to hit rolls for its combat attacks for the rest of the turn.
legend: Once worn by the rulers of ancient gargantkind, this huge stone necklace is covered in surprisingly intricate carvings. To wear it is to feel some trace of everything the gargants have lost and to be incensed into seeking revenge on as many foes as possible.

name: PROTECTY BITS
description: Effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.
legend: This titan has fashioned some crude personal armour, be this a few metai plates strapped to their torso or a castle door for a shield.

name: BRUTE SPIRITUALITY
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BIG or LITTLE unit to use this ability, then pick an enemy WIZARD or PRIEST within 18" of it to be the target.

Effect: Make a rampage roll of D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Control characteristic:
  • The target has a maximum power level of 1 until the start of your next turn.
  • All MANIFESTATIONS that were summoned by the target are banished and removed from play.
legend: Daubed with mystic woad or grunting ancient words of power, these gargants shut down magical influence.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

name: TEN-LEAGUE STRIDES
description: Effect: Each time a friendly BIG or LITTLE unit uses the ‘Redeploy’ command or the ‘Run’ ability, if you roll a 1-2 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 3 instead.
legend: If gargants are especially fired up by some oafish game or challenge, they can cross the land at terrifying pace.

name: ARROGANT BIG ’UNS
description: Effect: In the first battle round, subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks that target friendly BIG and LITTLE units that have not charged in the same turn.
legend: To be up close and personal with gargants at the apex of their self-assuredness can quickly drain the fight from any aggressor.

name: GET TO THE GOODS
description: Effect: Each time a friendly BIG or LITTLE unit that charged in the same turn makes a pile-in move, that unit can pass across enemy models in non-MONSTER units.
legend: When shiny treasure or barrels of grog are sighted, these gargants wade through ranks of little 'uns without pause.

name: STRIKE! HUR HUR!
description:
Declare: Pick up to 2 friendly MEGA-GARGANT units within 3" of any terrain features and pick any friendly GARGANT units within 3" of any terrain features to be the targets.

Effect: Double the Attacks characteristic of each target’s ranged weapons for the rest of the turn. If the target has no ranged weapons, pick an enemy unit within 12" of the target instead and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
legend: These gargants are particularly enthusiastic participants of the game of Manskittles: seeing how many pipsqueaks they can knock down or squish by hurling bits of the landscape... or its inhabitants.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase

name: LOFTY LOUTS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly Mancrusher Gargant unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly GARGANT units while they are wholly within 12" of the target and not wholly within 12" of any friendly MEGA-GARGANT units.
legend: Whether because they insist that they are ‘just a bit taller’ or because they are simply insufferable bullies, these Mancrusher Gargants have an authority over the other Footsloggas that is close to absolute. So long as no one bigger is around, of course.

name: TAKE A RUN AT IT
description:
Declare: Pick any number of friendly BIG or LITTLE units to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is lower than the number of targets picked, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, pick an effect for each target. The effects must be different unless specified otherwise.
  • Pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. You can pick this effect for multiple targets.
  • The target is building momentum for the rest of the turn.

legend: By pushing off with their back foot, the gargant can gain enough impetus to tear off into the distance or trample any obstacles.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase

name: ARGY BARGY
description:

condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

Effect: Set up that unit within 1" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. If it is not possible to set it up, it wanders off and is automatically destroyed.
legend: Suddenly remembering they were in the middle of a fight, an errant gargant returns to the fray.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn

name: THE BIG ONE
description:
Declare: Pick any number of friendly BIG or LITTLE units to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is lower than the number of targets picked, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, pick an effect for each target. The effects must be different unless specified otherwise.
