legend: The titan slams its foot into the earth, causing a minor seismic rupture. The more anger, momentum and general surliness they have behind them, the more damage they can do...
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn

name: That Boy’s not Right
description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, this unit can use a Prayer ability from the prayer lore you picked during army composition as if it had PRIEST (1). Instead of making a chanting roll for that prayer, the chanting roll is 5 and cannot be modified.
legend: This gargant is just plain barmy. They bellow at rocks, flap their arms like a bird and do weird little dances, all to the amusement of their bigger cousins. When the spirit of Behemat appears to answer such seemingly inane antics, that laughter is usually cut short.

name: Up For It
description: Effect: This unit’s melee weapons have Charge (+1 Damage).
legend: This gargant is loud, rowdy and absolutely ready to dish out some serious damage.

name: Always on Guard
description: Effect: This unit has WARD (5+) while it is wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly BIG unit.
legend: This gargant is especially wary around their biggers and betters, for they are always expecting a quick clip on the ear from their surly bosses.

name: GRABBY
description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target an enemy unit contesting an objective you do not control.
legend: If you have something this gargant wants, you won’t have it for long.

name: BRUTE OF BRUTES
description: Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.
legend: This especially thuggish Big Heel believes that enough raw belligerence can overcome any problem.

name: SPELL-CHOMPER
description: Effect: This unit can use UNBIND and BANISH abilities as if it had WIZARD (1). In addition, each time an enemy MANIFESTATION within this unit’s combat range is banished, Heal (D3) this unit.
legend: This Big Heel laughs in the face of the arcane and eats hostile spells for breakfast - in both a metaphysical and literal sense.

name: TERRIFYING HULK
description: Effect: If this unit is not in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, you can change one of the dice in that charge roll to a 1.
legend: As the enemy rushes forward, a raised eyebrow and an even bigger raised club causes them to seriously re-think the choices that brought them to confront this notably fierce-looking example of gargant kind.
condition: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Your opponent declared a CHARGE ability for a %000010532visible% non-<ky>MONSTER</ky> enemy unit within 12" of this unit

name: ALWAYS FIRST IN
description: Effect: This unit can move 2D6". It must end that move more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: Wanting to get stuck in as quickly as possible, this Big Heel hotfoots it across the battlefield before any of their mates can steal all the fun.

name: MEGA-GRUMP
description: Effect: This unit has WARD (5+) while it has 25 or more damage points.
legend: This gargant’s stubbornness and refusal to die in the face of adversity is the subject of local legend.

name: UNREASONABLE TYRANT
description:
Declare: Pick another visible friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT MONSTER unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
legend: This Big Heel has no time for excuses like ‘They’re too far away, boss’ or ‘I’ve lost a leg’, responding to such whingeing with a withering glare and a menacing grunt.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase

name: THUNDERING TITAN
description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a non-HERO enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Make a rampage roll of D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, this unit cannot be picked to be the target of pile-in moves made by the target while there are other friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT units in combat with the target.
legend: As this Big Heel crashes into the enemy, their discipline crumbles almost as fast as their ranks.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase

name: ONE-HIT WONDER
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: This unit can make a pile-in move. Then, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll for cach battle round in which this unit was on the battlefield in both combat phases and did not use any FIGHT abilities. On a 6+, inflict 4D6 mortal damage on the target.
legend: This Big Heel is infamous for winding up a punch that absolutely demolishes whatever it hits. Provided it does hit...
condition: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase

name: TIMBERRRRR!
description: Effect: Each time a friendly BIG unit or LITTLE unit model is slain, before removing it from play, the players must roll off. The winner picks a point on the battlefield within 3" of that model. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point that has a lower Health characteristic than that model.
legend: A dying gargant is a weapon of ruin in its own right, though it is anyone’s guess where their body will fall.

name: HIGH EXPECTATIONS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BRODD’S STOMP PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly BRODD’S STOMP units while they are wholly within 12" of the chanter. If the chanting roll was 9+, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic instead.
legend: In an effort to sort the weak from the strong among his stomp, this Mega‑Gargant encourages his followers to match their strength by seeing how much destruction they can wreak with their bare hands.

name: LUCKY SHINY HAT
description: Effect: This unit has WARD (4+) against damage points inflicted by SPELL and PRAYER abilities and by abilities used by MANIFESTATIONS.
legend: Torn from the head of a defeated aelven lord – and barely large enough to be noticed – this tiny helmet somehow provides its bearer with mystical protection.

name: I CAN DO THAT BETTER
description: Effect: This unit can use the ‘Wrath of Brodd’ ability immediately after the ‘Wrath of Brodd’ ability used by the other friendly unit has been resolved. This unit can do so even if it has used another DESTRUCTIVE IMPULSE ability this turn.
legend: King Brodd can outmatch and overpower even the most belligerent gargants in his Stomp, proving himself the biggest bully around.
condition: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: You declared the ‘%000025498Wrath of Brodd%’ ability for a friendly unit

name: THE WORLD TITAN’S PROPHET
description:
Effect: While any other friendly BRODD’S STOMP units are within a friendly King Brodd’s combat range:
  • That friendly King Brodd has WARD (5+).
  • Each time you make a successful ward roll for that friendly King Brodd, allocate 1 damage point to another friendly BRODD’S STOMP unit within its combat range after the damage sequence for that friendly
legend: Brodd is a living legend amongst his towering kin, the only being in existence they would risk themselves to protect.

name: WRATH OF BRODD
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BIG unit that has not used a DESTRUCTIVE IMPULSE ability this turn to use this ability.

Effect: If the unit using this ability charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, that unit can move 3D6" but must end that move in combat. When it does so, it can pass through terrain features and enemy models as if it had FLY.’
legend: When Brodd’s faithful stride into the fray, the mountains themselves tremble in terror.
condition: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Charge Phase

name: DOUBLE STOMP
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BIG unit that has not used a DESTRUCTIVE IMPULSE ability this turn to use this ability.

Effect: Roll a D6. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, add the result to the Attacks characteristic of the Almighty Stomp of the unit using this ability.
legend: It is quite a sight to see a Mega-Gargant perform a precarious hop, bringing both enormous feet down with enough force to squash a Steam Tank flat.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

name: CRAFTY CREEPERS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BIG unit that has not used a DESTRUCTIVE IMPULSE ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick an enemy HERO that has an artefact of power and is in combat with that BIG unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target no longer has that artefact of power.
legend: These mischievous critters scrabble down the limbs of their massive host when the enemy is near, pilfering the valuables of the foe.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

name: SMASH IT ALL TO BITS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BIG unit that has not used a DESTRUCTIVE IMPULSE ability this turn to use this ability, then pick a terrain feature within its combat range. Then, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of that BIG unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each friendly and enemy unit on the terrain feature that was picked. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll. After rolling for all those units, roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
legend: As part of his crusade of vengeance against Sigmar, Brodd has charged his gargants with the complete destruction of any settlement, outpost or inhabited terrain that they come across on their march.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase

name: WATCH THIS!
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly BIG unit that has not used a DESTRUCTIVE IMPULSE ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: If the target is a HERO, BEAST, MONSTER or WAR MACHINE, roll 6 dice. Otherwise, roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each roll that is equal to or greater than the target’s Save characteristic, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

legend: Eager to prove themself the meanest titan around, this Mega-Gargant embarks on an ungainly – yet terrifyingly destructive – rampage.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

name: A SHEPHERD’S WATCHFUL EYE
description:
Declare: Pick the friendly Ma Maegran to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly MATRIARCH’S MOB units have WARD (6+) while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster.
legend: As the wyrdy eye of Ma Maegran falls upon her gargant flock, they become acutely aware of impending danger.

name: BUTT OF THE LASH
description: Effect: If this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly Ma Maegran, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within her combat range. This unit can only be set up in combat with enemy units that are in combat with the friendly Ma Maegran.
legend: This gargant is always worried that the Chooser will kill them if they let her die, so they never stray too far from her side.

name: I’VE HEARD SHE CAN...
description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:

... Shoot Fire From Her Eyes!: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each visible enemy unit within 12" of the friendly Ma Maegran.

... Turn You Into a Human!: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of the friendly Ma Maegran. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with that unit.

... Make Ya Big and Strong!: Pick another visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of the friendly Ma Maegran. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit’s weapons for the rest of the turn.

. . . Whiz the Bigg
legend: Ma Maegran’s true abilities are shrouded in mystery, but rumours will always exist, and gargants are nothing if not susceptible to a good yarn.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

name: SIC ’EM!
description:
Declare: Pick the friendly Ma Maegran to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly MATRIARCH’S MOB unit wholly within 12" of her to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons, including Companion weapons, for the rest of the turn.
legend: Ma Maegran ‘encourages’ her followers to get stuck in, resulting in near catastrophic levels of damage.

name: OI! GERROFF!
description:
Declare: If the friendly Ma Maegran is in combat and damaged, pick up to 3 friendly Mancrusher Gargants on the battlefield that are visible to her to be the targets.

Effect: Each target has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.
legend: If the Chooser of the Mighty is ever truly threatened, her attendants will fly into a terrible rage, desperate to ensure their chances of being blessed with bigness remain intact.
condition: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase

name: GHYRANITE WHIRLSTONE
description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly MATRIARCH’S MOB unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Heal (D3) the target.
legend: This smooth, green rock, gifted to this gargant by Ma Maegran as a sign of her favour, pulses with healing energies.

name: SUMMON THE HERD
description:
Declare: If the friendly Ma Maegran is on the battlefield, pick each enemy non-FLY non-MONSTER unit that is visible to her to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a number of dice for each target equal to the current battle round number. For each 4+, allocate 1 mortal damage to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
legend: Ma Maegran allows herself a wry smile as a host of Mancrusher Gargants, eager to prove themselves, crash on to the battlefield and cause general havoc before their enthusiastic momentum carries them off to new pastures.
condition: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn

name: MYSTICAL DEMANDS
description:
Declare: Pick the friendly Ma Maegran to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly MATRIARCH’S MOB unit wholly within 18" of her to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the target is in combat, it can use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase. If the target is not in combat, it can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase. In both cases, the target must end that move no further from the caster than it was at the start of the move.
legend: With a magically enhanced bark that shakes the bones of those nearby, Ma Maegran’s orders are heard across the battlefield.

name: DON’T LET NUFFIN’ HAPPEN TO HER!
description:

name: BEHEMAT’S VENGEANCE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT MONSTER unit wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
legend: The chanter incites their followers to avenge their forefather.

name: Rock Bottom
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

name: The terrible Toes
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. If the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to the roll. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, if any enemy models are slain by this ability, halve the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.
legend: Yelling incomprehensibly, the priest jumps up and down. Nearby, enemies are squashed flat by invisible forces that leave massive footprints in the ground.

name: MIGHT OF THE EARTH
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick each friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT unit on the battlefield to be the targets, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Heal (D3) each target. If the chanting roll was 8+, Heal (3) each target instead.
legend: Tales of Behemat’s immense resilience are shouted out for all to hear - and, miraculously, the wounds of those gargants who take heed begin to seal shut.

name: Vocal Tectonics
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, each target has STRIKE-LAST.
legend: As the priest hums a single, low note, the earth shakes and buckles around them, staggering nearby enemies.

name: WORLD TITAN’S STRIDE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT MONSTER unit wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

legend: The priest grants their ally a titanic tread worthy of Behemat himself.

name: HAMMER THROW
description:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly Mancrusher Gargant within its combat range to be the target.

Effect: Roll 3D6. On a 4+, remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within a number of inches of this unit equal to the roll and visible to this unit. It can be set up in combat. The target cannot use CHARGE abilities for the rest of the turn.

If the target is set up in combat:
  • Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
  • Inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with
legend: A smaller gargant is grabbed by their larger cousin and, after a few spins, is hurled high into the air as a living missile.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase

name: EARTHSHAKING ROAR
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Make a rampage roll of D6. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
legend: A blast of this gargants hot, stınkıng breath delivered at volume bowls over those nearby.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

name: BATTERED SHRIMP
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy non-MONSTER HERO in combat with this unit to be the target

Effect: Both players roll off. If you win the roll-off, roll off again. Keep rolling off in this way until you lose the roll-off. Then, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the number of roll-offs made as part of this ability that you won this turn.
legend: The gargant grabs some luckless runt by the ankles and smashes them into the ground, over and over, until they either break free or end up as a wet pile of leaking armour.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

name: WINDMILL WALLOPING
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy MONSTER or WAR MACHINE in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target’s Health characteristic. Add 1 to each roll for each consecutive turn in which the target was picked to be the target of this ability. For each 6+, allocate 1 mortal damage to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
legend: This gargant windmills their arms as they advance towards the enemy, making it clear that if they stay where they are, it’s their fault for getting mashed to a pulp.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

name: COLOSSAL SLAM
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy MONSTER or WAR MACHINE that has no more than 1 model and is in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: If 2 or more friendly BIG or LITTLE units are in combat with the target, apply the effect below. Otherwise, make a rampage roll of D6. Subtract 1 from the roll if the target has a higher Health characteristic than this unit. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again in combat with this unit. Then, inflict D3
legend: The gargant effortlessly hoicks the foe over their shoulder and slams them full force into the ground.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

name: RANCID FLATULENCE
description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with this unit.
legend: Having imbibed a brewery’s worth of stolen ale and some questionably sourced meat, this gargant has a very grumbly tummy - with olfactorily obliterative results.
condition: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn

name: PIPSQUEAK CURSE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.
legend: One of the caster’s eyes begins to glow a dull, dark green as their enemies find all strength sapping from their arms, muscles diminishing by the moment.

name: ENERGY SURGE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT MONSTER unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the target is BIG, add 1 to rampage rolls for it until the start of your next turn. If the target
legend: Vital power cascades out from the caster to invigorate nearby allies

name: THORNFANG’S WRATH
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT MONSTER unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal) for the rest of the turn.
legend: The spirit of the great beast Thornfang, who was said to have given Behemat a solid wrestle more than once, is invoked to lend the caster’s allies immense power.

name: STOMP! STOMP! STOMP! STOMP!
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with a friendly STOMPER TRIBE unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll for each friendly STOMPER TRIBE model in combat with the target.
On a 5+:
  • The target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.
  • Inflict 3 mortal damage on the target.
legend: The Stomper Tribe are famous for one thing, and you’ll never guess what it is ...
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

name: ABSOLUTELY FUMING
description: Effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Almighty Stomp if it did not use a FIGHT ability in the previous turn.
legend: This Mega-Gargant hates being on the sidelines, getting more and more irate the longer they spend ‘not steppin’ on squishies’.

name: FUTURE STOMPER
description: Effect: This unit can use the ‘Power Through’ command even if it has not charged this turn.
legend: Very little can stop this gargant, and their deeds and stature are starting to grow...

name: SPARKY SHIELD
description: Effect: While they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit, friendly STOMPER TRIBE units have WARD (6+) against damage inflicted by shooting attacks.
legend: Whether part of a Seraphon vessel or the helm of a Lumineth knight, the mangled, sparking artefact strapped to this brute’s shoulder keeps them and theirs safe from missiles. Mostly.

name: CAREFULLY WATCHED
description: Effect: Pick a friendly BIG unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved. Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this unit and the target for the rest of the turn.
legend: Nothing spurs a Mega-Gargant on more than the knowledge that they might be outdone by a nearby Little. This one is more precocious than most, earning the watchful eye of their bigger cousin.
condition: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit

name: EAGER FOR THE FIGHT
description: Effect: When making charge rolls for this unit, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.
legend: This Warstomper simply cannot wait to get in amongst the foe.

name: GET IN THERE, YOU RUNTS!
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly LITTLE unit that is within a friendly BIG unit’s combat range, visible to it and not in combat to be the target.

Effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn, and the target has FLY for the rest of the phase.
legend: The Warstomper hates to see members of their tribe shirking battle and is happy to give a helping boot to anyone who needs ‘encouragement’.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase

name: CLUB OF THE FIRST OAK
description: Effect: Heal (D3) this unit.
legend: This immense club heals and invigorates the bearer - provided they keep it in their grip at all times.

name: LITTLE HOPPER
description: Effect: This unit can be picked to use the ‘Stompin’ About’ ability even if it is not wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly BIG unit.
legend: This gargant loves to get their feet good and properly caked in guts and mangled armour.

name: GRAB THOSE ROCKS AND CHUCK ’EM!
description:
Declare: Pick each friendly LITTLE unit wholly within 18" of and visible to a friendly BIG unit and not in combat to be the targets.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target’s ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.
legend: Realising that their followers cannot reach the enemy with their clubs, the Warstomper shouts at them to hurl some rocks instead.
condition: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Shooting Phase

name: KEEN BEAN
description: Effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly BIG unit, it can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN ability in the same turn.
legend: This gargant is constantly trying to get the attention of the Mega-Gargants, hoping that some of their bigness will rub off on them.

name: GETTIN’ STUCK IN
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly STOMPER TRIBE unit in combat to be the target.

Effect: If the target is LITTLE, pick a model in the target unit. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that model’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

If the target is BIG, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of its melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
legend: Warstompers and their followers relish the visceral thrill of battle, wading in wherever the fighting is most bloody.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

name: STOMPIN’ ABOUT
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly LITTLE unit wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly BIG unit to use this ability.

Effect: That LITTLE unit can move D6+3". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat. Then, you can inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit that has a lower Health characteristic than that LITTLE unit and that it passed across during that move.
legend: The Warstomper sends their ‘little’ helpers hither and thither with bellowed demands.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase

name: Bowled Over
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that was allocated any damage points by a friendly unit’s shooting attacks this turn to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, each time your opponent makes a charge roll for the target, they must change the highest D6 to match the lowest D6.
legend: Some gargants love sending the enemy flying with a well-punted rock.

name: Surly Sorts
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit in combat to be the target.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
legend: Usually forced to stay back and chuck rocks, these grumpy gargants are spoiling for a brawl.
condition: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

name: ’Ard ’Ead
description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made with your general’s ’Eadbutt for the rest of the turn.
legend: This gargant has a forehead like a slab of stone. Though stone is more likely to break...
condition: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

name: Close One Eye
description:
Declare: Pick your general to use this ability, then pick another friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target.

Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.
legend: The Boulder Basher bellows at one of their mates to take better aim.

name: Humongous Strides
description: Effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for your general.
legend: This gargant positively bounds across the battlefield, their extreme step length helping them close with the enemy in double-quick time.

name: Greedy and Grabby
description: Effect: Add 5 to the control scores of friendly units.
legend: Gargants love loot, but these gargants really, really love loot.

name: Lucky Rock
description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of your general’s Hurlin’ Rocks for the rest of the turn.
legend: This gargant has their favourite rock, which they lovingly retrieve after every battle.
condition: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase

name: Hungry Gobbler
description: Effect: If any enemy models were slain by your general’s combat attacks this turn, Heal (D3) your general.
legend: This gargant wolfs down the smashed corpses or mashed-but-still-living bodies of anyone they can get their huge hands on.

name: BELLOWING ROAR
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target, then roll a dice.

Effect: On a 2+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by the target unit this phase.
legend: An ear-splitting bellow let loose by a Mancrusher can send the enemy battleline into disarray.

name: FOE-CHOMPERS
description: Effect: Each time an enemy model is slain by a friendly unit’s ‘Stuff ’Em In Me Bag’ ability, Heal (D3) that unit.
legend: The Mancrushers hoist hapless enemies up into the air mid-battle, letting them tumble into their cavernous jaws before giving a mighty belch of satisfaction.

name: MONSTROUSLY TOUGH
description: Effect: Your general has a Health characteristic of 15 instead of 12.
legend: This greedy gargant always takes the juiciest spoils of battle and has an impressive gut as a result.

name: EARTH-SHAKING CHARGE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that charged this phase to use this ability, then roll a dice for each enemy unit in combat with it.

Effect: On a 3+, that enemy unit has STRIKE-LAST this turn.
legend: The ground shakes as the colossal gargants charge head-first into the fray.
condition: Once Per Phase (Army), Any Charge Phase

name: ‘GRAB THOSE ROCKS AND CHUCK ’EM!’
description:
Declare: Pick your general to use this ability, then pick another friendly unit wholly within 12" of them.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit’s Throwin’ Rocks this turn.
legend: Your general commands their fellow gargants to hurl as many rocks at the enemy as they can.

name: LANKY GIT
description: Effect: When you make a charge roll for your general, roll 3D6 instead of 2D6.
legend: This long-legged gargant strides across the battlefield at a frightening pace.

name: EXTRA-BIG BAG
description: Effect: When your general uses their ‘Stuff ’Em In Me Bag’ ability, you can pick 2 enemy units instead of 1 (roll for each).
legend: Made from the tattered remains of enemy banners, even more screaming warriors can be stuffed into this large and garish bag.

name: FURIOUSLY TERRITORIAL
description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by your general that target an enemy unit that is contesting an objective you do not control.
legend: Nothing infuriates this gargant more than pipsqueaks laying claim to the lands around them.

name: Foulhide
description: Effect: Heal (D3) this unit.
legend: Fashioned from the flensed flesh of Rat Ogors and soaked in cloying alchemical agents, this stinking armour sticks to its wearer like a bloated second skin and regrows as fast as it can be hacked apart.

name: Warpstone Charm
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
legend: This foul talisman radiates mutating energy that can be directed at an enemy unit to erode their armour.

name: Skavenbrew
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
legend: This foul concoction, brewed from blood and warpstone, is dispensed to expendable underlings to drive them into a short-lived but devastating killing frenzy.
condition: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

name: BACKSTABBING ALLIES
description: Effect: Pick up to 2 other friendly SKAVEN units that are not in combat and are wholly within 13" of the unit using the ‘Redeploy’ command to be the targets. Each target must have at least one of the following keywords: VERMINUS, SKRYRE, MOULDER, PESTILENS,
legend: The Skaven often form uneasy alliances between clans, but none of them want to suffer the brunt of the fighting when the enemy draws near.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared the ‘%000009837Redeploy%’ command for a friendly %000001298SKAVEN% unit

name: WILL OF THE HORNED RAT
description:
Effect: While a friendly SKAVEN DAEMON is within the combat range of a friendly non-HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY unit:
  • That SKAVEN DAEMON has WARD (4+).
  • Each time you make a successful ward roll for that SKAVEN DAEMON, al
legend: Although they tower over the rest of the swarm, Verminlords are as craven and cunning as any Skaven – in truth even more so – and will readily use their underlings as fodder to protect their own hides.

name: Prized Creations
description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-HERO MOULDER units to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target and apply the corresponding effect:
$000001417
legend: Moulder warbeasts are studded with warpstone crystals and pumped full of vile serums that spur their battle-rage – at the occasional cost of overtaxing their forms.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

name: Skryre Prototypes
description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly SKRYRE units to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target and apply the corresponding effect:
$000001416
legend: The fell contraptions wielded by these ratmen were created by the Clans Skryre’s most ingenious weaponsmiths.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase

name: Claw-picked
description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly VERMINUS units that charged this turn to be the targets.

Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
legend: The Stormvermin and Clanrats of a Verminus Claw‑horde are amongst the most ferocious of all ratmen.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase

name: Corrupted Earth
description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly PESTILENS units that are in combat to be the targets.

Effect: For each target:
  • Make a pile-in move.
  • Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
legend: The Clans Pestilens are relentless in advancing the spread of plague and corruption.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn

name: Kill-Kill! Scurry-Flee!
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy HERO to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, if the target has been destroyed, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly ESHIN units
legend: A kill‑pack has one purpose: slay the target. Once this goal has been achieved and the element of surprise lost, the Eshin agents must see to their own survival…

name: THE LURKING VERMINTIDE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SKAVEN unit that has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up that unit in reserve in the tunnels below. It has now been deployed.
legend: What scurries beneath the surface?

name: ALWAYS THREE CLAWSTEPS AHEAD
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-MONSTER SKAVEN unit that is not in combat and was not set up this turn to use this ability.

Effect: That unit can use the ’Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
legend: The best laid plans of the Skaven never go awry (or so they claim).
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase

name: TOO QUICK TO HIT-HIT
description: Effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY and CAVALRY units by RETREAT abilities.
legend: These skittish ratmen dart and run in all directions, avoiding retribution as they flee from combat.

name: SPLINTERS OF THE VERMINDOOM
description:
Declare: You can use this ability if there are fewer than 3 friendly Gnawholes on the battlefield.

Effect: Set up a Gnawhole on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units, more than 3" from all objectives and more than 1" from all other terrain features.
legend: In the aftermath of the Vermindoom, reality continues to fracture and tear as gnawholes bore into reality, spewing forth endless tides of ratmen.
condition: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round

name: GNAWHOLE AMBUSH
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SKAVEN unit that is in the tunnels below to use this ability.

Effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a friendly Gnawhole and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: Emerging from a green, glowing rift, the Skaventide pours onto the battlefield.

name: WAY OF THE SKITTERING SHADE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge to be the target.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.
legend: It is said that a soul marked for death is never more than a few feet from lurking Eshin agents.
condition: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase

name: CLOAKED IN SHADOW
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly HERO to use this ability. Then, pick a different friendly unit that has 2 or more models to be the target.

Effect: Make a shadow-travel roll of D6. On a 3+, remove the HERO using this ability from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 6" of the target. They can be set up in combat with any enemy units that are already in combat.
legend: By the time enemies have uncovered a band of Skaven assassins, the ratmen are already in place to strike.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

name: MURDEROUS ACROBATICS
description: Effect: When your general uses the ‘Charge’ ability, they can pass through enemy models.
legend: Glowing eyes locked on his target, Crixxit deftly weaves past and leaps across any who would impede him.

name: JUST ANOTHER SHADOW
description: Effect: While your general is wholly within the combat range of a friendly unit that has 3 or more models, your general has WARD (4+).
legend: Crixxit is adept at stalking unseen until the moment to strike arrives.

name: WAY OF THE FIENDISH CLAW
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly HERO to be the target.

Effect: The target has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.
legend: Veteran Deathmasters are experts in many wicked martial arts that harness their natural twitchy agility.
condition: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase

name: MASTER OF SHADOWS
description: Effect: When your general uses the ‘Cloaked in Shadow’ ability, add 1 to the shadow-travel roll.
legend: Swathed in darkness, Crixxit can slip in and out of the gloom with ease, his victims’ cooling corpses the only sign of his passing.

name: DEATH SCREECH
description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit within 6" of your general to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks.
legend: When needs must, Crixxit can unleash a deafening screech to stun foes.

name: THE LURKING VERMINTIDE
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that has not been deployed to be the target.

Effect: The target unit is set up in reserve in the tunnels below. Units in the tunnels below that have not used the ‘Gnawhole Ambush’ ability by the end of the third battle round are destroyed.
legend: What scurries beneath the surface?

name: LEAD THE SEETHING HORDE
description: Effect: Instead of using the set-up instructions in the ‘Call for Reinforcements’ ability, the replacement unit can be set up wholly within 13" of this unit and not in combat.
legend: With screeched war cries, this Clawlord directs their vermin underlings to swarm the enemy.
condition: Reaction: You declared the ‘%000022329Call for Reinforcements%’ ability

name: WARPSTONE-LACED BULLETS
description:
Declare: Pick a ranged weapon a friendly unit is armed with.

Effect: That weapon has Crit (Mortal) this phase.
legend: Saturated with the energies of ruin, these munitions pack a deadly punch.
condition: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase

name: GNAWHOLE AMBUSH
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in the tunnels below to use this ability.

Effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a corner of the battlefield and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: A pack of Skaven emerges onto the battlefield from a glowing green rift in reality.

name: WARPSTONE CHARM
description: Effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for enemy units in combat with your general.
legend: This foul talisman radiates mutating energy.

name: TOO QUICK TO HIT-HIT
description: Effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly units when they use RETREAT abilities.
legend: These skittish ratmen dart and run in all directions, avoiding retribution as they flee from combat.

name: SKRYRE CONNECTIONS
description: Effect: Your general’s Ratling Pistol has an Attacks characteristic of 2D6 instead of D6.
legend: This Clawlord has tasked the Skryre engineers under their command to overcharge their ratling pistol.

name: CLOAK OF STITCHED VICTORIES
description: Effect: Your general has WARD (5+).
legend: This cloak is made from the stitched pelts of traitors and inflicts a rabid paranoia upon the bearer, making them hard to hit and even harder to stab in the back.

name: MASTERCLAN CONNECTIONS
description: Effect: Add D3 to that casting roll or unbinding roll.
legend: This Skaven’s obsequious nature has allowed them to curry favour with a member of the sorcerous Masterclan.
condition: Reaction: You declared a <ky>Spell</ky> or <ky>Unbind</ky> ability for a %000010532visible% Skaven unit wholly within 13" of this unit

name: DEVIOUS UNDERLING
description:
Declare: Pick another friendly SKAVEN HERO on the battleeld with a Health characteristic that equals or exceeds this unit’s Health characteristic to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle:
  • While the target has not been slain, friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY units have WARD (6+) while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
  • Once the target has been slain, add 2 to charge rolls for friendly
legend: Sly in the extreme, this ratman has mastered the art of biding his time, content to wait until his superiors’ demise before violently seizing control for himself.

name: Scurry Away
description: Effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
legend: This Skaven chief does not think twice about scampering to safety when things look to be going south. Perhaps that’s why they have lived so long.

name: Short-tempered
description: Effect: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly SKAVEN units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
legend: This twitching and irascible Skaven has succeeded in making their minions more afraid of their displeasure than of the enemy.

name: MASTER OF THE SWARM
description: Effect: Each time an ability returns 1 or more slain models to a friendly SKAVEN unit wholly within 13" of this unit, after that ability has been resolved, you can return 1 additional slain model to it.
legend: This warlord understands the importance of numbers, ensuring their burrows are teeming with fresh warriors.

name: FLESHMEDDLER
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly MOULDER unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the turn.
legend: This Skaven carries syringe darts filled with warpstone serum that can be fired into the patchwork hides of nearby Moulder creations to give them a ‘bit of extra bite’.

name: Skilled Manipulator
description:
Effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly non-HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY unit:

  • This unit has WARD (4+).
  • Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
legend: This Skaven warlord is particularly devious and selfserving, deftly ensuring that their minions are always conveniently positioned between themselves and potential threats.

name: ESSENCE OF THE GNAW
description:
Declare: Pick another visible SKAVEN unit wholly within 13" of this unit and in combat to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit has STRIKE-FIRST and the target has STRIKE-LAST.
legend: A cursed combination of warpstone and daemonic power allows this rodent to twist reality.

name: PIT TINKERER
description: Effect: You can re-roll the random characteristic rolls for the Move characteristic of friendly SKRYRE WAR MACHINES while they are wholly within 13" of this unit. In addition, each time a friendly SKRYRE WAR MACHINE wholly within 18" of this unit uses the ‘Rolling Doom’ or ‘Whirling Doom’ ability, add 1 to the amount of mortal damage inflicted, if any.
legend: This mechanically minded Skaven has a compulsion to make ‘improvements’ to the Skryre devices under his command.

name: Summon Warp Lightning Vortex
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Warp Lightning Vortex on the battlefield, pick a friendly SKAVEN WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up the first part of the Warp Lightning Vortex within 18" of the caster and visible to them, then set up the second and third parts exactly 7" from the first part and exactly 7" from each other so that they form a triangle.
legend: Warpstone shards are cast into the air, growing impossibly large and discharging bolts of warp lightning.

name: Summon Vermintide
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Vermintide on the battlefield, pick a friendly SKAVEN WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Vermintide wholly within 13" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: A Skaven spellcaster can summon forth a seething mass of arcane rodents that consumes everything in its path.

name: Summon Bell of Doom
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Bell of Doom on the battlefield, pick a friendly SKAVEN WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Bell of Doom wholly within 13" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: Invoking ancient creation myths, the spellcaster causes a great Bell of Doom to manifest upon the battlefield.

name: TRANSPLANTED BRAINS
description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following brains. Its effects apply for the rest of the turn:

Warpstone Addict’s Brain:
  • Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.
  • This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

Warlock Whelp’s Brain: Add 10 to this unit’s control score
legend: The grey matter of various ‘willing’ Moulder volunteers has been grafted onto these mutants’ brains, allowing them to change their personalities in an instant.

name: ANABOLIC ACCELERATORS
description: Effect: If this unit was set up this turn, when making charge rolls for this unit, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.
legend: The limbs of these mutants have been injected with a serum that promotes rapid tissue growth, giving them a monstrous – if short-lived – burst of speed.

name: SERRATED BONE PROTRUSIONS
description: Effect: For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack made by an enemy unit that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.
legend: The jagged shards of bone that jut out from these abominations can inflict nasty injuries on careless attackers.

name: Battle Damaged
description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Moulder-beast’s Monstrous Limbs is 3.

name: Filth-crust
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SKAVEN PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, the target’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal) until the start of your next turn.
legend: The Great Horned Rat heeds the call of this priest to encrust the weapons of their minions with irresistible contagions.

name: Bile-torrent
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SKAVEN PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 4+ instead.
legend: The priest screeches with glowing green eyes as a torrent of bile sweeps over their foe.

name: Rabid-tough
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SKAVEN PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that unit until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to save rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.
legend: The priest snarls and conjures a dense cloud of toxins that sends their followers into a frenzy that numbs them to pain.

name: Skitterleap
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SKAVEN WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly SKAVEN HERO wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: Vanishing in a puff of foul-smelling smoke, the verminkin reappear elsewhere on the battlefield an eye-blink later.

name: Wither
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SKAVEN WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
legend: The spellcaster hurls a glowing green globe of magical energy at the foe. Anyone touched by the globe starts to shrivel and wither away.

name: Warpgale
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly SKAVEN WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.
legend: Screeching in an unholy tongue, the caster parts the veil of reality and draws a ravening gale of unnatural energies forth.

name: Summon Warp Lightning Vortex
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Warp Lightning Vortex on the battlefield, pick a friendly SKAVEN WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up the first part of the Warp Lightning Vortex within 18" of the caster and visible to them, then set up the second and third parts exactly 7" from the first part and exactly 7" from each other so that they form a triangle.
legend: Warpstone shards are cast into the air, growing impossibly large and discharging bolts of warp lightning.

name: Untapped Mutation
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly MUTATED MENAGERIE WIZARD to cast this spell, pick up to 3 visible friendly MUTATED MENAGERIE units wholly within 13" of them that are affected by the ‘More-more Mutation!’ ability to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For each damage point allocated to the target at the end of this turn by the ‘More-more Mutation!’ ability, add 1 to the target’s control score until the start of your next turn.
legend: This wizard manipulates the warpstone melded into the flesh of their minions, pushing the limits of their physicality before they are inevitably destroyed.

name: Monstrous Entourage
description:
Effect: The Companion weapon ability has no effect on MUTATED MENAGERIE units. While a friendly Thanquol is within the combat range of another friendly MUTATED MENAGERIE unit:

  • That Thanquol has WARD (4+).
  • Each time you make a successful ward roll for that Thanquol, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly MUTATED MENAGERIE unit within its combat range after the damage sequence has been resolved.
legend: Thanquol is well practised in getting Moulder mutants to die on his behalf.

name: Warpstone Innards
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO MUTATED MENAGERIE MONSTER unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the battle. However, at the end of each turn, allocate D3 damage points to the target.
legend: A 'gift' from Thanquol, these warpstone-studded organs have been inserted into a prized warbeast to augment its power.
condition: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase

name: Pack Tactics
description:
Declare: Pick up to 2 friendly non-HERO MUTATED MENAGERIE MONSTER units wholly within 13" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: The targets can each use the ‘All-out Attack’ or ‘All-out Defence’ command this phase even if that command has been used by a friendly unit this phase.
legend: Though insane with frenzy, the beasts of Thanquol's menagerie retain some of their predatory swarming instincts..
condition: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

name: Spiteful Swarms
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO MUTATED MENAGERIE MONSTER unit that has not used any RAMPAGE abilities this turn to use this ability.

Effect: This unit has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn. However, at the end of the turn, this unit is destroyed. When this unit would be destroyed, before it is removed from play, roll a dice for each enemy unit within 6" of this unit. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of that enemy unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the battle.

After this ability has been resolved, this unit cannot use any other RAMPAGE abilities for the rest of the turn.
legend: Always one for a cunning trick, churning rat-swarms have been stitched into the guts of Thanquol's beasts, ready to burst free in a wave of disorienting fangs and claws when their host is slain.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

name: More-more Mutation!
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO MUTATED MENAGERIE unit to be the target. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per battle.

Effect: For the rest of the battle:

  • Add 2 to the target’s Health characteristic.
  • Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic.
  • Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.
  • The target has WARD (5+).
  • At the end of each turn, allocate D3+2 damage points to the target.
legend: The sponsorship of a Grey Seer gives Thanquol's flesh-grafting lackeys licence to pursue their most deranged experiments.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

name: Rampaging Demise
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO MUTATED MENAGERIE MONSTER unit that has not used any RAMPAGE abilities this turn to use this ability.

Effect: This unit has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn. However, at the end of the turn, this unit is destroyed. When this unit would be destroyed, before it is removed from play, roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 6" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

After this ability has been resolved, this unit cannot use any other RAMPAGE abilities for the rest of the turn.
legend: Thanquol cares little for the survival of his beasts and is more than willing to have them sacrifice themselves in spasms of fury.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

name: Reverberating Ritual
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly GNAWHORDE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly GNAWHORDE INFANTRY unit wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target can move an extra 3" when it makes a pile-in move. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to the target’s control score until the start of your next turn.
legend: The priest chants in time with the tolling of the Warpshatter Bells, sonically shattering the last dregs of sanity from nearby ratmen and filling them with dreadful hunger.

name: Disciples of Vizzik
description:
Effect: While a friendly Vizzik Skour is within the combat range of another friendly GNAWHORDE unit:

  • That Vizzik Skour has WARD (4+).
  • Each time you make a successful ward roll for that Vizzik Skour, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly GNAWHORDE unit within its combat range after the damage sequence has been resolved.
legend: The clawpacks of the Great-grand Gnawhorde protect their daemon-prophet by any means necessary.

name: Icon of Great-total Supremacy
description: Effect: You can return up to D3 slain models to each friendly GNAWHORDE INFANTRY unit with a Health characteristic of up to 3.
legend: Within this jagged brass reliquary lies a cutting from the Horned Rat's whiskers. It exerts a natural hold over the Skaven, drawing frothing warriors to it.
condition: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase

name: Harbinger of the Great Ascendancy
description: Effect: If this unit is not in combat, you can use 2 different WARPSHATTER THROES abilities this turn instead of 1.
legend: In the eyes of this Skaven warlord, nothing can stop the Horned Rat's ascendancy and the ruination of the Mortal Realms.
condition: Once Per Battle, Start of Any Turn

name: Deafening Frenzy
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly GNAWHORDE WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly GNAWHORDE INFANTRY unit wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. The casting roll for this spell cannot be modified.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:

  • The target has STRIKE-FIRST.
  • The target cannot use commands.
legend: The caster enhances the clangour of the thirteen Warpshatter Bells in the minds of a nearby swarm, driving them to even greater heights of fury.

name: Summon Vermintide
description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly Vermintide on the battlefield, pick a friendly GNAWHORDE WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a Vermintide wholly within 13" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: A Skaven spellcaster can summon forth a seething mass of arcane rodents that consumes everything in its path.

name: Unstoppable Warp-volley
description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any WARPSHATTER THROES abilities this turn. Pick up to 3 friendly GNAWHORDE units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

  • Add 3" to the Range characteristic of the targets’ ranged weapons.
  • The targets cannot use commands.
legend: The Warlocks of the Gnawhorde are no less aggressive than their Verminus kin - they are simply able to strike from further away.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase

name: Frenzied Momentum
description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any WARPSHATTER THROES abilities this turn. Pick up to 3 friendly GNAWHORDE units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

  • Add 2 to run rolls and charge rolls for the targets.
  • Subtract 1 from the targets’ control scores.
legend: Hateful bells clanging in their minds, the swarms of the Great-grand Gnawhorde surge into the fray.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase

name: Reckless Abandon
description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any WARPSHATTER THROES abilities this turn. Pick up to 3 friendly GNAWHORDES units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

  • Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons.
  • Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks that target those friendly units.
legend: With the death frenzy upon them, the Gnawhorde's warriors show a most unusual disregard for self-preservation.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

name: SKILLED MANIPULATOR
description: Effect: Your general has WARD (4+) while they are within 1" of any friendly Clanrats units.
legend: This Grey Seer is particularly devious and self-serving, deftly ensuring that their minions are always conveniently positioned between themselves and potential threats.

name: ALWAYS THREE CLAWSTEPS AHEAD
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat.

Effect: That unit can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
legend: The best-laid plans of the Skaven never go awry (or so they claim).
condition: Once Per Phase, Enemy Movement Phase

name: WARPSTONE-LACED ARMOUR
description:
Used By: Your Stormfiends unit

Effect: Your Stormfiends unit has WARD (5+) for the rest of the turn.
legend: Lurid green lightning begins to crackle across the armour of the Stormfiends, momentarily deflecting any blows levelled at them.
condition: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared an <ky>ATTACK</ky> ability and targeted your Stormfiends unit

name: CAGE OF WARP LIGHTNING
description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of your general and roll a dice.

Effect: On a 2+, the enemy unit has STRIKE-LAST this phase. On a 1, inflict 1 mortal damage on your general.
legend: A ‘gift’ to the Grey Seer from the Clans Skryre, when this unstable device works correctly, it can momentarily trap its victims in a prison of thrashing galvanic tendrils.
condition: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

name: ENDLESS SWARM OF RATS
description: Effect: When a friendly Clanrats unit uses its ‘Seething Swarm’ ability, you can return D6 slain models to that unit instead of D3.
legend: From the many gnawholes that encircle the battlefield, more and more verminkin swarm forth without cease.

name: SKITTERLEAP
description:
Declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: On a 6+, remove your general from the battlefield and set them up again on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units. They cannot use MOVE abilities in the following movement phase.
legend: The Grey Seer vanishes in a puff of foul-smelling smoke, reappearing elsewhere on the battlefield an eye-blink later.

name: SCURRY AWAY
description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase. If it does so, no mortal damage is inflicted on it.
legend: This Grey Seer is a staunch believer in the Skaven philosophy that prudent cowardice is a virtue, and they do not think twice about scampering to safety when things look to be going south.

name: INFERNAL PUPPET
description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy WIZARD within 24" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, each time the target is picked to use a SPELL ability, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target as a reaction. If the target is destroyed by this ability, do not resolve the effect of that SPELL ability.
legend: As it dances upon the aetheric winds, this eldritch marionette violently disrupts the spellcraft of enemy mages.
condition: Once Per Battle, Start of Any Turn

name: AELFSKIN SCROLL
description: Effect: Pick a visible friendly SLAVES TO DARKNESS WIZARD within 18" of this unit. After that SPELL ability has been resolved, that friendly WIZARD can use a SPELL ability as if it were your hero phase, and the casting roll for that spell is equal to the casting roll for that enemy spell. Do not count that spell towards the number of SPELL abilities that friendly WIZARD can use this phase.
legend: Upon reciting the words on this unholy scroll, the aelf-soul bound to it is twisted into the perfect fuel for the foulest of magic.
condition: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared a <ky>Spell</ky> ability for a %000016901Wizard% within 18" of this unit

name: AMULET OF CHAOS
description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick a friendly DARKOATH INFANTRY unit in combat with that enemy unit to be the friendly target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+:
  • Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the enemy target equal to the roll.
  • If there is a friendly target, return a number of slain models to it equal to the roll.
legend: Life, death, creation, obliteration. Maddening potential swirls within the gemstone set in this talisman. It need only be loosed by belief.

name: DARKFLAME PENDANT
description: Effect: Weapons used for attacks that target this unit have a maximum Damage characteristic of 1.
legend: This unsettling-looking necklace wreathes the wearer in shadowy flames that see arrows lose momentum and blades dull upon impact.

name: THE VARANITE SHACKLE
description: Effect: Friendly non-WARRIORS OF CHAOS SLAVES TO DARKNESS units have WARD (6+) while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
legend: This writhing torque radiates an aura that twists reality, aiding those who serve the will of the Dark Gods yet are blind or indifferent to the import of their actions.

name: THE CONQUEROR’S CROWN
description: Effect: Subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy INFANTRY units while they are in combat with this unit.
legend: This blasphemous diadem grants the bearer dominion over the minds of lesser mortals.

name: HEAD OF THE UNWORTHY
description: Effect: If a friendly SLAVES TO DARKNESS HERO with any Dark Apotheosis points is destroyed, give this unit 8 Dark Apotheosis points.
legend: This grim trophy is a bleak reminder that the gods’ favour, even if earned over centuries of battle, can be lost and bestowed on another in a heartbeat.

name: RUNE OF MURDER
description:
Declare: Pick 1 of this unit’s melee weapons to be the target.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:
  • Inflict 3 mortal damage on this unit. Then, double the target weapon’s Attacks characteristic for the rest of the turn.
  • Add D6 to the target weapon’s Attacks characteristic for the rest of the turn.
legend: Tracing their fingers over the symbol etched on this stone, the bearer feels their muscles swell with fell strength. Should they smear their own blood over the rune, the power intensifies.
condition: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

name: REALMWARPER’S TWIST-RUNE
description:
Declare: Pick a terrain feature within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: If the target does not have the ‘Obscuring’ terrain ability, it gains that ability until the start of your next turn. Then, roll a dice for each model (friendly and enemy) within 1" of the target. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that model’s unit.
legend: One who bears this cursed rune can bind warped landscapes to their will. Ruptured chasms open as thick palls of dark energy obscure the favoured and their servants from view.
condition: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase

name: IRONCLAD ONSLAUGHT
description:
Declare: Pick an objective that is contested by any friendly units to be the target.

Effect: Place a defiled token next to the target objective. Then, roll a D3 for each enemy unit contesting an objective that has a friendly defiled token. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
legend: When a Chaos horde is on the march, the realms tremble. Hundreds of heavily armoured warriors desecrate all in their path as they roar oaths to the Dark Pantheon.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn

name: FERAL RUIN
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly Daemon Prince to use this ability. Then, pick a visible friendly non-DAEMON non-UNIQUE SLAVES TO DARKNESS unit that does not have an Ensorcelled Banner wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Remove any Pledge to Chaos keywords the target has. Then, the target gains any Pledge to Chaos keywords this unit has.
legend: A Daemon Prince is manifest proof of the ultimate reward that awaits those who serve their patron. The awe they inspire is such that when they make demands in the name of their god, few have reason to deny them.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn

name: UNITED IN DARKNESS
description: Effect: While there is at least 1 friendly WARRIORS OF CHAOS HERO and 1 other friendly DAEMON HERO or DARKOATH HERO on the battlefield, add 2 to the control scores of friendly SLAVES TO DARKNESS units while they are contesting an objective
legend: The myriad forces of Chaos march to war under a common cause, led by warlords who have put aside their rivalries in the name of laying waste to the lands of a shared foe.

name: DEVOTEES OF RUIN
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly WARRIORS OF CHAOS unit. Then, pick up to 2 visible friendly DARKOATH units that do not have a Pledge to Chaos keyword and are wholly within 12" of that WARRIORS OF CHAOS unit to be the targets.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the targets have the same Pledge to Chaos keyword as that WARRIORS OF CHAOS unit.
legend: Though the Darkoath do not know the true significance of the Dark Gods’ runes, when armour-clad warriors bearing those same sigils arrive in their lands, these visitors are often hailed as divine crusaders sent to save them.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

name: PARAGONS OF DARKNESS
description: Effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly non-MONSTER SLAVES TO DARKNESS HEROES.
legend: Those who have long walked the Path to Glory and bear the scars and mutations to prove it are some of the most dangerous warriors in all the Mortal Realms.

name: RALLY THE TRIBES
description:
Declare: If there is a friendly DARKOATH HERO on the battlefield, pick a friendly non-HERO non-UNIQUE DARKOATH unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more th
legend: One of the horde’s commanders looses a terrifying battle cry, calling more of their blade-sworn warriors to their side.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase

name: EYE OF THE GODS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE WARRIORS OF CHAOS or DARKOATH HERO to be the target.

Effect: During the battle, the target gains Dark Apotheosis points as follows:
  • Each time the target uses a FIGHT ability, it gains D3 Dark Apotheosis points.
  • At the end of each of your turns, if the target is contesting an objective that is wholly outside friendly territory, it gains D3 Dark A
legend: The mortal champions of Chaos seek to attract the notice of the gods by performing great deeds in battle.

name: PLEDGE TO CHAOS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE SLAVES TO DARKNESS unit that does not already have one of the keywords below to be the target.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following Pledge to Chaos keywords:
  • PLEDGED TO KHORNE
  • PLEDGED TO TZEENTCH
  • PLEDGED TO NURGLE
legend: The Slaves to Darkness forsake their souls by pledging to the Dark Gods.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

name: DARK APOTHEOSIS
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit with 8 or more Dark Apotheosis points to be the target.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following:

Aura of Chaos: Heal (X) the target, where X is the number of damage points allocated to the target. In addition, the target has WARD (5+) for the rest of the battle.

Daemonhood: Set up a Daemon Prince within 1" of the target. Then, remove the target from the battlefield. If the target is your general, the Daemon Prince becomes your general instead and is added to your general’s regiment. If the target has any
legend: Favoured by the Dark Gods, this champion is bestowed with fell glory.
condition: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase

name: PLEDGED TO TZEENTCH
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly PLEDGED TO TZEENTCH unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll 2D6. Then pick a point within a number of inches of the target equal to the roll. Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that point and more than 9" from all enemy units.
legend: Reality twists and weaves around these warriors as they become intertwined in the machinations of the Change God.
condition: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase

name: PLEDGED TO KHORNE
description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly PLEDGED TO KHORNE units.
legend: The Blood God instils a blind rage in his most frenzied adherents.

name: PLEDGED TO NURGLE
description: Effect: Friendly PLEDGED TO NURGLE units have WARD (6+). If a unit already has WARD (6+), it has WARD (5+) instead.
legend: The Father of Plagues bestows gifts of rot and decay upon his followers.

name: PLEDGED TO SLAANESH
description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, when making charge rolls for friendly PLEDGED TO SLAANESH units, you can roll 1 additional dice (to a maximum of 3), but if you do, you must discard 1 dice of your choice.
legend: The thrill of battle drives these warriors to charge at spectacular speed.

name: DREADED ARRIVAL
description: Effect: Set up this unit wholly within your territory, within 1" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.
legend: To the thunderous beating of flame-trailing hooves and clattering Chaos Armour, the knights arrive to shatter the enemy.

name: FIERCE CONQUERORS
description: Effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly Chaos Warriors units.
legend: These warriors are hell‑bent on desecrating the territory and holdings of any who dare oppose them.

name: MARK OF KHORNE
description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of your general’s melee weapons if they charged in the same turn.
legend: This general serves the Blood God and promises to deliver endless carnage upon the battlefield in return for his dark gifts.

name: EYE OF THE GODS
description:
Declare: Pick one of the following friendly units to use this ability:
  • A unit that is contesting an objective not controlled by your opponent and is not in combat.
  • A unit that destroyed an enemy unit this turn.

Effect: Roll once on the Eye of the Gods table for that unit. That unit gains the Eye of the Gods passive ability that corresponds to the roll (the unit keeps all Eye of the Gods abilities gained in previous turns). If the same unit gains the same ability more than once in the battle, the effects are not cumulative.

$000002961
legend: The Slaves to Darkness seek to attract the notice of the gods by performing great deeds in battle.
condition: Once Per Turn, End of Any Turn

name: THE DREAD BANNER
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly Chaos Warriors unit.

Effect: You can immediately roll on the Eye of the Gods table for that unit.
legend: Marked with sigils of each of the Dark Gods, those who bear this banner seek ruinous blessings whatever their provenance.
condition: Once Per Battle, Start of the First Battle Round

name: MARK OF NURGLE
description: Effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks that target your general.
legend: The Father of Plagues has blessed your general with unnatural resilience.

name: MARK OF TZEENTCH
description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit on the battlefield. You cannot pick your general.

Effect: Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of your general and more than 6" from all enemy units. It cannot use Move abilities for the rest of the phase.
legend: The Changer of the Ways shapes the destiny of your general and grants them the ability to twist and warp the realms around them.
condition: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase

name: MARK OF SLAANESH
description: Effect: Your general has STRIKE-FIRST.
legend: Your general is bound to the Dark Prince, who, for the price of their soul, gifts them inhuman grace and martial skill.

name: BRAND OF UNBREAKABLE BONDS
description:
Declare: This unit cannot use this ability if it has an Ensorcelled Banner.

Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of an objective you control and not in combat. This unit cannot use CHARGE abilities for the rest of the turn.
legend: This brand binds those who bear it to a site of corrupted earth. As yet, none know what importance this forsaken land holds.
condition: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase

name: BRAND OF APOPLEXY
description: Effect: While your fury level is 7, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s weapons.
legend: When those marked with this brand see red, all hell breaks loose.

name: BRAND OF THE UNALIGNED
description:
Effect: Remove all of this unit’s Pledge to Chaos keywords. Then, pick 1 of the following Pledge to Chaos keywords. You cannot pick a keyword you picked for this unit earlier in the battle.
  • <SPAN CLASS="KWB KWBU">PLEDGED</SPAN> <SPAN CLASS="KWB KWBU">TO</SPAN> <SPAN CLASS="KWB KWBU">KHORNE</SPAN>
  • <SPAN CLASS="KWB
legend: The warriors bearing this brand are beholden to no single deity; they regularly shift their allegiance depending on which Dark God’s power is in ascendancy.

name: OATHS OF DARKNESS
description:
Effect: You can reveal 1 battle tactic card in your hand to your opponent. If you do so, that battle tactic card becomes your oath for the rest of the turn.

While this battle tactic card is your oath, you can still use the command on it, or attempt to score the battle tactic on it, as normal.

If you score the battle tactic on your oath this turn, your oath is fulfilled. Instead of discarding the card, it is placed to one side but you can still use the command on it. Once you do so, the card is discarded as normal. Fulfilled oaths placed to one side in this way do not count towards the 3 battle tactic cards you can have in your hand.
